local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldSanabiSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LaboseWorldSanabi @
		Comment = 산나비 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type LaboseWorldSanabiController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	---@type LaboseWorldScreenplayManager
	self.sp_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/Common/LaboseWorldScreenplayManager')

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'passage_18_2'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		zone_enter = 2,
		battle = 3,
		battle_end = 4
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- characters
	self.characters = {
		kid_girl = function()
			return get_character('lw_passage_kid_girl')
		end,
		worker = function()
			return get_character('battle_event_boss')
		end
	}

	-- zones
	self.zones = {
		kid_girl_zone = 'sanabi_zone_1',
		worker_zone = 'battle_event'
	}

	-- fx
	self.fx = {
		tint_red_to_none = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_tint_red_to_none')
		end,
		black_slash = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_laboseworld_black_slash')
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:pre_setting()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.sp_manager = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.kid_girl_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.zone_enter
		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.show_kid_girl_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.worker_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle
		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.battle_start, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.battle and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(get_party_leader(), e.Info.target) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(self.characters.worker(), e.Info.sender) then
		-- 사망 시 처리
		if user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < 1 then
			self.current_state = self.states.battle_end
			start_coroutine(self.player_dead, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.battle and
			e.BattleGroupName == 'battle8' then
		self.current_state = self.states.battle_end
		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.battle_clear_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

--- 시작 전 세팅
function local_class:pre_setting()
	local kid_girl = self.characters.kid_girl()

	scene_util.set_direction(kid_girl, 'right', false)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(kid_girl, 0, 0)
	kid_girl.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	--npc는 이더리얼 상태로 충돌하지 않는다.
	kid_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(kid_girl, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
end

function local_class:show_kid_girl_event()
	local kid_girl = self.characters.kid_girl()

	--소녀npc(lw_passage_kid_girl npc) 가 지정 위치에 1초만에 0.3 알파값으로 알파 페이드 인
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(kid_girl, 0.1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--애니, (run, right)
	--5의 속도로 지정된 위치부터 오른쪽으로 4초간 달린다
	wp_util.move(kid_girl, kid_girl.Position + vector(16, 0, 0),
			4, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
	wait_for_sec(3.5)

	--3.5초부터 4초까지 알파 페이드 아웃시키며 퇴장
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(kid_girl, 0, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end
--- 보스 전투 시작
function local_class:battle_start()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local worker = self.characters.worker()
	local align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('stair_in_pos_2')
	local worker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sanabi_center') + vector(1, 0, 0)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('sanabi_battle_gate_1'))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		local dir = i == 0 and vector(1, 0, 0) or vector(-1, 0, 0)
		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, dir,
				12000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		scene_util.set_direction(member, i == 0 and 'left' or 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'surprise')
		command_util.publish_knock_back(member.Owner, member, knock_back_info, member.Position)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(member)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
	end

	scene_util.hero_landing(worker, 'left', worker_pos, 10, 0.6)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.8)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 보스 위치로 정렬
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, worker })
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

	--전투 시작 시 타이틀 출력
	--진입 시 보스 이름 출력 이벤트
	--title: 워커287634
	--desc: 끝까지 가는 것이…
	screen_util.show_boss_title('lw_sanabi_s1_1', 'lw_sanabi_s1_2', 2, false)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_immortal(get_party_leader(), true)

	--전투 종료 시 도어가 열리도록
	character_util.convert_to_monster(worker, 'battle8', 'battle_event')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(worker, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
end

--- 플레이어 사망 시 처리
function local_class:player_dead()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local worker = self.characters.worker()

	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(worker)

	--전투 중 사망할 경우 처형 씬 연출
	--1프레임만에 화면 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magwi_rock_set_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--1초 뒤 빨간색 페이드 인
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--파티 리더와 이벤트 몬스터의 연출 위치 수정
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(worker, 'right', false)
	character_util.set_position(leader, field_util.get_marker_pos('sanabi_center'))
	character_util.set_position(worker, leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, worker })

	--파티 리더, npc 까맣게 틴트 처리
	self.fx.tint_red_to_none():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position, 15))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.add_color(member, member.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)

		-- 파티원 안보이는 위치로 이동
		if i ~= 0 then
			character_util.set_position(member, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end
	end

	character_util.add_color(worker, worker.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_06')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	--다음 동작 동시에 진행
	--카메라 줌인 (3, 1.1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1.1)

	--머리 부근에  공격 이펙트(요청 예정) 출력
	--산나비 오마주 npc (katana_attack3, right) 출력
	scene_util.set_anim(worker, self, { name = 'katana_attack3', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	--파티 리더 (damaged2, left)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'damaged2')
	character_util.move_distance(worker, vector(2, 0, 0), 0.03)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minotaurs_slash_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_white_slash_02')
	self.fx:black_slash():Instantiate(leader.Position)

	--1.5초 대기 후 캐릭터 사망 처리
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'dead', sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.remove_color(member, member.Name, 1)
	end

	character_util.remove_color(worker, worker.Name, 1)

	--이후 게임 오버 연출 그대로 사용
	stage:SetGameOver(CS.Oak.UIGameOver.UIGameOverButtonType.OnlyWaypoint, false, false)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent.Instance)
end

--- 보스 전투 클리어
function local_class:battle_clear_event()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('sanabi_battle_gate_1', true))

	local origin_party = party_util.get_origin_party()

	for i = 2, #origin_party do
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(origin_party[i], user_party)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('sanabi_door_pos'), 1)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('sanabi_door_1', false))

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.set_immortal(get_party_leader(), false)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()

			return get_field_object('medevac_bed_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- zones
	self.zones = {
		start_zone = 'medevac_start_zone',
		safe_zone = 'medevac_safe_zone',
		reset_zone = 'medevac_reset_zone',
		exit_zone = 'medevac_exit_zone',
		safe_start_zone = 'medevac_safe_start_zone',
		labose_zone = 'weak_labose_zone_'
	}

	--markers
	self.markers = {
		swat_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('medevac_swat_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		center_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('medevac_swat_center')
		end,
		end_event_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('medevac_swat_clear_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- door
	self.door_name_pre_fix = 'medevac_door_'

	-- fx
	self.fx = {
		star_piece = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character')
		end,
		lilithtower_virus_death_explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_virus_death_explosion')
		end,
		reset = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.star_piece_fx = nil

	-- 세이프 존
	self.event_range = {
		inst = nil,

		create = function(this, zone_name)
			local bounds = field:GetZone(zone_name).Bounds
			local pos = bounds.center
			local size = unity_class.vector2(bounds.size.x, bounds.size.z)
			local show_type = CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.NONE
			this.inst = attack_range_util.create_rect_by_color_key('green', pos, size, show_type)

			attack_range_util.show(this.inst, 0)
			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(this.inst, pos, 0)
		end,

		set_active_state = function(this, is_active)
			if is_active then
				this.inst:Show(0)
			else
				this.inst:Hide()
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.inst ~= nil then
				this:set_active_state(false)
				this.inst = nil
			end
		end
	}

	-- 스테이지 종료 체크용
	self.stage_ended = false

	-- quest marker
	self.quest_marker_name = 'medevac_quest_'
	self.quest_marker_count = 3
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:pre_setting()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.swat(1), self.controller)

	self.current_state = self.states.none
	self.stage_ended = true

	self:star_piece_fx_dispose()

	self.event_range:dispose()
	self.event_range = nil

	self.swat_info = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.fx = nil
	self.sp_manager = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.show_swat and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.swat(1)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_swat
		local is_entered = self.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.talk_swat_event, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.show_swat
		end

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.quest_do_not_accept and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.swat(1)) then
		self.current_state = self.states.quest_request
		local is_entered = self.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.talk_swat_event, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_state = self.states.quest_do_not_accept
		end

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state >= self.states.quest_accept and
			self.current_state < self.states.quest_clear and
			self.current_restart_state == self.restart_state.out and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.swat(1)) then
		self.current_restart_state = self.restart_state.restart
		local is_entered = self.sp_manager:try_start_scene(self.quest_restart_event, self)
		if not is_entered then
			self.current_restart_state = self.restart_state.out
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.start_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_swat
		start_coroutine(self.show_swat_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state >= self.states.quest_accept and
			self.current_state < self.states.quest_clear and
		self.current_restart_state == self.restart_state.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.exit_zone) then
		self.current_restart_state = self.restart_state.out
		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.quest_stop_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.quest_accept and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.safe_start_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.safe_start
		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.safe_start_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.safe_start then
		for i = 1, #self.swat_info do
			if not self.swat_info[i].holdable then
				goto continue
			end

			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.swat_info[i].npc, self.zones.reset_zone) then
				self:swat_reset(i)
				return true
			end

			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.swat_info[i].npc, self.zones.safe_zone) then
				start_coroutine(self.safe_swat_check, self, i)

				return true
			end

			::continue::
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

--- 시작 이벤트

	--군인 (right, idle, twohand_idle)[shout] : 여기는 베타! 대답하라, 감마!

	--군인 (right, idle, twohand_idle)[shout] : 부상당한 대원들 상태가 어떤지 브리핑 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_broadcast_01', play_pos = swat.Position })
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(swat, 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_2', false)

	--이후 군인 NPC에게 FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 출력.

	character_util.add_listener(swat, self.controller)

--- 퀘스트 수락할 지 대사
function local_class:talk_swat_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local swat = self.characters.swat(1)

	--플레이어 군인 NPC 인터렉트 시, ■타일에 right 방향으로 정렬.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)
	party_util.align_party(swat, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	--군인 NPC FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 제거.
	self:star_piece_fx_dispose()

	if self.current_state == self.states.talk_swat then
		--대기 0.5초
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--가디언 (right, idle, release 2회)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		--군인 (left, idle, idle 자세로 jump 1회) : 앗, 가디언 님!
		character_util.normal_jump(swat, '01_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'left',
				'idle',
				'idle',
				'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_3')

		--해당 대사 출력 부터 손에 들고 있던 walkie_takie 장비 제거
		scene_util.hide_weapon(swat)
		--군인 (left, idle, release 2회) : 큰일입니다, 지금 부대원들이 위험합니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				'idle',
				'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_4')

		--가디언 (right, idle, bomb_idle 1초)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		--군인 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 작전 명령을 수행하기 위해 안쪽으로 진입했던 저희 부대원들이…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'left',
				'cross_arm',
				'idle',
				'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_5')

		--군인 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 그만 부상을 입고 L-박테리아 지역에 고립되고 말았습니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'left',
				{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false },
				'idle',
				'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_6')

		--군인 (left, idle, idle) : 상태가 어떤지 계속 통신을 시도해보고 있지만… 도저히 연락이 닿질 않고 있습니다…!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_7')

		--군인 (left, idle, idle) : 이대로라면… 분명 병사들의 목숨이…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_8')
	else
		scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'left')
	end

	do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--(mercy) 내가 도와줄게, 앞장 서!
			{ 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_9', 'mercy' },
			--(brutal) 바빠서 이만 실례하지.
			{ 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_12', 'brutal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--가디언 (right, idle, release 2회)
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

			--군인 (left, idle, salute) : 감사합니다, 가디언님!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
					'left',
					'salute',
					'idle',
					'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_10')

			--군인 (right, idle, release 2회) : 저와 함께 병사들이 있는 지역으로 이동하시죠!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
					'left',
					{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
					'idle',
					'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_11')

			self:party_move(swat)

			self.current_state = self.states.quest_accept
		else
			self.current_state = self.states.quest_do_not_accept

			--군인 (left, idle, idle) : 아… 알겠습니다.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_13')

			--군인 (right, idle, idle) : 젠장…! 방법이 없는건가…!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
					'right',
					'idle',
					'idle',
					'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_14')

			--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
			--이후 군인 NPC에게 FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 출력.
			self:star_piece_fx_instantiate(swat)
		end

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
	end
end

--- 입장 처리용 함수
function local_class:party_move(swat)
	--닫혀있던 도어가 오픈되며, 가디언과 군인 NPC가 1.5초에 걸쳐 오른쪽으로 5칸 walk 자세로 이동.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_name_pre_fix .. 1, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_name_pre_fix .. 2, false))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(5, 0, 0),
				nil, 1.5)
	end

	wp_util.move_async(swat, swat.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), nil, 1.5)

	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	--군인 NPC가 가디언의 팔로워로 따라붙는다. (파티원이 아닌 팔로워로만 따라붙게 처리)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(swat, user_party, false)
end

--- 퀘스트 존 바깥으로 나올 경우
function local_class:quest_stop_event()
	local swat = self.characters.swat(1)

	--군인 NPC의 팔로워를 떨어뜨린다.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(swat)

	--동시에 군인은 지정된 위치로 left 방향 정렬.
	wp_util.move(swat, self.markers.swat_pos(1), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	--가디언 ■타일로 이동 후 right 방향 정렬.
	party_util.align_party(self.markers.swat_pos(1), 'left', 1, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_name_pre_fix .. 1, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_name_pre_fix .. 2, false))

	--군인 (left, idle, release) : 가디언님! 용무가 있으시다면 먼저 다녀오십시오!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			'left',
			'release',
			'idle',
			'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_15')

	--군인 (left, idle, salute) : 그 동안 이곳에서 대기하고 있겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
			'left',
			'salute',
			'idle',
			'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_16')

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'right', false)
	--이후 군인 NPC에게 FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 출력.
	self:star_piece_fx_instantiate(swat)
	character_util.add_listener(swat, self.controller)

	for i = 1, self.quest_marker_count do
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name .. i)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:quest_restart_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local swat = self.characters.swat(1)

	--플레이어 군인 NPC 인터렉트 시, ■타일에 right 방향으로 정렬.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)
	party_util.align_party(swat, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	--군인 NPC FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 제거.
	self:star_piece_fx_dispose()

	--군인 left 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'left')

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--(mercy) 복귀 완료! 다시 들어가자고.
		{ 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_17', 'mercy' },
		--(brutal) 바빠서 이만 실례하지.
		{ 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_19', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--가디언 (right, idle, release 2회)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		--군인 (left, idle, salute) : 알겠습니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'left',
				'salute',
				'idle',
				'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_18')

		self:party_move(swat)
		self.current_restart_state = self.restart_state.none

		if self.current_state == self.states.safe_start then
			for i = 1, self.quest_marker_count do
				if self.swat_info[i + 1].holdable then
					quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name .. i,
							self.cs_controller.QuestId, false, self.characters.swat(i + 1))
				end
			end
		end
	else
		self.current_restart_state = self.restart_state.out
		--군인 (left, idle, salute) : 알겠습니다! 용무가 끝나실 동안 이곳에서 대기하고 있겠습니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swat, self,
				'left',
				'salute',
				'idle',
				'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_20')

		--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
		--이후 군인 NPC에게 FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 출력.
		scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'right', false)
		self:star_piece_fx_instantiate(swat)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:safe_start_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local swats = {
		self.characters.swat(1),
		self.characters.swat(2),
		self.characters.swat(3),
		self.characters.swat(4)
	}

	--가디언 파티원들 ■ 타일에 right 방향으로 정렬.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)
	party_util.align_party(self.markers.center_pos(), 'left', 1.5, 'linear')

	character_util.normal_jump(swats[1], true)
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'attack' })
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 병사1 NPC를 향해 패닝.

	party_util.set_direction('up')
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(swats[2], 1)

	--병사1 (right, idle, prostrate 자세로 0.03값 shake 0.5초) : 감마 팀… 위급 상황…
	scene_util.shake(swats[2], 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swats[2], 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_21')

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 병사2 NPC를 향해 패닝.
	--동시에 파티원들 모두 right 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(swats[1], 'right', false)
	party_util.set_direction('right')
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(swats[3], 1)

	--병사2 (left, idle, prostrate 자세로 0.03값 shake 0.5초) : 부상이 심각해 움직일 수가 없습니다…
	scene_util.shake(swats[3], 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swats[3], 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_22')

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 병사3 NPC를 향해 패닝.
	--동시에 파티원들 모두 down 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(swats[1], 'down', false)
	party_util.set_direction('down')
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(swats[4], 1)

	--병사3 (right, idle, prostrate 자세로 0.03값 shake 0.5초) : 현재 고립 상태… 도움이 필요합니다…!
	scene_util.shake(swats[4], 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swats[4], 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_23')

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 플레이어에게로 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--가디언 left 방향 전환.
	party_util.set_direction('left')
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	--군인 (right, idle, release 2회) : 가디언님! 상황이 더 나빠지기 전에, 부대원들을 어서 옮겨야 합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swats[1], self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'idle',
			'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_24')

	--군인 (right, idle, idle) : L-박테리아가 없는 이쪽 안전 구역으로 병사들을 직접 들어서 옮겨주시겠습니까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swats[1], 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_25')

	--군인 (right, idle, idle) : 그렇게 하면 병사들을 밖으로 후송해서 치료 할 수 있을 겁니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swats[1], 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_26')

	--가디언 (left, idle, nod 2회)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')

	for i = 1, self.quest_marker_count do
		if self.swat_info[i + 1].holdable then
			quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name .. i,
					self.cs_controller.QuestId, false, swats[i + 1])
		end
	end

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_capture_neutral_01')
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
	self.event_range:create(self.zones.safe_zone)
	start_coroutine(self.swat_labose_zone_routine, self)
end

function local_class:swat_labose_zone_routine()
	local labose_wind_pot_controller = get_stage_event_controller('LaboseWindPotController')

	while self.current_state == self.states.safe_start and self.current_restart_state == self.restart_state.none do
		local labose_zone_start = 9
		local labose_zone_end = 18
		for i = 1, #self.swat_info do
			if self.swat_info[i].holdable then
				for j = labose_zone_start, labose_zone_end do
					if not lua_helper.type_compare(get_party_leader().FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
							CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) and
							labose_wind_pot_controller:labose_hit_check(self.zones.labose_zone .. j, self.swat_info[i].npc) then
						self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.swat_dead_event, self, i)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 존 바운드와 fo 의 바운드의 center 로 비교 해서 절반이 엔터 되었는지 판단
function local_class:is_zone_half_enter(bound, fo)
	local fo_center_pos = fo.Bounds.center
	return CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(bound, fo_center_pos)
end

---병사 1,2,3이 (홀더블 하고 있거나 혹은 던졌을 때) 라보스 기믹에 닿을 시 연출
function local_class:swat_dead_event(index)
	self:release_hold_swat()

	local target = self.swat_info[index].npc

	--0.5초에 걸쳐 병사 캐릭터 스파인이 0.7배로 줄어든다.
	character_util.spine_scale(target, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7, 0.5)
	--동시에 스파인 0.03값으로 shake.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_03')
	scene_util.shake(target, 0.03, 0.7, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion 이펙트와 함께 폭발하여 사라진다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_explosion_02')
	self.fx.lilithtower_virus_death_explosion():Instantiate(target.Position)
	--동시에 가디언 surprise 표정 전환.
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	--폭발할 때 화면 shake 0.2초, 세기 0.07로.
	camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.2)
	character_util.set_position(target)
	--게임오버 서큘러 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--이후 플레이어는 안전 구역 존 중앙에 right 방향으로 리스폰되어 서큘러 페이드 인.
	party_util.align_party(self.markers.center_pos(), 'left', 0.5, 'linear')
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	character_util.spine_scale(target, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.set_position(target, self.swat_info[index].pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(target, self.swat_info[index].dir, false)
	--폭발한 병사 스파인은 원래 있던 위치에 다시 배치되어 있음.
	--폭발하지 않은 병사 스파인은 자리 초기화 하지 않음.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

---플레이어가 병사 NPC를 리셋 존에 던졌을 시
function local_class:swat_reset(index)
	self:release_hold_swat()

	local target = self.swat_info[index].npc

	--병사 NPC가 최초 위치로 초기화된다.
	self.fx.reset():Instantiate(target.Position)
	character_util.set_position(target, self.swat_info[index].pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(target, self.swat_info[index].dir, false)
	self.fx.reset():Instantiate(target.Position)
end

function local_class:release_hold_swat()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget

		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),
					leader.Position, 4, false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:safe_swat_check(index)
	--1초 동안 해당 존에 병사 NPC가 모두 존재할 시, 클리어 이벤트 진행.
	--0.1초마다 검사로 계속 검사 방지
	local target = self.swat_info[index].npc
	local delay = 0.05
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1.5
	local leader = get_party_leader()


	while time_passed <= duration and not self.stage_ended do
		-- 2번 swat부터 검사
		if not zone_util.contains_fo(self.zones.safe_zone, target, false) then
			return
		end

		local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

		if zone_util.contains_fo(self.zones.safe_zone, leader, true) and
				lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			break
		end

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(delay, function(progress)
			return not self.stage_ended
		end)

		time_passed = time_passed + delay
	end

	self:release_hold_swat()
	self.swat_info[index].holdable = false
	target.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name .. index - 1)

	local safe_check = true

	for i = 1, #self.swat_info do
		if self.swat_info[i].holdable then
			safe_check = false
			break
		end
	end

	if safe_check then
		self.current_state = self.states.quest_clear
		sp_util.start_scene(self.quest_clear_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:quest_clear_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local swats = {
		self.swat_info[1].npc,
		self.swat_info[2].npc,
		self.swat_info[3].npc,
		self.swat_info[4].npc
	}

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--플레이어가 모든 병사 1,2,3 NPC를 존 안으로 옮겼을 시 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	--가디언 군인(팔로워) NPC를 향해 방향 전환.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.convert_to_npc(swats[1])
	character_util.look_at(leader, swats[1])
	character_util.look_at(swats[1], leader)

	--군인 (right, idle, idle) : 수고하셨습니다, 가디언님!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swats[1], 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_27')

	--군인 (right, idle, release) : 이제 병사들을 밖으로 후송하겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swats[1], self,
			nil,
			'release',
			'idle',
			'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_28')

	--가디언 (nod 1회)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	--들어왔던 도어는 닫혀있는 상태.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_name_pre_fix .. 1, true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_name_pre_fix .. 2, true))

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--최초 NPC는 다음과 같이 배치.
	for i = 1, #swats do
		local bed_offset = i == 1 and vector(0, 0, 0) or vector(0.5, 0.5, 0)
		character_util.set_position(swats[i], self.markers.end_event_pos(i) + bed_offset)
	end

	--병사1 (left, idle, prostrate)
	--병사2 (left, idle, prostrate)
	--병사3 (left, idle, prostrate)
	scene_util.set_group_direction(swats, 'left', false)
	--군인 (right, idle, eat)
	scene_util.set_direction(swats[1], 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(swats[1], self, 'eat')

	--병사 1,2,3 자리에는 wall_CW_battlefield_safe_bed오브젝트가 새로 배치되어 있음.
	self.field_objects.bed(1).Position = self.markers.end_event_pos(2)
	self.field_objects.bed(2).Position = self.markers.end_event_pos(3)
	self.field_objects.bed(3).Position = self.markers.end_event_pos(4)

	--가디언은 ■타일에 (right, idle, idle) 상태.
	party_util.align_party(swats[1].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 페이드 인.
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--군인 (right, idle, nod 1회)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	scene_util.set_anim_async(swats[1], self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	--군인 NPC 왼쪽으로 1칸 이동
	wp_util.move_async(swats[1], swats[1].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 2)

	--군인 (right, idle, idle) : 휴… 다행히 제시간에 응급조치를 마쳤습니다..
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swats[1], self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_29')

	--군인 (left, idle, idle) : 가디언님이 없었다면 결코 병사들을 살리지 못했을 겁니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swats[1], self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_30')

	--군인 (left, idle, salute) : 정말 감사드립니다! 충성!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swats[1], self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'salute', keep = true },
			'idle',
			'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_31')

	--가디언 (right, attack, salute)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'salute')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--군인 (left, idle, idle) : 부디 보답으로 이걸 받아주시죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(swats[1], self,
			'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_32')

	--군인 NPC get 자세로 스타피스를 떨군다.
	scene_util.set_anim(swats[1], self, 'get')
	--스타피스는 군인 NPC의 왼쪽 위 대각선 1칸에 놓임.
	local star_piece = get_field_object('medevac_star_piece')
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, swats[1].Position)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--군인 NPC right 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(swats[1], 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(swats[1], self, 'idle')
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	--이후 각 NPC 인터렉트 시 하단의 원라인 대사 출력.
	--군인 (right, idle, idle) : 모두 무사해서 정말 다행이군.
	swats[1].Interactable.Talk = 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_33'
	--병사1 (left, idle, prostrate) : 으윽…
	swats[2].Interactable.Talk = 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_34'
	--병사2 (left, idle, prostrate) : 여… 여긴…
	swats[3].Interactable.Talk = 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_35'
	--병사3 (left, idle, prostrate) : 대, 대장님…
	swats[4].Interactable.Talk = 'lw_soldier_medevac_s1_36'

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
	self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()
end

return local_class

---@class LaboseWorldDemonGodAndrasGimmick : LaboseWorldDemonGodGimmickBase
local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodAndrasGimmick', gimmick_base)

function local_class:init()
	self.super:init()

	self.super.data = require('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/DemonGod/Gimmick/AndrasConstants')
	self.owner = 'demon_slayer'

	-- fx
	self.fx = {
		ice = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_iceflower')
		end,
		slash = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_demonslayer_slash')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end

			yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
		end
	}

	self.ice_effects = {}

	self.interactable_hashset = create_lua_hashset()

	self.labose_windpot_extension = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/DemonGod/Gimmick/LaboseWindPotExtension')

	---@type LaboseWorldDemonGodGimmickResetManager
	self.reset_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/DemonGod/Gimmick/GimmickResetManager')
end

function local_class:load_async()
	self.super:load_async()

	self.fx:load_all()

	self.labose_windpot_extension:create_virtual_field_object()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self:set_interactable()
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:set_noninteractable()

	self.super:exit()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.interactable_hashset:clear()

	for i = 1, #self.ice_effects do
		self.ice_effects[i]:Dispose()
	end

	self.ice_effects = nil
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event()
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.interactable_hashset:contains(e.Target) then
		-- 여기서는 변경이 거절되더라도 문제가 없으므로, try로 실행
		-- 또한 중복 루틴 체크도 겸하기에 enter 여부를 확인할 필요가 없음
		self.sp_manager:try_start_coroutine(self.convert_to_holdable_scene, self, e.Target)
	end
end

function local_class:convert_to_holdable_scene(target)
	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	self:convert_to_holdable_routine(target)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:convert_to_holdable_routine(fo)
	local andras = get_character(self.owner)

	self:remove_interactable(fo)

	fo.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PortableCrashBehaviour()
	fo.DamagedBehaviour.SuppressDamageReaction = true
	fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle

	self.reset_manager:set_creature_resettable(fo)

	scene_util.set_emotion(andras, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(andras, self, { name = 'twohand_attack', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_twohand_slash_01' })

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	local rotation = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToQuaternion(andras.Direction, unity_class.vector3.forward)

	local slash_effect = self.fx.slash():Instantiate(andras.Bounds.center, rotation, nil)

	if andras.Direction == direction_constants.left then
		slash_effect.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()

		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		heal_info.sender = fo
		heal_info.target = fo

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_ice_03')
	table.insert(self.ice_effects,
		self.fx:ice():Instantiate(fo.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, fo.transform))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(andras)
end

function local_class:convert_to_holdable_immediately(fo)
	self:remove_interactable(fo)

	fo.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PortableCrashBehaviour()
	fo.DamagedBehaviour.SuppressDamageReaction = true
	fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle

	self.reset_manager:set_creature_resettable(fo)

	local ice_effect = self.fx:ice()
			:Instantiate(fo.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, fo.transform)

	table.insert(self.ice_effects, ice_effect)
end

function local_class:add_interactable(fo)
	self.interactable_hashset:add(fo)

	if self.using then
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:set_interactable()
	for fo, _ in pairs(self.interactable_hashset) do
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:set_noninteractable()
	for fo, _ in pairs(self.interactable_hashset) do
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:remove_interactable(fo)
	self.interactable_hashset:remove(fo)

	fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

return local_class

---@class LaboseWorldDemonGodGimmickResetManager
local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodGimmickResetManager')

---@private
function local_class:init()
	-- reset_switch -> fo
	self.reset_infos = {}

	-- grid -> fo
	self.creature_grid_reset_info = {}

	-- fo -> { origin_pos, type, resettable }
	self.fo_infos = {}

	self.fo_type = {
		truck = 1,
		creature = 2
	}

	-- 얘는 스테이지에서 이미 로드하고 있어서, 다시 로드할 필요가 없음
	self.get_fx_reset = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
	end

	self:build_info()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent), 'on_reset_switch_turned_on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.reset_infos = nil
	self.fo_infos = nil
	self.creature_grid_reset_info = nil
end

---@private
function local_class:on_reset_switch_turned_on_event(e)
	local fo_hashset = self.reset_infos[e.SwitchObject]

	if fo_hashset ~= nil then
		self:reset_fos(fo_hashset, true)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	local fo_hashset = self.creature_grid_reset_info[e.CameraGrid.name]

	if fo_hashset ~= nil then
		self:reset_fos(fo_hashset, false)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

---@private
function local_class:build_info()
	local constants = require('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/DemonGod/Gimmick/GimmickResetConstants')

	for switch_name, truck_names in pairs(constants.truck) do
		for _, truck_name in pairs(truck_names) do
			local truck = get_field_object(truck_name)

			self:add_switch_reset_fo_info(truck, switch_name, self.fo_type.truck, true)
		end
	end

	for switch_name, creature_names in pairs(constants.creature) do
		for _, creature_name in pairs(creature_names) do
			local creature = get_character(creature_name)

			self:add_switch_reset_fo_info(creature, switch_name, self.fo_type.creature, false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_creature_resettable(creature)
	self:add_fo_info(creature, self.fo_type.creature, true)
end

---@private
function local_class:add_switch_reset_fo_info(fo, reset_switch_name, fo_type, resettable)
	local switch_fo = get_field_object(reset_switch_name)

	if self.reset_infos[switch_fo] == nil then
		self.reset_infos[switch_fo] = create_lua_hashset()
	end

	for _, fos in pairs(self.reset_infos) do
		fos:remove(fo)
	end

	self.reset_infos[switch_fo]:add(fo)

	self:add_fo_info(fo, fo_type, resettable)
end

---@private
function local_class:add_fo_info(fo, fo_type, resettable)
	if self.fo_infos[fo] == nil then
		self.fo_infos[fo] = {
			type = fo_type,
		}
	end

	self.fo_infos[fo].origin_pos = fo.Position
	self.fo_infos[fo].resettable = resettable

	if fo_type == self.fo_type.creature then
		local grid_name = self:get_contains_grid_name(self.fo_infos[fo].origin_pos)

		if grid_name ~= nil then
			if self.creature_grid_reset_info[grid_name] == nil then
				self.creature_grid_reset_info[grid_name] = create_lua_hashset()
			end

			for _, fos in pairs(self.creature_grid_reset_info) do
				fos:remove(fo)
			end

			self.creature_grid_reset_info[grid_name]:add(fo)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_contains_grid_name(position)
	local grid_index = field:GetCameraGridIdxOrMinusOne(position)

	if grid_index < 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local grid = field.CameraGrids[grid_index]

	return grid.name
end

---@private
function local_class:reset_fos(fo_hashset, play_sfx)
	for fo in pairs(fo_hashset) do
		local info = self.fo_infos[fo]

		-- 리셋하지 않음
		if vector_util.almost_close_to(fo.Position, info.origin_pos) or not info.resettable then
			goto continue
		end

		if info.type == self.fo_type.truck then
			self:reset_truck(fo, info.origin_pos)
		elseif info.type == self.fo_type.creature then
			if play_sfx then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '01_object_warp_01',
					parent = fo,
					type_priority = 'event'
				})
			end

			self:reset_creature(fo, info.origin_pos)
		end

		::continue::
	end
end

function local_class:reset_creature(fo)
	local fo_info = self.fo_infos[fo]

	self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(fo.Bounds.center)

	if fo.Holdable.IsHeld then
		character_util.clear_holdup_state(fo.Holdable.Holder, fo)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		message_system:SendSync(fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	end

	fo.Position = fo_info.origin_pos

	self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(fo.Bounds.center)
end

---@private
function local_class:reset_truck(fo)
	local fo_info = self.fo_infos[fo]

	self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(fo.Bounds.center)

	fo.Position = fo_info.origin_pos

	local collided_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(fo.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 1, collided_fos.Count do
		local collided_fo = collided_fos[i - 1]

		local collided_fo_info = self.fo_infos[collided_fo]

		-- 겹쳐진 오브젝트가 creature면 리셋 때려버림
		if collided_fo_info ~= nil and collided_fo_info.type == self.fo_type.creature and collided_fo_info.resettable then
			self:reset_creature(collided_fo, collided_fo_info.origin_pos)
		end
	end

	collided_fos:Dispose()

	self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(fo.Bounds.center)

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(fo, { 'truck_reset_done' }))

	end
}

---@class LaboseWorldDemonGodLaboseCreatureManager
local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodLaboseCreatureManager')

function local_class:init()
	self.creatures = setmetatable({
		---@type fun(this:self, key:any)
		contains = nil,
		---@type fun(this:self, key:any, value:table)
		add = nil,
		---@type fun(this:self, key:any)
		remove = nil
	}, {
		__index = {
			contains = function(this, key)
				return this[key] ~= nil
			end,
			add = function(this, key, value)
				if this:contains(key) then
					return
				end

				this[key] = value
			end,
			remove = function(this, key)
				this[key] = nil
			end
		}
	})

	self.detected_key = 'labose_creature_detect'

	self.in_detected_scene = false

	---@type LaboseWorldScreenplayManager
	self.sp_manager = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/Common/LaboseWorldScreenplayManager')

	---@type LaboseWorldDemonGodGimmickController
	self.gimmick_controller = nil

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.is_running = true

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self.is_running = false

	self.sp_manager = nil
	self.gimmick_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if not self.in_detected_scene and self.creatures:contains(e.Sender) and e:GetParamAt(0) == self.detected_key then
		self.in_detected_scene = true

		self.sp_manager:start_scene_delayed(self.detected_scene, self, e.Sender):Then(function()
			self.in_detected_scene = false
		end)

		return true
	end

	-- 감시 중인 애들 트럭에 치였을 때 동작
	if self.creatures:contains(e.Sender) and not self.creatures[e.Sender].is_dead
			and e:GetParamAt(0) == self:get_gimmick_controller():get_truck_crash_npc_event_key() then
		local info = self.creatures[e.Sender]

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01',
			parent = e.Sender,
			type_priority = 'event'
		})

		info.is_dead = true

		if info.death_data.type == 'air_spin' then
			self:execute_air_spine_dead(e.Sender, e:GetParamAt(1))

			return true

		elseif info.death_data.type == 'fly_fall' then
			start_coroutine(self.fly_fall_dead_routine, self, e.Sender, info.death_data)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.creatures:contains(e.FieldObject) then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarIgnoreTargetEvent.Create(e.FieldObject, false))

		character_util.set_locked_dir(e.FieldObject, direction_util.to_side_dir(e.FieldObject.Direction))
		scene_util.set_anim(e.FieldObject, self, 'prostrate')

		self:dispose_creature(e.FieldObject)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_running = false

	return true
end

function local_class:set_creature(character, position, direction, detect_reset_pos, detect_reset_dir, death_data, sight_data)
	if self.creatures:contains(character) then
		return
	end

	if death_data == nil then
		death_data = {
			type = 'air_spin'
		}
	end

	self.creatures:add(character, {
		reset_pos = detect_reset_pos,
		reset_dir = detect_reset_dir,
		death_data = death_data,
		is_dead = false,
	})

	if position ~= nil then
		character.Position = position
	end

	if direction ~= nil then
		character.Direction = character_util.get_direction(direction)
	end

	local sight_dist = lua_helper.get_value(sight_data, 'sight_dist', 4)
	local sight_angle = lua_helper.get_value(sight_data, 'sight_angle', 60)

	character.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController
			.Create(character, self.detected_key, sight_dist, sight_angle)
	character.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.9, 1, 0.9))

	if (character.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarIgnoreTargetEvent.Create(character, true))
	end
end

function local_class:set_creature_with_marker(character, setting_marker_name, reset_marker_name, death_data, sight_data)
	local reset_marker = field_util.get_marker(reset_marker_name)

	if setting_marker_name ~= nil then
		local setting_marker = field_util.get_marker(setting_marker_name)

		self:set_creature(character, setting_marker.position, setting_marker.direction,
				reset_marker.position, reset_marker.direction, death_data, sight_data)
	else
		self:set_creature(character, nil, nil,
				reset_marker.position, reset_marker.direction, death_data, sight_data)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_creature(character, just_dispose)
	if not self.creatures:contains(character) then
		return
	end

	self.creatures:remove(character)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(character)

	character_util.stop(character)

	just_dispose = lua_helper.get_or_default(just_dispose, false)

	if not just_dispose then
		-- 안드라스 기믹에 등록.
		self:get_gimmick_controller():add_creature_interactable(character)
	end
end

function local_class:fly_fall_dead_routine(character, death_data)
	local dist = death_data.fall_offset.magnitude
	local duration = dist / death_data.speed
	local target_rotation = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(death_data.spin_clockwise, -720, 720)

	character_util.set_active_state(character, 'visible')

	character_util.set_side_direction(character)
	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, 'prostrate')

	character_util.jump(character, death_data.fly_height, duration)
	character_util.spine_rotate(character, target_rotation, duration)

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, character.Position, character.Position + death_data.fall_offset,
			function(progress, cur_value)
				if not self.is_running then
					return false
				end

				character_util.set_position(character, cur_value)
			end)

	if not self.is_running then
		return
	end

	character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_active_state(character, 'enabled')

	self:dispose_creature(character)
end

function local_class:execute_air_spine_dead(character, dir_str)
	self:dispose_creature(character, true)

	local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(dir_str)

	character_util.air_spin(character, {
		offset = dir_vec * 3
	})
end

function local_class:reset_creature(character)
	if not self.creatures:contains(character) then
		return
	end

	message_system:Send(character, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
end

function local_class:detected_scene(detector)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.stop(detector)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	--감시시야 공통 발각 이벤트
	--리더(attack,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, { look_target = detector })
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--이동 간에 애니메이션(prostrate)를 0.2배속으로 재생
	scene_util.set_anim(detector, self, { name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = 1 })

	local jump_duration = 1.5

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	--발각한 역병괴물이 리더위치까지  1.5 초 간 y높이 1.5로 떠오르면서 이동
	character_util.jump(detector, 1.5, jump_duration)
	wp_util.move(detector, leader.Position, nil, jump_duration, { locked_dir = detector.Direction })

	--이동 시작과 동시에 페이드 아웃 1초간 재생
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	character_util.remove_anim(detector)

	character_util.stop(detector)

	--달려든 역병괴물은 다시 배치된다.
	self:reset_creature(detector)

	--이 후 지정된 위치에
	do
		local info = self.creatures[detector]

		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.position_party(info.reset_pos, info.reset_dir, 'linear')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--페이드 인으로 복귀한다.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
end

function local_class:is_registered(character)
	return self.creatures:contains(character)
end

function local_class:get_gimmick_controller()
	if self.gimmick_controller == nil then
		self.gimmick_controller = get_stage_event_controller('LaboseWorldDemonGodGimmickController')
	end

	return self.gimmick_controller
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodLaboseWindPotExtension')

function local_class:init()
	self.stage_ended = false
	self.owner = 'demon_slayer'

	self.vfo_table = {}

	self.strong_zone_name = 'strong_labose_zone_'
	self.weak_zone_name = 'weak_labose_zone_'

	self.data = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/Common/LaboseWindPotConstants.lua')['lw_sub_demongod']

	self.gimmick_controller = nil

	self.fog_enter_event_key = 'party_fog_collide_state'

	self.labose_fog_zone = {
		collided_zones = create_lua_hashset(),

		zone_names = create_lua_hashset(),

		add_collided_zone = function(this, zone_name)
			if not this.zone_names:contains(zone_name) then
				return false
			end

			return this.collided_zones:add(zone_name)
		end,

		remove_collided_zone = function(this, zone_name)
			if not this.zone_names:contains(zone_name) then
				return false
			end

			return this.collided_zones:remove(zone_name)
		end,

		collided_zone_count = function(this)
			return #this.collided_zones
		end,
	}

	for i = 1, self.data.weak_zone_count do
		self.labose_fog_zone.zone_names:add('weak_labose_zone_' .. i)
	end

	for i = 1, self.data.strong_zone_count do
		self.labose_fog_zone.zone_names:add('strong_labose_zone_' .. i)
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.iced_sfx_request_poses = {}

	self.on_fog_disabled_callback = function(pos)
		table.insert(self.iced_sfx_request_poses, pos)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.iced_sfx_request_poses = nil
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event()
	self.gimmick_controller = get_stage_event_controller('LaboseWindPotController')

	start_coroutine(self.update_routine, self)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if e.Info.sender.Name == self.owner and self.vfo_table[e.Info.target] ~= nil and
		e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile then
		self.gimmick_controller:labose_disappears(self.vfo_table[e.Info.target].zone, e.Info.target.Position,
				true, self.on_fog_disabled_callback)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) and
			self.labose_fog_zone:add_collided_zone(e.Zone.Name) then
		if self.labose_fog_zone:collided_zone_count() == 1 then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.fog_enter_event_key, 'enter' }))

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) and
			self.labose_fog_zone:remove_collided_zone(e.Zone.Name) then
		if self.labose_fog_zone:collided_zone_count() == 0 then
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.fog_enter_event_key, 'leave' }))

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.stage_ended = true
	self.vfo_table = nil
	self.gimmick_controller = nil
end

function local_class:create_virtual_field_object()
	self:create_virtual_field_object_routine(self.strong_zone_name, self.data.strong_zone_count)
	self:create_virtual_field_object_routine(self.weak_zone_name, self.data.weak_zone_count)
end

function local_class:create_virtual_field_object_routine(key, count)
	local xz_adder = 0.5
	for idx = 1, count do
		local zone_name = key .. idx
		local zone = field_util.get_zone(zone_name)

		if zone == nil then
			return
		end

		local min_x = zone.Bounds.min.x + xz_adder
		local min_z = zone.Bounds.min.z + xz_adder
		local max_x = zone.Bounds.max.x - xz_adder
		local max_z = zone.Bounds.max.z - xz_adder

		local start_pos = vector(min_x, 0, min_z)
		local end_pos = vector(max_x, 0, max_z)
		local cur_pos
		for i = math.floor(start_pos.x), math.floor(end_pos.x) do
			for j = math.floor(start_pos.z), math.floor(end_pos.z) do
				cur_pos = vector(i, 0, j)

				local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(cur_pos):GetHeightAt(cur_pos)
				cur_pos.y = floor_height

				local vfo = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
				vfo.Position = cur_pos
				vfo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 1))
				vfo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
				vfo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.HittableObstacle
				vfo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

				self.vfo_table[vfo] = {
					zone = zone_name
				}

			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	while not self.stage_ended do
		-- 한 프레임 안에 쌓인 요청 처리
		if not table_util.is_empty(self.iced_sfx_request_poses) then
			local sum = unity_class.vector3.zero
			local req_count = #self.iced_sfx_request_poses

			for i = 1, #self.iced_sfx_request_poses do
				sum = sum + self.iced_sfx_request_poses[i]

				self.iced_sfx_request_poses[i] = nil
			end

			-- 적당히 중간지점에 뿌려줌
			local target_pos = sum / req_count

			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '02_hit_ice_04',
				play_pos = target_pos,
				type_priority = 'gimmick',
				player_priority = 'object'
			})
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodPowerSourceSwitch')

function local_class:init()
	self.stage_ended = false
	self.owner = 'demon_operator'

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	self.power_source_table = {}
	self.off_time = 5.5

	start_coroutine(self.update_routine, self)
end

-- 업데이트 루틴
function local_class:update_routine()
	while not self.stage_ended do
		self:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 업데이트
function local_class:update(dt)
	for power_source, _ in pairs(self.power_source_table) do
		if self.power_source_table[power_source] < self.off_time then
			self.power_source_table[power_source] = self.power_source_table[power_source] + dt
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(power_source))
			self.power_source_table[power_source] = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if e.Info.sender.Name == self.owner and self.power_source_table[e.Info.target] == nil and
			e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile and
			lua_helper.type_compare(e.Info.target.Electrocutable, CS.Oak.PowerSourceElectrocutable) then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(e.Info.target))
		self.power_source_table[e.Info.target] = 0
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	self.stage_ended = true

	self.power_source_table = nil
end

function local_class:convert_to_hittable_obstacle(power_source_table)

	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class LaboseWorldDemonGodPymonGimmick : LaboseWorldDemonGodGimmickBase
local local_class = newclass('LaboseWorldDemonGodPymonGimmick', gimmick_base)

function local_class:init()
	self.super:init()

	self.super.data = require('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/DemonGod/Gimmick/PymonConstants')
	self.owner = 'demon_powergirl'
	self.pymon = get_character(self.owner)

	self.interactable_hashset = create_lua_hashset()
	self.interact_ignore_hashset = create_lua_hashset()

	self.npc_crash_event_key = 'truck_crashed_npc'

	self.moving_object = nil
	self.routine_cancelled = false

	self.move_diff_bounds_calculators = {
		right = function(fo, move_dist)
			local center = vector(fo.Bounds.max.x + move_dist / 2, fo.Position.y, fo.Bounds.center.z)
			local size = vector_util.get_0yz(fo.Bounds.size, move_dist)

			return CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size)
		end,
		left = function(fo, move_dist)
			local center = vector(fo.Bounds.min.x - move_dist / 2, fo.Position.y, fo.Bounds.center.z)
			local size = vector_util.get_0yz(fo.Bounds.size, move_dist)

			return CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size)
		end,
		up = function(fo, move_dist)
			local center = vector(fo.Bounds.center.x, fo.Position.y, fo.Bounds.max.z + move_dist / 2)
			local size = vector_util.get_xy0(fo.Bounds.size, move_dist)

			return CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size)
		end,
		down = function(fo, move_dist)
			local center = vector(fo.Bounds.center.x, fo.Position.y, fo.Bounds.min.z - move_dist / 2)
			local size = vector_util.get_xy0(fo.Bounds.size, move_dist)

			return CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size)
		end,
	}
end

function local_class:load_async()
	self.super:load_async()

	for i = 1, #self.data.interactable do
		local fo = get_field_object(self.data.interactable[i])
		self:add_interactable(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self:set_interactable()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.pymon.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) and
			self.pymon.FieldObjectController.CurrentState.Dashing then
		-- 충돌 바위 파괴
		local obj_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.pymon.Position, 1)

		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local obj = obj_list[i]

			if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
				damage_info.sender = self.pymon
				damage_info.target = obj
				damage_info.damage = 1

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end

		obj_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self:set_noninteractable()

	self.super:exit()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.pymon = nil
	self.moving_object = nil

	self.interactable_hashset:clear()
	self.interact_ignore_hashset:clear()

	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event()
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.interactable_hashset:contains(e.Target) and not self.interact_ignore_hashset:contains(e.Target) then
		self.sp_manager:try_start_coroutine(self.move_object_scene, self, e.Target)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if not self.routine_cancelled and
			self.interactable_hashset:contains(e.Sender) and
			e:GetParamAt(0) == 'truck_reset_done' and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.moving_object) then
		self.routine_cancelled = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:move_object_scene(fo)
	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	self:move_object_routine(fo)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

-- 물체 움직이는 연출 루틴
function local_class:move_object_routine(fo)
	self.moving_object = fo
	self.routine_cancelled = false

	local anim_duration = 0.5
	local routine_start_time = unity_class.time.time

	scene_util.set_anim(self.pymon, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01' })

	do
		local hit_delay = 0.3
		local start_time = unity_class.time.time

		while unity_class.time.time - start_time < hit_delay and not self.routine_cancelled do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	if self.routine_cancelled then
		self.moving_object = nil
		self.routine_cancelled = false

		character_util.remove_anim(self.pymon)

		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	self:move_object(fo)

	while unity_class.time.time - routine_start_time < anim_duration and not self.routine_cancelled do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.pymon)

	self.moving_object = nil
	self.routine_cancelled = false
end

-- 물체를 한 방향으로 움직이는 함수
function local_class:move_object(fo)
	local blocked = false
	local speed = 8

	local dir = nil
	local dir_str = nil

	if self:is_side_dir(fo) then
		if self.pymon.Position.x < fo.Bounds.center.x then
			dir = vector(1, 0, 0)
			dir_str = 'right'
		else
			dir = vector(-1, 0, 0)
			dir_str = 'left'
		end
	else
		if self.pymon.Position.z < fo.Bounds.center.z then
			dir = vector(0, 0, 1)
			dir_str = 'up'
		else
			dir = vector(0, 0, -1)
			dir_str = 'down'
		end
	end

	local get_move_diff_bounds = self.move_diff_bounds_calculators[dir_str]

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_car_leaving_03',
		parent = fo,
		type_priority = 'event',
		fade_in_time = 0.5
	})

	-- 해당 트럭에 리셋이 발생하면(특정 CustomStageEvent 수신되면) 루틴을 중지
	while not blocked and not self.routine_cancelled do
		local move_dist = speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local move_diff_bounds = get_move_diff_bounds(fo, move_dist)
		local move = dir * move_dist
		local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(move_diff_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local obj = obj_list[i]

			if obj.Name ~= fo.Name then
				if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour) or
						lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) then
					if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) then
						obj.DamagedBehaviour.RockBreakSfxHandleName = '02_car_crashed_01'
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
					damage_info.sender = fo
					damage_info.target = obj
					damage_info.damage = 1

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				elseif lua_helper.type_compare(obj.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) or
						lua_helper.type_compare(obj.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.PortableCrashBehaviour) then
					blocked = true

				elseif lua_helper.type_compare(obj, CS.Oak.Character) then
					message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(obj, { self.npc_crash_event_key, dir_str }))

				elseif lua_helper.type_compare(obj.CrashBehaviour, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchCrashBehaviour) then
					message_system:SendSync(obj, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(fo))
				end
			end
		end

		obj_list:Dispose()

		if blocked then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(fo, dir, speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		else
			fo.Position = fo.Position + move
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:add_interactable(fo)
	self.interactable_hashset:add(fo)

	if self.using then
		self:set_truck_interactable(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:set_interactable()
	for fo, _ in pairs(self.interactable_hashset) do
		self:set_truck_interactable(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:set_noninteractable()
	for fo, _ in pairs(self.interactable_hashset) do
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:add_interact_ignore_object(fo)
	if not self.interactable_hashset:contains(fo) then
		return
	end

	self.interact_ignore_hashset:add(fo)
end

function local_class:remove_interact_ignore_object(fo)
	self.interact_ignore_hashset:remove(fo)
end

function local_class:set_truck_interactable(fo)
	fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.DirectionLimitInteractable.Create()
	if self:is_side_dir(fo) then
		fo.Interactable.Up = false
		fo.Interactable.Down = false
	else
		fo.Interactable.Left = false
		fo.Interactable.Right = false
	end
end

function local_class:is_side_dir(fo)
	local angle = fo.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.y
	return float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 0) or float_util.almost_close_to(angle, 180)
end

return local_class

--캐릭터를 화면 앞으로 커지면서 날리는 연출
function local_class:screen_out_fly_away_async(fo, target_pos, duration, dir, rotate, scale)
	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, dir * rotate * 360, duration + 0.2)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one * scale, duration)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fo, false)

	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local end_pos = target_pos

	fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 1000)

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, end_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * end_pos.y
		fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(cur_value, y)
	end)

	--초기화
	fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)

	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fo, true)

	for npc_name, info in pairs(data) do

		character_util.set_direction(npc, info.dir)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, info.anim)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, info.emo)
		npc.Interactable.Talk = info.oneline

		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(info.marker_name)
		npc.Position = pos + info.offset
	end

	quest_icon_util.pre_load()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:jar_pixy()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.first_zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'alexander_s1_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_zone_enter
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'alex_s1_sense_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_zone_enter
		start_coroutine(self.sense_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:sense_enter_scene()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()

	--항아리 픽시 (left,idle,embarrassed) : 어~이! 어~이!! 거기 누가 있는가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s1_1', skip = false })

	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact

	character_util.add_listener(jar_pixy, self.controller)

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(jar_pixy)
end

function local_class:interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	quest_icon_util.remove(jar_pixy)

	party_util.align_to_target(jar_pixy, 'right', 0.5, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(jar_pixy)

	if self.is_first then
		self.is_first = false
		--항아리 픽시 (left,idle,idle) : 오오…! 지나가는 길에 미안하지만 제발 나 좀 여기서 꺼내주게…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_alexander_s1_2', skip = true })
	end

	-- 선택지
	do
		-- 퀘스트 수락 UI
		local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.cs_controller.QuestId, false)
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		if accepted then
			floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party.Leader, self.cs_controller.QuestSpec.QuestName, 0)

			self.current_state = self.states.after_interact

			-- 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,idle) : 이렇게 친절할 수가… 이 은혜는 평생 잊지 않겠네!
			scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, { name = 'idle', loop = false })
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					nil,
					nil,
					{ key = 'pw_alexander_s1_4', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_relate_event(jar_pixy, self.controller)

			self.controller:activate_quest(0)
		else
			--플레이어 (left, idle, cross_arm)
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cross_arm')

			-- 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,idle) : 가지 말게! 날 도와주면 반짝이는 걸 주겠네!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					nil,
					nil,
					{ key = 'pw_alexander_s1_3', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:enter_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	camera_util.move(jar_pixy.Position, 0.5)

	party_util.align_party(jar_pixy.Position + vector(4, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'linear')

	do
		local wait = true

		start_coroutine(function()
			scene_util.set_anim_async(jar_pixy, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 3, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' })
			wait = false
		end)

		--항아리 픽시 (right,idle,jingak) : 제발 좀…!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_alexander_s1_0_1', skip = true })

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	do
		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

		--A 지점에서 우측 2칸 0.5초에 걸쳐 (right,idle,run) 자세로 이동.
		character_util.remove_anim(jar_pixy)
		wp_util.move_async(jar_pixy, jar_pixy.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				nil, 0.5, { run = true })

		dash_sfx:Stop()
		dash_sfx = nil
	end

	--목표 지점에 도달했을 때 항아리 픽시 (right,scared,prostrate)
	--자세로 0.3초간 왼쪽으로 0.5칸 easeoutquad 이동
	scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, 'prostrate')
	wp_util.move_async(jar_pixy, jar_pixy.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	--넘어짐과 동시에 Damage Squish, Red pulse 출력
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(jar_pixy)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(jar_pixy)

	--넘어짐과 동시에 항아리 픽시 하단에 fx_hit 출력
	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(jar_pixy.Position)

	--항아리 픽시 (right,scared,prostrate) 자세로 1초 대기 후
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')

	-- mario jump로 일어남.
	character_util.mario_jump_async(jar_pixy, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--0.3초 대기 후 항아리 픽시 (right,idle,dualgun_attack) 자세로 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(jar_pixy, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, 'dualgun_attack')

	--항아리 픽시 (right,idle,dualgun_attack) : 제발 좀 빠져라 제발!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s1_0_2', skip = true })

	--대사 후 다시 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,jingak) 자세로 전환하며 1초 유지.
	scene_util.set_anim_async(jar_pixy, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 2, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(jar_pixy, 'left', false)

	--리더 캐릭터 question 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

	--카메라 스케일 줌 인 (2.5,0.3)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 0.3)

	--항아리 픽시 (left,idle, gauntlet_boong_attack_ready) 1회 수행 후
	scene_util.set_anim_async(jar_pixy, self, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack_ready', loop = false, keep_anim = true, scale = 0.5 })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--gauntlet_boong_attack 자세 1회 수행후 마지막 동작(0.333초)에서 멈춘 상태로 점프
	scene_util.set_anim_async(jar_pixy, self, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack', loop = false, scale = 0.5, keep_anim = true })

	--바로 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,gauntlet_boong_attack) 상태로 C 지점까지 이동
	do
		start_coroutine(function()
			local fx_pos = jar_pixy.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			--항아리 픽시 위로 FX_Common_SmokeScreen 생성
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
			self.fx:smoke():Instantiate(fx_pos)
		end)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_01')

		wp_util.move_async(jar_pixy, jar_pixy.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0), nil,
				0.3)

		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	end

	--벽에 캐릭터가 105도 각도로 박혀 있습니다.
	character_util.spine_rotate(jar_pixy, 105, 0)

	scene_util.set_direction(jar_pixy, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, { name = 'fix_embarrassed' })

	--리더, 파티원 (left,surprise,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')

	--1초간 플레이어 포커스로 카메라 이동
	--동시에 1초간 카메라 줌 기본값으로 전환
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	self.controller:set_npc_by_data(self.pre_npc_data)
end
