local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldAlexanderSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = PixyWorldAlexander @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldAlexanderController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'pixyworld_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_interact = 2,
		after_interact = 3,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact

	--npc
	self.npc = {
		jar_pixy = function()
			return get_character('alex_jar_pixy')
		end,
	}

	--set npc data
	self.s1_npc_data = {
		alex_jar_pixy = {
			dir = 'left',
			anim = { name = 'idle', loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false },
			emo = 'idle',
			marker_name = 'alex_s1_pixy_pos',
			offset = vector(-2, 0, 0),
		},
	}

	--fx
	self.fx = setmetatable({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.is_first = true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()

	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:jar_pixy()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	quest_icon_util.remove(jar_pixy)

	-- 0.5초에 거쳐 항아리 픽시 앞으로 파티원 캐릭터 left 방향을 바라보며, 0.5타일 간격으로 바짝 붙기.
	wp_util.move_async(leader, jar_pixy.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'left' })

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'shoot', loop = false })

	character_util.shake(leader, 0.01, 99999)
	character_util.shake(jar_pixy, 0.01, 99999)

	-- 1차 QTE
	-- 종류 : 스와이프 (→) 2회
	-- 제한 시간 : 각 5초
	do
		local qte_start = true
		local tap_reaction_wait = false
		local pixy_move = false
		local success = false
		local time_passed = 0
		local change_next_duration = false
		local qte_data = {
			{
				key = 'tap',
				type = 3,
				data = {
					duration = 5,
					tap_count_callback = function(count)
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

						if count == 1 then
							--항아리 픽시 0.04값으로 shake 시작
							character_util.shake(jar_pixy, 0.04, 99999)

							--플레이어 0.04값으로 shake 시작
							character_util.shake(leader, 0.04, 99999)

							character_util.remove_anim(leader)
							scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'shoot', loop = true })
						end
					end,
				},
				callback_func = function()
					change_next_duration = true
				end,
			},
			{
				key = 'swipe',
				type = 'right',
				data = { duration = 5 },
				callback_func = function()
					--동시에 플레이어 (left,damaged,shoot) 지속
					scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')

					-- 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,idle) : 조금만 더 하면 될 것 같다네!
					scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
							{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
							nil,
							nil,
							{ key = 'pw_alexander_s1_9', skip = true })

					time_passed = 0
				end,
			},
			{
				key = 'tap',
				type = 3,
				data = {
					duration = 5,
					tap_count_callback = function(count)
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

						if count == 1 then
							start_coroutine(function()
								tap_reaction_wait = true
								camera_util.shake(0.03, 99999)

								--플레이어 (left,damaged,rifle_reload) 자세로 1초 대기
								wait_for_sec(1)

								--이후 플레이어 (left,mad,sniper_shoot) 1회 수행하며, 0.5초 동작에서 멈춤
								scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'mad')
								scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false })

								wp_util.move_async(jar_pixy, jar_pixy.Position + vector(0.15, 0, 0),
										nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'left' })

								tap_reaction_wait = false
								pixy_move = true
							end)

						end
					end,
					callback_func = function()
						change_next_duration = true
					end,
				},
			},
			{
				key = 'swipe',
				type = 'up',
				data = { duration = 5 },
			},
		}

		start_coroutine(function()
			while qte_start do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end)

		for _, info in ipairs(qte_data) do
			local current_data = info.data

			if change_next_duration then
				current_data.duration = current_data.duration - time_passed
				change_next_duration = false
			end

			success = qte_play_util[info.key](info.type, current_data)

			if not success then
				break
			elseif info.callback_func ~= nil then
				info.callback_func()
			end
		end

		while tap_reaction_wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		qte_start = false

		if success then
			camera_util.cancel_shake()

			character_util.stop_shake(jar_pixy)
			character_util.stop_shake(leader)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')

			--플레이어 (left,burning,sniper_shot)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'burning' })

			wait_for_sec(1)

			--동시에 0.5초에 거쳐 카메라 항아리 픽시 포커스로 전환 + 카메라 크기 2로 줌인
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, 0.5)

			--항아리 픽시 (left,idle,cast2) : 어… 어어…?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(jar_pixy, {
				key = 'pw_alexander_s1_11', skip = false,
			})

			--쉐이크 시작 0.1초 후
			wait_for_sec(0.1)

			character_util.stop_shake(jar_pixy)
			character_util.stop_shake(leader)

			-- 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,idle) : [shout] 으아아악!!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(jar_pixy, {
				key = 'pw_alexander_s1_12',
				skip = false,
				type_speed = 0,
				bubble_type = 'shout',
				bubble_direction = 'none',
				viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.75),
			})

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

			--항아리 픽시 위로 FX_Common_SmokeScreen 출력.
			self.fx:smoke():Instantiate(jar_pixy.Position)

			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
			camera_util.resize_to_default(1)

			--항아리 픽시 뽑힘과 동시에 플레이어 (left,damaged,damaged) 상태로 y축 최대 1.5 높이까지 올라가며, 우측 2타일로 1초에 거쳐 포물선 이동.
			local wait = true
			start_coroutine(function()

				scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'damaged')

				character_util.jump(leader, 1.5, 1)
				wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), nil,
						1, { locked_dir = 'left', y_mode = 'flying' })

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

				--y축이 0이 되면 기사 (left,damaged,hurt)상태로 전환하며, 하단에 fx_hit,fx_lasthit 동시 출력
				self.fx:hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)
				self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)

				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'hurt')

				wait = false
			end)

			character_util.set_direction(jar_pixy, 'down')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(jar_pixy, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

			--회전하면 화면 앞으로 날라가는 연출
			self.controller:screen_out_fly_away_async(jar_pixy, jar_pixy.Position + vector(10, 10, -12), 1, 1, 2.5, 4)

			self.fx:hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)

			while wait do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

			--1초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.shake_and_wakeup(leader, 'left', 1, nil, true)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			character_util.remove_relate_event(jar_pixy, self.controller)

			self.controller:progress_section()
		else
			scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, 'fix_embarrassed')

			camera_util.cancel_shake()

			--화면 쉐이크 (0.1,0.3)
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

			-- QTE 실패 연출
			character_util.stop_shake(jar_pixy)
			character_util.stop_shake(leader)

			if pixy_move then
				character_util.shake(jar_pixy, 0.015, 0.3)
				wp_util.move(jar_pixy, jar_pixy.Position + vector(-0.15, 0, 0),
						nil, 0.3, { locked_dir = 'left' })
			end

			--플레이어 (left,damaged,damaged) 상태로 y축 최대 1.5 높이까지 올라가며, 우측 2타일로 1초에 거쳐 포물선 이동.
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'damaged')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_02')

			character_util.jump(leader, 1.5, 0.3)
			wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), nil,
					0.3, { locked_dir = 'left', y_mode = 'flying' })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

			--y축이 0이 되면 기사 (left,damaged,hurt)상태로 전환하며, 하단에 fx_hit,fx_lasthit 동시 출력
			self.fx:hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)
			self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)

			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'hurt')

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

			-- 리더 캐릭터 (left,tired,hurt) + sweat 이모티콘 출력
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'sweat')

			wait_for_sec(1)

			-- 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,salute) : 거의 다 된 것 같았는데 아쉽군…!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.remove_anim(jar_pixy)
			scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, { name = 'idle', loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
					{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
					nil,
					nil,
					{ key = 'pw_alexander_s1_13', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(jar_pixy)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	self.controller:set_npc_by_data(self.s1_npc_data)
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(self.npc:jar_pixy())
	character_util.add_listener(self.npc:jar_pixy(), self.controller)
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.npc:jar_pixy(), 105, 0)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldAlexanderSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = PixyWorldAlexander @
		Comment = @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldAlexanderController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'pixyworld_3'

	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_interact = 2,
		after_interact = 3,
		first_hit = 4,
		first_hit_end = 5,
		second_hit = 6,
		second_hit_end = 7,
		third_hit = 8,
		section_end = 11,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact

	--npc
	self.npc = {
		jar_pixy = function()
			return get_character('alex_jar_pixy')
		end,
	}

	--set npc data
	self.s2_npc_data = {
		alex_jar_pixy = {
			dir = 'left',
			anim = 'prostrate',
			emo = 'idle',
			marker_name = 'alex_s2_pixy_pos',
			offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		},
	}

	self.stage_end = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_alexander', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc:jar_pixy() },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:jar_pixy()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_interact
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.stage_end = true
	return true
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.section_end and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'alexander_s2_move_zone') then
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('sub_alexander')
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.states.section_end and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'alexander_s2_move_zone') then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_alexander', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc:jar_pixy() },
		})
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if (self.current_state == self.states.first_hit or
			self.current_state == self.states.second_hit) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.npc:jar_pixy()) and
			e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap then
		self.current_state = self.current_state + 1
		start_coroutine(self.damage_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.third_hit and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.npc:jar_pixy()) and
			e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap then
		self.current_state = self.states.section_end
		sp_util.start_scene(self.section_end_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	-- 플레이어, 0.5초에 거쳐 이미지와 같이 정렬 (right,idle,idle)
	party_util.align_to_target(jar_pixy, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	--플레이어 (right,attack,release 2회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	do
		local wait = true

		--notice 이모티콘 출력과 동시에
		start_coroutine(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(jar_pixy, nil, 'notice')
			wait = false
		end)

		-- 항아리 픽시 mario jump로 일어나 (left,idle,idle) 자세
		character_util.shake_and_wakeup(jar_pixy, 'left', 1, nil, true)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,idle) : 오, 자네인가! 여기까지 따라와주다니… 이거 정말 감동이구만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s2_1', skip = true })

	--항아리 픽시 (left,idle,cast2) : 그보다 이 항아리를 깨기 위해 벽에 박았던 건데 아직 그대로군… 아무래도 더 큰 충격을 가해야 할 것 같아.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s2_2', skip = true })

	--플레이어 (right,surprise,cast2) 자세로 일반 점프 1회
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'cast2')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_player_jump_01')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--항아리 픽시 (left,idle,cast2) : 하하! 너무 걱정 말게, 자네 생각보다 내가 아주 튼튼하거든!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast2' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s2_3', skip = true })

	self.current_state = self.states.first_hit

--fo 폭탄
function local_class:damage_routine()

function local_class:section_end_scene()

4123:
local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldAlexanderSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = PixyWorldAlexander @
		Comment = @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldAlexanderController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'pixyworld_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_interact = 2,
		interacting = 3,
		after_interact = 4,
		holdable_pixy = 5,
		throw_end = 6,
		section_end = 9,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact

	--npc
	self.npc = {
		jar_pixy = function()
			return get_character('alex_jar_pixy')
		end,
		jar_pixy_small = function()
			return get_character('alex_jar_pixy_small')
		end,
	}

	--fx
	self.fx = setmetatable({
		smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen')
		end,
		water_splash_in = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in')
		end,
		water_splash_out = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_out')
		end,
		reset = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	--set npc data
	self.s3_npc_data = {
		alex_jar_pixy = {
			dir = 'left',
			anim = 'hurt',
			emo = 'idle',
			marker_name = 'alex_s3_pixy_pos',
			offset = vector(0, 0, 0),
		},
	}

	self.brazier = {
		prefix = 'alex_brazier_',

		count = 4,

		active = { false, false, false, false },

		---@param this self
		---@param index number
		---@param active boolean
		set_active = function(this, index, active)
			this.active[index] = active
		end,

		---@param this self
		all_active = function(this)
			for num = 1, this.count do
				if not this.active[num] then
					return false
				end
			end

			return true
		end,

		---@param this self
		get = function(this, index)
			return get_field_object(this.prefix .. index)
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param action "function(index, npc) end"
		foreach = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				action(i, this:get(i))
			end
		end,
	}

	self.damage = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent), 'on_brazier_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_alexander', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc:jar_pixy() },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:jar_pixy()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.interacting
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state <= self.states.holdable_pixy and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'alexander_s3_enter_zone') then
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('sub_alexander')
	end

	if self.current_state < self.states.holdable_pixy and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'alex_throw_ignore_zone_1') then
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('sub_alexander', {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc:jar_pixy() },
		})
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.holdable_pixy then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'alex_throw_ignore_zone_1') then
			start_coroutine(self.zone_out_scene, self, e.Zone.Name)
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.npc:jar_pixy(), 'alex_throw_ignore_zone_1') then
			start_coroutine(self.reset_npc, self, self.npc:jar_pixy())
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.npc:jar_pixy(), 'alex_throw_ignore_zone_2') then
			start_coroutine(self.reset_npc, self, self.npc:jar_pixy())
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.npc:jar_pixy(), 'alex_throw_ignore_zone_3') then
			start_coroutine(self.reset_npc, self, self.npc:jar_pixy())
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.npc:jar_pixy(), 'alex_throw_ignore_zone_4') then
			start_coroutine(self.reset_npc, self, self.npc:jar_pixy())
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_brazier_on_off_event(e)
	for index = 1, self.brazier.count do
		local fo = self.brazier:get(index)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, fo) then
			self.brazier:set_active(index, e.IsTurningOn)

			if self.current_state == self.states.after_interact then
				if e.IsTurningOn then
					start_coroutine(self.brazier_on_scene, self, index)
				else
					start_coroutine(self.brazier_off_scene, self)
				end
			end

			return true
		end

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')

	--항아리 픽시 mario jump로 일어나 (left,ilde,cross_arm) 자세
	character_util.mario_jump_async(jar_pixy, 'left')

	scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })

	--플레이어는 0.5초에 거쳐 이미지와 같이 정렬.
	party_util.align_to_target(jar_pixy, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	--플레이어 (rignt,attack,release 2회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	-- 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,cast2) : 오, 자네 왔나!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast2' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s3_1', skip = true })

	-- 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,cast2) : 이거 단순히 충격을 가해서 되는 게 아닌 것 같아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast2' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s3_2', skip = true })

	-- 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,question 유지) : 발상의 전환이 필요할 것 같은데….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'question', keep = true },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s3_3', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_relate_event(jar_pixy, self.controller)

	self.current_state = self.states.after_interact

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.holdable_pixy and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:jar_pixy()) then
		start_coroutine(self.throw_routine, self, e.Target)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.holdable_pixy and
			not self.damage and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, self.npc:jar_pixy()) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.npc:jar_pixy()) and
			e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee then
		self.damage = true
	end
end

function local_class:throw_routine(fo)
	while not lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.damage = false
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	while not self.damage do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--조건
	if self:check_water(fo) then
		message_system:SendSync(fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		self.current_state = self.states.throw_end
		self.npc:jar_pixy().Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = nil
		sp_util.start_scene(self.throw_end_scene, self)
	end

	self.damage = false
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
end

--zone을 이용하여 fo가 물에 떨어졌는지 체크
function local_class:check_water(fo)
	local result = false

	--접근 가능 구역
	result = zone_util.contains_fo('alex_throw_able_zone', fo)

	--접근 제외 구역
	if zone_util.contains_fo('alex_throw_unable_zone_1', fo, true) or
			zone_util.contains_fo('alex_throw_unable_zone_2', fo, true) or
			zone_util.contains_fo('alex_throw_unable_zone_2', fo, true) or
			zone_util.contains_fo('alex_throw_ignore_zone_1', fo, true) or
			zone_util.contains_fo('alex_throw_ignore_zone_2', fo, true) or
			zone_util.contains_fo('alex_throw_ignore_zone_3', fo, true) or
			zone_util.contains_fo('alex_throw_ignore_zone_4', fo, true) then
		result = false
	end

	return result
end

function local_class:zone_out_scene(zone_name)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	sp_util.enter_scene({ release_hold = false })

	--들려 있는지
	if jar_pixy.Holdable.IsHeld then
		--항아리 픽시 : 나 죽어!! 이러다 픽시 통구이가 될 거야!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(jar_pixy, 'pw_alexander_s3_9')
	else
		--항아리 픽시 : 날 두고 어디로 간 건가!! 제발 가지 말게!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(jar_pixy, 'pw_alexander_s3_10')
	end

	--들어온 방향반대로 0.5칸 이동
	local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone_name, leader, 'right', 1)

	wp_util.move_async(leader, return_pos, nil, 0.5)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:reset_npc(fo)
	local reset_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('alex_s3_pixy_pos')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_object_warp_01')
	self.fx:reset():Instantiate(fo.Position)

	--던져지는 상태 종료
	message_system:SendSync(fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

	fo.Position = reset_pos
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.fx:reset():Instantiate(fo.Position)
end

function local_class:brazier_on_scene(index)
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(jar_pixy)
	character_util.remove_anim(jar_pixy)

	--모든 횟불 켜짐.
	if self.brazier:all_active() then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.all_active_routine, self)
	else
		if index == 1 then
			--항아리가 뜨거워지는 게 느껴져!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(jar_pixy, { key = 'pw_alexander_s3_5', skip = false })
		elseif index == 2 then
			--으윽, 조금만 더 달궈주면 될 것 같은데!
			scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, 'sing')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(jar_pixy, { key = 'pw_alexander_s3_6', skip = false })
		elseif index == 3 then
			--방금 깨지는 소리가…!
			scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, 'release')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(jar_pixy, { key = 'pw_alexander_s3_7', skip = false })
		elseif index == 4 then
			-- 아뜨뜨!!
			scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, 'embarrassed')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(jar_pixy, { key = 'pw_alexander_s3_8', skip = false })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:all_active_routine()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()
	local jump_wait = true

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	--횃불 교체
	local num = 1
	self.brazier:foreach(function(index, fo)
		local obj = get_field_object('alex_brazier_finish_' .. num)
		obj.Position = fo.Position
		num = num + 1
		fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end)

	camera_util.move_async(jar_pixy.Position, 1)

	self.current_state = self.states.holdable_pixy
	character_util.add_color(jar_pixy, 'fade_color', unity_class.color.red, 0.5, 1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		for i = 1, 3 do
			character_util.normal_jump_async(jar_pixy, true)
		end
		jump_wait = false
	end)

	--너무 뜨거워! 이 작전은 실패야! 제발 나 좀 식혀주게!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, 'cast2')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jar_pixy, { key = 'pw_alexander_s3_15', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, 'embarrassed')

	while jump_wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	character_util.stop(jar_pixy)

	jar_pixy.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	character_util.clear_holdup_state(jar_pixy.Holdable.Holder, jar_pixy)
	jar_pixy.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_hit_npc_01'

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:brazier_off_scene()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()

	--항아리 픽시 (left,idle,idle) : 으으, 조금만 더 하면 될 것 같은데…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(jar_pixy, 'pw_alexander_s3_4', false)
end

function local_class:throw_end_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local jar_pixy = self.npc:jar_pixy()
	local jar_pixy_small = self.npc:jar_pixy_small()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	-- 항아리 픽시 입수하며 fx_common_water_splash_in 이펙트 적용
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_float_01')
	self.fx:water_splash_in():Instantiate(jar_pixy.Position)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(jar_pixy, active_state_type.disabled)

	-- 입수 후 2초 뒤
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	-- 튀어 오르며 fx_common_water_splash_out 이펙트 적용
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_water_01')
	self.fx:water_splash_out():Instantiate(jar_pixy.Position)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(jar_pixy, active_state_type.enabled)
	scene_util.set_direction(jar_pixy, 'left', false)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		local duration = distance / speed

		scene_util.set_direction(jar_pixy, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy, self, 'get')

		character_util.spine_rotate(jar_pixy, 360 * duration, duration)

		character_util.spine_rotate(jar_pixy_small, 180, 0)
		wp_util.move_async(jar_pixy_small, default_pos + vector(1, 0, -3), speed)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

		self.fx:smoke():Instantiate(jar_pixy_small.Position)

		--동시에 카메라 쉐이크 0.15값으로 0.3초
		camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)

		scene_util.set_anim(jar_pixy_small, self, 'prostrate')
		character_util.spine_rotate(jar_pixy_small, 0, 0)

		--작은 항아리 픽시가 목표값에 도달하면 플레이어가 항아리 픽시 방향으로 전환
		character_util.look_at(leader, jar_pixy_small)
	end

	--작은 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,prostrate) 자세로 0.01값으로 1초간 쉐이크.

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jar_pixy_small)

	character_util.mario_jump_async(jar_pixy_small, 'left')

	--작은 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,success) : 앗, 드디어 빠졌다! 드디어 빠졌어! 야호!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy_small, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },

			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s3_11', skip = true })

	--작은 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,clap) : 이제야 본 모습으로 돌아왔군. 이게 다 자네 덕분이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy_small, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'clap' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s3_12', skip = true })

	--작은 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,idle) : 이건 나를 위해 애써준 자네를 위한 보답이라네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy_small, self,

	--스타피스, 이미지와 같은 위치에 제공.
	local star_piece = get_field_object('alexander_star_piece')

	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, jar_pixy_small.Bounds.center, jar_pixy_small.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--작은 항아리 픽시 (left,idle,release 2회) : 한껏 가벼워진 몸으로 떠나볼까!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jar_pixy_small, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },

			{ key = 'pw_alexander_s3_14', skip = true })

	--작은 항아리 픽시, 이미지와 같은 경로로 2.5초에 걸쳐 그리드 밖으로 퇴장.
	do

		dash_sfx = nil

	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	self.fx.create_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.in_game_data.is_playing = false

	if self.event_range.inst ~= nil then
		self.event_range:dispose()
	end

	self:detach_count_ui()
	self:detach_image_ui()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(426)

	if self.in_game_data.is_playing and not self.in_game_data.player.is_in_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_clever_ogre_quit_zone') then
		self.in_game_data.player.is_in_zoner = true

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

			self:mini_game_surrender_scene()
		end)

		return true
	elseif quest_progress ~= nil and not quest_progress.IsComplete and
			not self.in_game_data.is_playing and not self.in_game_data.player.is_in_zone and
			e.Zone.Name == 'sub_clever_ogre_reset_zone' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		self.in_game_data.player.is_in_zone = true

		sp_util.start_scene(self.blocked_entry_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.in_game_data.is_playing and not self.in_game_data.is_brazier_zone_out and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.brazier, 'sub_clever_ogre_reset_zone') then
		self.in_game_data.is_brazier_zone_out = true

		start_coroutine(self.brazier_reset_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.in_game_data.is_playing and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, leader) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.brazier) then
		self.in_game_data.player.current_state = self.in_game_data.player.state.hold_up

		start_coroutine(self.player_hold_up_routine, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.in_game_data.is_playing and
			self.in_game_data.player.current_state == self.in_game_data.player.state.hold_up and
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then

		start_coroutine(self.player_throw_routine, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

--플레이어 화로 드는 상태 적용
function local_class:player_hold_up_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--액션 버튼 변조
	get_party_leader().FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(leader, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Throw)

	local throw_button_action = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Throw
	local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetUIByKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton, leader)

	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction = throw_button_action
	action_button:RefreshButton(throw_button_action, false)
end

--화로 들고 있을 경우 던지는 루틴
function local_class:player_throw_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.in_game_data.player.current_state == self.in_game_data.player.state.hold_up then
		self.in_game_data.player.current_state = self.in_game_data.player.state.idle

		command_util.publish_throw(leader, self.brazier,
				direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(leader.Direction), leader.Position, 3, true)

		--오버라이드 액션 버튼 리셋
		local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
		action_button.OverridenButtonAction = nil
	end
end

function local_class:brazier_reset_event()
	self:player_throw_routine()

	local brazier = self.brazier
	local reset_pos = self.const[self.in_game_data.current_level].brazier_pos

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_object_warp_01')
	message_system:SendSync(brazier, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

	brazier.Position = reset_pos

	self.in_game_data.is_brazier_zone_out = false
end

function local_class:reset_gimmicks_in_zone()
	local zone_bounds = field_util.get_zone('sub_clever_ogre_reset_zone').Bounds
	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(zone_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for idx = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = obj_list[idx]
		if lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BarrelFieldObjectBehaviour) or
				lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BombFieldObjectBehaviour) then
			message_system:Send(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:puzzle_settings(level)
	-- 현재 게임 레벨 저장
	self.in_game_data.current_level = level

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5.7, 0)
	--화로 위치 세팅
	self.brazier = self.get_brazier()
	self.brazier.Position = self.const[level].brazier_pos

	-- 캐릭터 세팅
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	local hp_const = self.const[level].player.hp
	self.in_game_data.player.hp = hp_const

	-- hp 옆에 고블린 이미지 세팅
	self:attach_image_ui(leader)
	self:attach_count_ui(leader, hp_const)

	local start_pos = self.const[level].player.start_pos
	leader.Position = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 3)

	camera_util.move(start_pos, 0)
	--럼: (right, idle, idle)
	local clever_ogre = self.get_clever_ogre()
	scene_util.set_direction(clever_ogre, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(clever_ogre, self)

	--꼬마 공주: (right, smile, idle)
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(princess)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	princess.Position = clever_ogre.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

	-- 부서진 바위가 있다면 재생성
	self:reset_rock()

	-- 레벨에 따른 예외 처리
	if level == 'level_2' then
		leader.Position = start_pos

		-- 돌 삭제함
		for idx = 1, 3 do
			local rock = get_field_object('sub_clever_ogre_rock_' .. idx)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(rock, active_state_type.disabled)
		end
	end

	-- 도착 목표 지점 어택 레인지 세팅
	self:set_attack_range(level)
end

function local_class:attach_image_ui(target)
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local items_custom = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'spritesheets/items', 'items_custom')
	local custom_atlas = items_custom.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
	custom_atlas:Initialize()

	local offset = vector(-0.25, target.Bounds.size.y + 1.6, -0.5)

	self.pooled_sprite = self.fx.custom_sprite:Instantiate(target.Bounds.center + offset,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, target.Transform)

	self.goblin_sprite = self.pooled_sprite.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	self.goblin_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0)

	self.goblin_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
	self.goblin_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas

	self.goblin_sprite.SpriteName = 'pw_wood_goblin_icon'
	self.goblin_sprite:SetSortingOrder(-1)
	self.goblin_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:attach_count_ui(target, count)
	local offset = vector(0.25, target.Bounds.size.y + 2, -0.8)

	self.count_ui = self.fx.count:Instantiate(target.Bounds.center + offset,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, target.Transform)

	self.count_ui.transform:Find('Offset').gameObject:SetActive(false)
	local tmp = self.count_ui.transform:Find('BuffCountText'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.TMPro.TextMeshPro))
	tmp.text = count
	tmp.color = unity_class.color.yellow
end

function local_class:update_count_ui(value)
	local tmp = self.count_ui.transform:Find('BuffCountText'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.TMPro.TextMeshPro))

	tmp.text = value
end

function local_class:detach_count_ui()
	if self.count_ui ~= nil then
		self.count_ui.transform:Find('Offset').gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.count_ui:Dispose()
		self.count_ui = nil
	end
end

function local_class:detach_image_ui()
	if self.pooled_sprite ~= nil then
		self.pooled_sprite:Dispose()
		self.pooled_sprite = nil
	end

	if self.goblin_sprite ~= nil then
		self.goblin_sprite = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_fugitive_goblin(level)
	for _, goblin in pairs(self.const[level].goblin) do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(goblin.fo, active_state_type.visible)

		local start_pos = self.wp(goblin.start_x, goblin.start_z)
		goblin.fo.Position = start_pos

		scene_util.set_direction(goblin.fo, 'down', false)
	end
end

function local_class:reset_goblin(level)
	for _, goblin in pairs(self.in_game_data[level].goblin) do
		goblin.current_anim = 'idle'
		goblin.current_x = self.const[level].goblin[goblin.fo.Name].start_x
		goblin.current_z = self.const[level].goblin[goblin.fo.Name].start_z
		goblin.is_success = false
	end
end

function local_class:hide_ui()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	--퍼즐 진입 시 방향키와 달리기 UI만 출력

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield()

	--6성 리더 스킬 버튼 추가에 따른, 필요한 UI만 출력하도록 수정.
	field_ui_util.show_target_ui({
		owner = leader,
		show_target = field_ui_type.action_button | field_ui_type.dpad,
		show_navigation_bar = true
	})

	-- 부메랑 ui 숨김
	self.boomerang_controller = get_stage_event_controller('PixyWorldBoomerangController')
	self.boomerang_controller:boomerang_active_setting(false)
end

function local_class:hide_mini_game_ui()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, field_ui_type.action_button | field_ui_type.dpad)
end

function local_class:reset_mini_game_ui()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, field_ui_type.action_button | field_ui_type.dpad)
end

function local_class:reset_ui()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, field_ui_type.skill_button | field_ui_type.role_button |
			field_ui_type.class_button | field_ui_type.team_combination_button | field_ui_type.mode_change_button)

	-- 부메랑 ui 돌려줌
	self.boomerang_controller:boomerang_active_setting(true)

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
end

function local_class:stop_control_check()
	local goblin_count = 0

	for _, goblin in pairs(self.in_game_data[self.in_game_data.current_level].goblin) do
		if not self.in_game_data.player.stop and goblin.current_state ~= goblin.state.watch then
			self.in_game_data.player.stop = true

			self:hide_mini_game_ui()

			break
		elseif self.in_game_data.player.stop and goblin.current_state == goblin.state.watch then
			goblin_count = goblin_count + 1

			if goblin_count == self.const[self.in_game_data.current_level].success_count then
				self.in_game_data.player.stop = false

				self:reset_mini_game_ui()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_attack_range(level)
	--퍼즐 목표는 틴트를 통해 표시
	--빨간색 어택 레인지로 표현
	--범위는 2x2
	for _, success_pos in pairs(self.const[level].success_pos) do
		self.event_range:create(success_pos, 'red', vector(2, 2))
		self.event_range:set_active_state(true)
	end
end

function local_class:reset_rock()
	for idx = 1, 3 do
		local rock = get_field_object('sub_clever_ogre_rock_' .. idx)

		if rock.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			-- 부숴진 바위가 있다면 다시 활성화
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.sender = rock
			heal_info.target = rock
			heal_info.skipEffect = true

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:mini_game_start_routine(level)
	self.in_game_data.is_playing = true
	self.in_game_data.surrender = false

	self:set_fugitive_goblin(level)
	self:reset_goblin(level)
	self:puzzle_settings(level)
	self:reset_gimmicks_in_zone()

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	do
		local start_count_string_key = 'pw_clever_ogre_activity_count'

		for i = 3, 1, -1 do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format(start_count_string_key, i), 3)

			wait_for_sec(1)
		end
	end

	--  BGM이 변경된 적이 없으면 변경해줌
	--if not bgm_on then
	--	bgm_on = true
	--
	--	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
	--		state = 'event',
	--		name = 'bgm_chasing'
	--	})
	--end

	self:hide_ui()

	-- ui 제거
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	start_coroutine(self.mini_game_update, self, level)
end

function local_class:mini_game_update(level)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	while self.in_game_data.is_playing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		for _, goblin in pairs(self.in_game_data[level].goblin) do
			if goblin.current_state == goblin.state.dodge then
				if goblin.current_anim ~= 'run' then
					goblin.current_anim = 'run'
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_hit_01')
					scene_util.set_anim(goblin.fo, self, 'run')

					scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'mad')
					scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'hold_loop')
					if self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx == nil then
						self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
							sfx_name = '01_dash_01',
							parent = goblin.fo,
							loop = true,
							type_priority = 'loop',
							player_priority = 'npc'
						})
					end
				end

				self:goblin_move(dt, goblin, level)
			elseif goblin.current_state == goblin.state.watch then
				if goblin.current_anim ~= 'idle' then
					goblin.current_anim = 'idle'
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goblin.fo)

					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				end

				self:moving_order(goblin, level)
			end
		end

		self:stop_control_check()

		self.in_game_data.player.backup_pos = leader.Position

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:goblin_move(dt, goblin, level)
	local move_speed = self.const.goblin_move_speed
	local move_distance = move_speed * dt

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(goblin.target_pos - goblin.fo.Position)
	local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
	local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)

	if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		direction = goblin.fo.Direction
	end

	goblin.fo.Direction = direction

	local min_dist = math.min(move_distance, dist)
	if dist > 0 then
		goblin.fo.Position = goblin.fo.Position + (min_dist * dir)

		if bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(self.brazier.Bounds, goblin.fo.Bounds) then
			goblin.current_state = goblin.state.back

			self:goblin_blocked_brazier(goblin, dt)
		else
			--고블린끼리 충돌 시
			for _, other_goblin in pairs(self.in_game_data[level].goblin) do
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(goblin.fo, other_goblin.fo) then
					if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(other_goblin.fo.Bounds, goblin.fo.Position) then
						self.in_game_data.is_playing = false
						goblin.current_state = goblin.state.crash

						if self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx ~= nil then
							music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx)
						end

						self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx = nil

						sp_util.start_scene(self.goblin_crash, self, goblin, other_goblin)

						goblin.current_state = goblin.state.watch

						return
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if goblin.current_state == goblin.state.dodge and min_dist >= dist then
		goblin.fo.Position = goblin.target_pos
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(get_party_leader())

		if bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(self.brazier.Bounds, goblin.fo.Bounds) then
			goblin.current_state = goblin.state.back

			self:goblin_blocked_brazier(goblin, dt)

			return
		else
			--고블린끼리 충돌 시
			for _, other_goblin in pairs(self.in_game_data[level].goblin) do
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(goblin.fo, other_goblin.fo) then
					if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(other_goblin.fo.Bounds, goblin.fo.Position) then
						self.in_game_data.is_playing = false
						goblin.current_state = goblin.state.crash

						if self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx ~= nil then
							music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx)
						end

						self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx = nil
						sp_util.start_scene(self.goblin_crash, self, goblin, other_goblin)

						goblin.current_state = goblin.state.watch

						return
					end
				end
			end
		end

		goblin.current_state = goblin.state.watch

		if self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx)
		end

		self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx = nil

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goblin.fo)
		goblin.current_anim = 'idle'

		self.in_game_data.player.hp = self.in_game_data.player.hp - 1

		self:update_count_ui(self.in_game_data.player.hp)

		self:success_check(goblin, level)
		self:mini_game_clear_check(level)

		if self.in_game_data.player.hp == 0 and self.in_game_data.is_playing then
			self.in_game_data.is_playing = false
			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

				self:mini_game_fail_scene()
			end)

			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:goblin_blocked_brazier(goblin)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	goblin.current_anim = 'idle'

	if self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx)
	end

	self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx = nil

	--고블린 위와 같이 이동 중 정지
	scene_util.set_emotion(goblin.fo, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')

	character_util.remove_anim(goblin.fo)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(goblin.fo, nil, 'annoyed')

	if self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx == nil then
		self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01',
			parent = goblin.fo,
			loop = true,
			type_priority = 'loop',
			player_priority = 'npc'
		})
	end

	--이후 (annoyed) 버블 이모티콘 출력 후 다시 원래 위치로 복귀
	character_util.move_to_async(goblin.fo, goblin.backup_pos, nil, 4, true, true)


	if self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx)
	end

	self.in_game_data.dash_loop_sfx = nil

	--레이어는 가장 가까운 좌표로 직진 이동
	--(진입 방향을 등진 상태에서 tired, walk)로 이동
	--4의 속도
	local shortest_dist = 999999
	local back_pos = self.wp(0, 0)
	for x = 0, self.const[self.in_game_data.current_level].max_x do
		for z = 0, self.const[self.in_game_data.current_level].max_z do
			local wp = self.wp(x, z)
			if wp ~= goblin.backup_pos then
				local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.in_game_data.player.backup_pos - wp)
				local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

				if dist < shortest_dist then
					shortest_dist = dist
					back_pos = wp
				end
			end
		end
	end


	character_util.look_at(leader, goblin.fo)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, back_pos, nil, 4, false, true)


	character_util.remove_emotion(goblin.fo)

	--이동 수는 소모되지 않음.
	local backup_x, backup_z = self:convert_to_xz(goblin.backup_pos)
	goblin.current_x = backup_x
	goblin.current_z = backup_z
	goblin.current_state = goblin.state.watch
end

function local_class:goblin_crash(goblin, other_goblin)
	local goblin_pos = goblin.fo.Position
	local goblin_dir = goblin.fo.Direction

	local other_goblin_pos = other_goblin.fo.Position
	local other_goblin_dir = other_goblin.fo.Direction

	--고블린끼리 충돌 시 fx_hit 출력되며 고블린 부딪히는 반대 방향으로 0.5초에 걸쳐 0.5타일씩 밀려남
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	local center_pos = vector(((goblin_pos.x + other_goblin_pos.x) / 2), 0.1, ((goblin_pos.z + other_goblin_pos.z) / 2))
	self.fx.hit:Instantiate(center_pos)

	--밀려날 때 (방향, idle, embarrassed) 출력
	scene_util.set_anim(goblin.fo, self, 'embarrassed')
	scene_util.set_anim(other_goblin.fo, self, 'embarrassed')

	if goblin_dir == other_goblin_dir then
		other_goblin_dir = direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(goblin_dir)
	end

	local wp = {
		goblin_pos + (direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(goblin_dir)) / 2),
		other_goblin_pos + (direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(other_goblin_dir)) / 2)
	}

	local wp_key = 'wp_key'
	local speed = 1
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(goblin.fo,
			wp[1], speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, locked_dir = direction_util.to_str(goblin_dir) })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(other_goblin.fo,
			wp[2], speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, locked_dir = direction_util.to_str(other_goblin_dir) })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	goblin.current_anim = 'idle'
	other_goblin.current_anim = 'idle'

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goblin.fo)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(other_goblin.fo)

	self:mini_game_fail_scene()
end

function local_class:mini_game_fail_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self:player_throw_routine()

	--실패 연출
	--고블린 충돌 연출 진행 후 플레이어 (방향, tired, dead) 출력되며 실패 UI 출력
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('pw_clever_ogre_activity_failed'))

	character_util.set_side_direction(leader)

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dead')

	--고블린은 (방향, smile, victory_extra) 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_appear_01')
	for _, goblin in pairs(self.const[self.in_game_data.current_level].goblin) do
		character_util.set_side_direction(goblin.fo)
		scene_util.set_emotion(goblin.fo, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(goblin.fo, self, { name = 'victory_extra' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	self:mini_game_post_fail_scene()
end

function local_class:mini_game_post_fail_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local clever_ogre = self.get_clever_ogre()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	--이후  circular fade out 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	self:detach_count_ui()
	self:detach_image_ui()

	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

	--1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.event_range.inst ~= nil then
		self.event_range:dispose()
	end

	self.in_game_data.is_playing = false

	--플레이어 (right, idle, idle)
	local align_pivot = self.get_ogre_pos()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	leader.Position = align_pivot + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	princess.Position = align_pivot + vector(-2.5, 0, 0)

	self.in_game_data.player.is_in_zone = false

	--럼 (left, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(clever_ogre)
	scene_util.set_direction(clever_ogre, 'left', false)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	for _, goblin in pairs(self.const[self.in_game_data.current_level].goblin) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goblin.fo)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(goblin.fo, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(princess, user_party, false,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep, -(user_party.Count - 1))

	self.brazier.Position = vector(500, 0, 500)

	--1초 뒤 circular fade in 출력

	if self.in_game_data.surrender then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1 })
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	self:reset_mini_game_ui()

	if self.in_game_data.surrender then
		self.in_game_data.surrender = false

		character_util.add_listener(clever_ogre, self)

		self:reset_ui()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), { 'clever_ogre_mini_game_surrender' }))

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

		return
	end

	--대화 진행
	--럼 (left, idle, idle): 하하하. 내가 이겼다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(clever_ogre, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_clever_ogre_s1_21', skip = true })

	--럼 (left, idle, idle): 그럼 내기에 졌으니까, 맛있는 고기를 먹어볼까?

function local_class:moving_order(goblin, level)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position - goblin.fo.Position)

	-- 저프레임 이슈 때문에 감지 범위에 들어온 이후에 실제로 경로 탐색은 플레이어의 이전 프레임의 위치로 탐색함
	local backup_pos_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.in_game_data.player.backup_pos - goblin.fo.Position)
	local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
	local start_pos = goblin.fo.Position

	local current_x = goblin.current_x
	local current_z = goblin.current_z

	if dist > self.const.watching_dist then
		return
	end

	local leader_x_diff = self:get_leader_x_diff(backup_pos_diff)
	local leader_z_diff = self:get_leader_z_diff(backup_pos_diff)
	--플레이어가 고블린 보다
	--위
	local is_leader_up_side_of_goblin = backup_pos_diff.z >= 0
	--아래
	local is_leader_down_side_of_goblin = backup_pos_diff.z < 0
	--오른쪽
	local is_leader_right_side_of_goblin = backup_pos_diff.x >= 0
	--왼쪽
	local is_leader_left_side_of_goblin = backup_pos_diff.x < 0

	-- 플레이어가 좌 우 에서 접근 했을 때
	local goblin_vertical_movement_rule = function(player_relative_to_goblin)
		local offset
		if player_relative_to_goblin == is_leader_right_side_of_goblin then
			offset = -1
		else
			offset = 1
		end

		--왼쪽 그리드 화로 검사
		if current_x + offset >= 0 and current_x + offset <= self.const[level].max_x and
				self:check_grid_blocked(start_pos, self.wp(current_x + offset, current_z)) then
			-- 고블린의 z 좌표가 최 하단 일 때
			if current_z == 0 then
				current_z = current_z + 1

				-- 고블린의 z 좌표가 최 상단 일 때
			elseif current_z == self.const[level].max_z then
				current_z = current_z - 1
			else
				if is_leader_up_side_of_goblin then
					current_z = current_z - 1
				elseif is_leader_down_side_of_goblin then
					current_z = current_z + 1
				end
			end
		else
			--고블린의 좌표가 왼쪽 위 모서리 일때
			if current_x == 0 and current_z == self.const[level].max_z then
				current_z = current_z - 1
				--고블린의 좌표가 왼쪽 아래 모서리 일때
			elseif current_x == 0 and current_z == 0 then
				current_z = current_z + 1
				--고블린의 좌표가 오른쪽 위 모서리 일때
			elseif current_x == self.const[level].max_x and current_z == self.const[level].max_z then
				current_z = current_z - 1
				--고블린의 좌표가 오른쪽 아래 모서리 일때
			elseif current_x == self.const[level].max_x and current_z == 0 then
				current_z = current_z + 1
				--고블린의 좌표가 양쪽 끝 이지만 모서리는 아닐 때
			elseif current_x == 0 or current_x == self.const[level].max_x then
				if is_leader_up_side_of_goblin then
					if current_z - 1 >= 0 and self:check_grid_blocked(start_pos, self.wp(current_x, current_z - 1)) then
						current_z = current_z + 1
					else
						current_z = current_z - 1
					end
				elseif is_leader_down_side_of_goblin then
					if current_z + 1 <= self.const[level].max_z and
							self:check_grid_blocked(start_pos, self.wp(current_x, current_z + 1)) then
						current_z = current_z - 1
					else
						current_z = current_z + 1
					end
				end
			else
				current_x = current_x + offset
			end
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어가 상 하 에서 접근 했을 때
	local goblin_horizontal_movement_rule = function(player_relative_to_goblin)
		local offset

		if player_relative_to_goblin == is_leader_up_side_of_goblin then
			offset = -1
		else
			offset = 1
		end

		--오른쪽 그리드 화로 검사
		if current_z + offset >= 0 and current_z + offset <= self.const[level].max_z and
				self:check_grid_blocked(start_pos, self.wp(current_x, current_z + offset)) then
			-- 고블린의 x 좌표가 0 일 때
			if current_x == 0 then
				current_x = current_x + 1
				-- 고블린의 x 좌표가 max 일 때
			elseif current_x == self.const[level].max_x then
				current_x = current_x - 1
			else
				if is_leader_right_side_of_goblin then
					current_x = current_x - 1
				elseif is_leader_left_side_of_goblin then
					current_x = current_x + 1
				end
			end
		else
			--고블린의 좌표가 왼쪽 위 모서리 일때
			if current_x == 0 and current_z == self.const[level].max_z then
				current_x = current_x + 1
				--고블린의 좌표가 왼쪽 아래 모서리 일때
			elseif current_x == 0 and current_z == 0 then
				current_x = current_x + 1
				--고블린의 좌표가 오른쪽 위 모서리 일때
			elseif current_x == self.const[level].max_x and current_z == self.const[level].max_z then
				current_x = current_x - 1
				--고블린의 좌표가 오른쪽 아래 모서리 일때
			elseif current_x == self.const[level].max_x and current_z == 0 then
				current_x = current_x - 1
				--고블린의 좌표가 양쪽 끝 이지만 모서리는 아닐 때
			elseif current_z == 0 or current_z == self.const[level].max_z then
				if is_leader_right_side_of_goblin then
					if current_x - 1 >= 0 and self:check_grid_blocked(start_pos, self.wp(current_x - 1, current_z)) then
						current_x = current_x + 1
					else
						current_x = current_x - 1
					end
				elseif is_leader_left_side_of_goblin then
					if current_x + 1 <= self.const[level].max_x and
							self:check_grid_blocked(start_pos, self.wp(current_x + 1, current_z)) then
						current_x = current_x - 1
					else
						current_x = current_x + 1
					end
				end
			else
				current_z = current_z + offset
			end
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어가 좌 우 에서 접근 했을 때
	if leader_x_diff > leader_z_diff then
		if is_leader_right_side_of_goblin then

			goblin_vertical_movement_rule(is_leader_right_side_of_goblin)
		elseif is_leader_left_side_of_goblin then

			goblin_vertical_movement_rule(is_leader_left_side_of_goblin)
		end

		self:move_to_grid(level, goblin, current_x, current_z)

		-- 플레이어가 상 하 에서 접근 했을 때
	elseif leader_x_diff < leader_z_diff then
		if is_leader_up_side_of_goblin then

			goblin_horizontal_movement_rule(is_leader_up_side_of_goblin)
		elseif is_leader_down_side_of_goblin then

			goblin_horizontal_movement_rule(is_leader_down_side_of_goblin)
		end

		self:move_to_grid(level, goblin, current_x, current_z)
	else
		-- 15프레임 에서 테스트 했을 때도 이런 경우는 없었지만 예외 처리 해놓음
		logger_util.warning('Pathfinding results are incorrect at very low frame rates.')

		if is_leader_right_side_of_goblin then

			goblin_vertical_movement_rule(is_leader_right_side_of_goblin)
		elseif is_leader_left_side_of_goblin then

			goblin_vertical_movement_rule(is_leader_left_side_of_goblin)
		elseif is_leader_up_side_of_goblin then

			goblin_horizontal_movement_rule(is_leader_up_side_of_goblin)
		elseif is_leader_down_side_of_goblin then

			goblin_horizontal_movement_rule(is_leader_down_side_of_goblin)
		end

		self:move_to_grid(level, goblin, current_x, current_z)
	end
end

function local_class:move_to_grid(level, goblin, x, z)
	if goblin.current_state == goblin.state.dodge then
		return false
	end

	if x < 0 or x > self.const[level].max_x then

		return false
	end

	if z < 0 or z > self.const[level].max_z then

		return false
	end

	goblin.current_x = x
	goblin.current_z = z

	goblin.backup_pos = goblin.fo.Position

	local target_pos = self.wp(goblin.current_x, goblin.current_z)
	goblin.target_pos = target_pos

	goblin.current_state = goblin.state.dodge
end

function local_class:convert_to_xz(pos)
	local base_wp = self.wp(0, 0)
	local pos_x = math.floor(math.abs(base_wp.x - pos.x) / self.const.x_diff)
	local pos_z = math.floor(math.abs(base_wp.z - pos.z) / self.const.z_diff)

	return pos_x, pos_z
end

function local_class:get_leader_x_diff(diff)
	if math.abs(diff.x) < (self.const.x_diff / 2) then
		return 0
	else
		return (math.abs(diff.x) - (self.const.x_diff / 2)) / self.const.x_diff
	end
end

function local_class:get_leader_z_diff(diff)
	if math.abs(diff.z) < (self.const.z_diff / 2) then
		return 0
	else
		return (math.abs(diff.z) - (self.const.z_diff / 2)) / self.const.z_diff
	end
end

function local_class:check_grid_blocked(start_pos, target_pos)
	local is_grid_blocked = false

	local bounds_size = vector(2, 1, 2)
	local check_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(start_pos, bounds_size)
	check_bounds.center = start_pos

	-- 그리드의 크기로 화로 검사
	local obj_list_1 = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(check_bounds, target_pos - start_pos)

	for idx = 0, obj_list_1.Count - 1 do
		local fo = obj_list_1[idx]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.brazier) then
			is_grid_blocked = true
		end
	end

	obj_list_1:Dispose()

	local is_goblin_blocked = false

	-- 고블린의 충돌 범위로 재 검사
	if is_grid_blocked then
		bounds_size = vector(1.1, 0.75, 1.1)
		local goblin_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(start_pos, bounds_size)
		check_bounds.center = start_pos

		local obj_list_2 = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(goblin_bounds, target_pos - start_pos)

		for idx = 0, obj_list_2.Count - 1 do
			local fo = obj_list_2[idx]
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.brazier) then
				is_goblin_blocked = true
			end
		end

		obj_list_2:Dispose()
	end

	local blocked_result = false

	if is_grid_blocked and is_goblin_blocked then
		blocked_result = true
	end

	return blocked_result
end

function local_class:success_check(goblin, level)
	for _, success_pos in pairs(self.const[level].success_pos) do
		local success_x, success_z = self:convert_to_xz(success_pos)
		if goblin.current_x == success_x and goblin.current_z == success_z then
			goblin.is_success = true

			break
		else
			goblin.is_success = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:mini_game_clear_check(level)
	local success_count = 0

	for _, goblin in pairs(self.in_game_data[level].goblin) do
		if goblin.is_success then
			success_count = success_count + 1
		end
	end

	if success_count == self.const[level].success_count and self.in_game_data.is_playing then
		self.in_game_data.is_playing = false
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene( { hide_weapon = false })

			self:mini_game_clear_scene()
		end)
	end
end

		ogre_interact_scene_2 = 3,
		before_mini_game = 4,
		after_mini_game = 5,
		done = 6
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.ogre_interact_scene_1

	self.mini_game_fail = false
	self.mini_game_surrender = false
	self.decline_request = false
	self.decline_request_2 = false
	self.after_battle = false
	self.is_in_zone = false

	--npc
	self.get_princess = function()
		return get_character('princess')
	end

	self.get_clever_ogre = function()
		return get_character('clever_ogre')

		return field_util.get_marker_pos('clever_ogre_pos_1')

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self:set_npc_presets_for_state()
		self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.current_state])

		screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local clever_ogre = self.get_clever_ogre()

	if self.current_state == self.states.ogre_interact_scene_1 and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, clever_ogre) then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_battle

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			self:ogre_interact_scene_1()
		end)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.ogre_interact_scene_2 and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, clever_ogre) then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_mini_game

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			self:ogre_interact_scene_2()
		end)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.after_mini_game and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, clever_ogre) then
		self.current_state = self.states.done

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			self:mini_game_1_clear_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_battle and
			e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		self.current_state = self.states.ogre_interact_scene_2
		self.after_battle = true

		sp_util.start_scene(self.ogre_battle_end_event, self)

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'clever_ogre_mini_game_clear' then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_mini_game

		start_coroutine(function()
			self:mini_game_1_clear_scene()
		end)

		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'clever_ogre_mini_game_fail' then
		self.decline_request = false
		self.mini_game_fail = true
		self.current_state = self.states.ogre_interact_scene_2

		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'clever_ogre_mini_game_surrender' then
		self.decline_request = false
		self.mini_game_fail = true
		self.mini_game_surrender = true
		self.current_state = self.states.ogre_interact_scene_2

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npc_presets_for_state()
	local ogre_pos = self.get_ogre_pos()
	local clever_ogre = self.get_clever_ogre()

	character_util.add_listener(clever_ogre, self.controller)

	self.npc_presets = {
		[self.states.ogre_interact_scene_1] = {
			{
				type = 'static',
				name = 'clever_ogre',
				pos = ogre_pos,
				dir = 'left',
			},
		},
		[self.states.ogre_interact_scene_2] = {
			{
				type = 'static',
				name = 'clever_ogre',
				pos = ogre_pos,
				dir = 'left',
			},
			{
				type = 'static',
				name = 'leader',
				pos = ogre_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
				dir = 'right',
			},
			{
				type = 'static',
				name = 'princess',
				pos = ogre_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
				dir = 'right',
			},

end

function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)
			end
		else
			npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)
		end

		character_util.hide_weapon(npc, true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, data[i].pos)
		end

		if data[i].dir ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data[i].dir)
		end

		if data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data[i].emo)
		end

		if data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, data[i].anim)
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

function local_class:ogre_interact_scene_1()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local clever_ogre = self.get_clever_ogre()
	local pivot_pos = self.get_ogre_pos()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local wp = {
		pivot_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
		pivot_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
	}

	local speed = 4
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader,
			wp[1], speed, nil, self, nil,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess,
			wp[2], speed, nil, self, nil,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	-- 이후 대화 진행

	-- 럼 (left, idle, idle): 반갑다, 이방인.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(clever_ogre, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_clever_ogre_s1_1', skip = true })

	-- 럼 (left, idle, idle): 나는 내기의 대가, 영리한 럼이다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(clever_ogre, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_clever_ogre_s1_2', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 등장
	local choose_result_1 = {
		{
			-- (mercy) 오거답지 않게 말을 잘하는군.
			'pw_clever_ogre_s1_choose_1_1',
			'mercy',
			function()
				-- 플레이어 (right, surprise, clap)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
				scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'clap' })

				wait_for_sec(1)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

				-- 럼 (left, idle, idle): 내기는 영리한 두뇌를 만드는 법.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(clever_ogre, self,
						{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
						{ key = 'pw_clever_ogre_s1_3', skip = true })


				self.current_state = self.states.ogre_interact_scene_2

				self:ogre_interact_scene_2()
			end
		},
		{
			-- (normal) 혹시 나에게 뿔피리를 줄 거야?
			'pw_clever_ogre_s1_choose_1_2',
			'normal',
			function()
				-- 플레이어 (right, sing, sing 1.5초 간 출력)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
				scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
						{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
						{ name = 'sing' },
						{ name = 'sing' },
						1.5)

				-- 럼 (left, idle, idle): 나의 뿔피리에 대해서 알고 있군.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(clever_ogre, self,
						{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						nil,
						nil,
						{ key = 'pw_clever_ogre_s1_4', skip = true })

				--럼 (left, idle, idle): 하지만 지금은 뿔피리가 중요한 게 아니다.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(clever_ogre, self,
						{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						nil,
						nil,
						{ key = 'pw_clever_ogre_s1_4_1', skip = true })

				self.current_state = self.states.ogre_interact_scene_2

				self:ogre_interact_scene_2()
			end
		},
		{
			-- (brutal) 공격한다.
			'pw_clever_ogre_s1_choose_1_3',
			'brutal',
			function()
				-- 플레이어(right, attack, jingak 1회)
				scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' })

				-- 럼 (left, idle, idle): 참고로 나는 미식가이기도 하다.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(clever_ogre, self,
						{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
						nil,
						nil,
						{ key = 'pw_clever_ogre_s1_5', skip = true })

				-- 전투 시작: 보스 타이틀
				-- 럼
				-- 영리한 오거
				local show_boss_title_dur = 2
				screen_util.show_boss_title('pw_clever_ogre_boss_title',
						'pw_clever_ogre_boss_sub_title', show_boss_title_dur, false)

				wait_for_sec(show_boss_title_dur)

				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0)

				-- 배틀 게이트는 아래와 같이 배치되고 전투 시작되면 close 상태
				for idx = 1, 3 do
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('sub_clever_ogre_battlegate_' .. idx, true))
				end

				character_util.convert_to_monster(clever_ogre, self.battle_group_name)
				character_util.set_death_type(clever_ogre, 'none')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

				sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
			end
		}
	}

	-- 플레이어 선택지 출력
	choose_util.play_async({
		-- (mercy) 오거답지 않게 말을 잘하는군.
		choose_result_1[1],
		-- (normal) 혹시 나에게 뿔피리를 줄 거야?
		choose_result_1[2],
		-- (brutal) 공격한다.
		choose_result_1[3]
	})
end

function local_class:ogre_battle_end_event()
	local clever_ogre = self.get_clever_ogre()
	for idx = 1, 3 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('sub_clever_ogre_battlegate_' .. idx, true))
	end

	--럼 패배하면 (보는 방향, idle, dead 출력하고 마지막에 정지)
	character_util.set_side_direction(clever_ogre)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(clever_ogre, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	--이후 circular fade out 연출 진행

	--전투 승리 시  circular fade out
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.current_state])
	character_util.convert_to_npc(clever_ogre)
	character_util.add_listener(clever_ogre, self.controller)

	scene_util.set_anim(clever_ogre, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false, scale = 999 })

	--1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--1초 후  circular fade in
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--1초
	self:ogre_interact_scene_2()
end

end

function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self:set_npc_presets_for_state()
		self:set_npc_with_data(self.npc_presets[self.current_state])

		if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			self.current_state = self.states.after_mini_game_2

			self:mini_game_2_start()
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local clever_ogre = self.get_clever_ogre()

	if self.current_state == self.states.before_mini_game_2 and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, clever_ogre) then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_mini_game_2

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()
			self:ogre_interact_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'clever_ogre_mini_game_clear' then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_mini_game_2

		start_coroutine(function()
			self:mini_game_2_clear_scene()
		end)

		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'clever_ogre_mini_game_fail' then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_mini_game_2

		return true

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'clever_ogre_mini_game_surrender' then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_mini_game_2
		self.mini_game_surrender = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_npc_presets_for_state()
	local ogre_pos = self.get_ogre_pos()
	local clever_ogre = self.get_clever_ogre()

	character_util.add_listener(clever_ogre, self.controller)

	self.npc_presets = {
		[self.states.before_mini_game_2] = {

				pos = ogre_pos,
				dir = 'left',
			},
