function local_class:set_npc_with_data(data)
	for i = 1, #data do
		local npc_preset = data[i]

		local npc
		if npc_preset.type == 'static' then
			if npc_preset.name == 'leader' then
				npc = get_party_leader()
			else
				npc = get_character(npc_preset.name)

		else
			npc = self.dynamic_npcs:get(npc_preset.name)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		end

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldBackgroundAttacher')

function local_class:init()
	self.res_holder = nil

	self.background_objects = {}

	self.grid_to_bg_key = {}
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent))

	if self.background_objects ~= nil then
		for _, obj in pairs(self.background_objects) do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(obj)
		end

		self.background_objects = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_async(constants_path, scale)
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		return
	end

	--constants_path가 nil일 경우, 기본 Constants 경로 셋팅(pixyworld)
	constants_path = lua_helper.get_or_default(constants_path,
			'Quest/Main/PixyWorld/Common/BackgroundAttacherConstants')
	scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local all_constants = require(constants_path)
	local stage_constants = all_constants[stage.Name]
	local has_grid_condition = false

	for key, constants in pairs(stage_constants) do
		local obj = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
				constants.asset.path, constants.asset.name, stage_camera.Transform)

		obj.transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, 1)
		obj.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
		obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

		if constants.active_grid_names ~= nil then
			for _, grid_name in pairs(constants.active_grid_names) do
				self.grid_to_bg_key[grid_name] = key
			end

			has_grid_condition = true
		end

		self.background_objects[key] = obj
	end

	if has_grid_condition then
		message_system:Subscribe(self,
				typeof(CS.Oak.WatchingCameraGridChangedEvent), 'on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event')
	end
end

function local_class:on_watching_camera_grid_changed_event(e)
	if e.CameraGrid == nil then
		return false
	end

	local target_key = self.grid_to_bg_key[e.CameraGrid.name]

	-- nil이면 전부 꺼질 것임
	self:switch_background(target_key)

	return true
end

function local_class:set_active(key, enabled)
	self.background_objects[key]:SetActive(enabled)
end

function local_class:switch_background(activate_target_key)
	for key, obj in pairs(self.background_objects) do
		obj:SetActive(activate_target_key == key)
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldAutoForwardMoveController')

function local_class:init()
	self.controller_state = {
		none = 0,
		playing = 1,
	}
	self.current_controller_state = self.controller_state.none

	-- 자동 이동 속도
	self.move_speed = 4

	-- 자동 이동 애니
	self.moving_anim = 'run'

	-- 자동 이동 끝내기 위한 존(추후 함수 형태로 바뀔 여지 있음)
	self.finish_zone = nil

	self.input_direction = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
end

function local_class:pre_load(load_end_callback)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')

	self:game_ui_hide()

	local all_constants = require('Quest/Main/PixyWorld/Common/PixyWorldAutoForwardMoveConstants')
	local stage_constants = all_constants[stage.Name]

	self.move_speed = stage_constants.move_speed -- 자동 이동 속도 셋팅
	self.moving_anim = stage_constants.moving_anim

	if stage_constants.finish_zone ~= nil then
		self.finish_zone = stage_constants.finish_zone
	end

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:game_ui_show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 모든 조작을 막아놓음
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_util.show_ui({
		hide_target = field_ui_type.skill_button | field_ui_type.class_button
			| field_ui_type.role_button | field_ui_type.action_button
			| field_ui_type.custom_button_1 | field_ui_type.mode_change_button | field_ui_type.team_combination_button,
		hide_minimap = false,
		hide_navigation_bar = false,
	})
end

function local_class:game_ui_hide()
	field_ui_util.hide_ui()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
end

function local_class:moving_forward_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'run' })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(user_party[i])
	end

	self.input_direction = get_party_leader().Direction

	self.current_controller_state = self.controller_state.playing
	self:game_ui_show()

	while self.current_controller_state == self.controller_state.playing do
		self:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:game_ui_hide()

	party_util.remove_animation()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(user_party[i])
	end
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local field_object_current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(field_object_current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterForcedDashState) or
			lua_helper.type_compare(field_object_current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState) then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_direction(leader, self.input_direction)

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.input_direction)
	move_info.magnitude = dt * self.move_speed

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, leader.Direction, true)

	message_system:SendSync(leader, move_event)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		self.input_direction = e.Stick4WayDirection

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:exit_auto_moving_state()
	self.current_controller_state = self.controller_state.none
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

			end

		hide = function(this)
			this.counter.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end,
		set_count = function(this, num)
			this.count = num
			this.counter:SetCount(this.count)
		end,
		add_count = function(this, num)
			this.count = this.count + num
			this:set_count(this.count)
		end,
	}

	self.fish_state = {
		none = 1,
		diving = 2,
		surfacing = 3,
		hit = 4,
		air_spin = 5,
		air_spin_end = 6,
		wait = 7,
	}

	--ex = {
	--			fo = nil,
	--			current_state = self.fish_state.none,
	--			next_state = self.fish_state.none,
	--			time_passed = 0,
	--			max_duration = 0,
	--		}
	self.fish_info = {
		data = {},
		add = function(this, key, info)
			this.data[key] = info
		end,
		foreach = function(this, action)
			for key, info in pairs(this.data) do
				action(key, info)
			end
		end,
		set = function(this, key, state_data)
			this.data[key] = state_data
		end,
		set_current_state = function(this, key, state)
			this.data[key].current_state = state
		end,
		get = function(this, key)
			return this.data[key]
		end,
	}

	--endregion
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.NormalDyingEndEvent), 'on_normal_dying_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.start_routine, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.NormalDyingEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	self.number_ui:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.wait_quest_open and
			e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and
			e.CurrentProgress == self.need_main_quest_progress then
		self.current_state = self.states.start_quest_open
		start_coroutine(self.activate_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state <= self.states.before_activity and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc:fisher_goblin()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if not self.current_state == self.states.start_activity then
		return false
	end

	--부메랑 커스텀 이벤트 여부 확인
	if self.is_playing and
			e.Params ~= nil and
			e.Params.Length == 2 and
			e.Params[0] == 'pw_boomerang_event' and
			e.Params[1] == 'npc_collision' then

		local info_list = self.fish_info.data

		for key, info in pairs(info_list) do
			local fo = info.fo
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, fo) then
				self.fish_info:set_current_state(key, self.fish_state.hit)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_normal_dying_end_event(e)
	if self.is_playing then

		local info_list = self.fish_info.data

		for key, info in pairs(info_list) do
			local fo = info.fo
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.character, fo) then
				self.fish_info:set_current_state(key, self.fish_state.air_spin_end)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.stage_end = true
	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
end

--퀘스트 시작 시 설정
function local_class:start_routine()
	if not self:check_activate_condition() then
		return
	end

	self:pre_setting()
	self:interact_setting()
end

--퀘스트 활성화 여부 체크
function local_class:check_activate_condition()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if quest_progress == nil then
		return false
	end

	return quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.need_main_quest_progress
end

--퀘스트 활성화 연출 및 세팅
function local_class:activate_scene()
	local fisher_goblin = self.npc:fisher_goblin()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	self:pre_setting()

	-- 이미지의 고블린 위치에 fx_common_water_splash_out 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_03')
	self.fx:water_splash_out():Instantiate(fisher_goblin.Position)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 고블린(left, attack, embarrassed): 누구냐! 시끄럽게 해서 물고기 다 도망가게 하는 녀석은!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_hit_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
			{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_1', skip = false })

	self:interact_setting()
end

function local_class:interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fisher_goblin = self.npc:fisher_goblin()
	local fx_star_piece = self.fx_data:get('star_piece')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 고블린(down, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(fisher_goblin, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fisher_goblin, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(fisher_goblin)

	-- 몸 위의 FX_starpiece_in_character 이펙트 제거
	fx_star_piece.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 가디언 1초간 이미지의 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	do
		local duration = 1

		party_util.align_to_target(fisher_goblin.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), 'down', duration, 'linear')
	end

	if self.current_state <= self.states.before_interact then
		self.current_state = self.states.after_interact

		-- 고블린(down, attack, release): 너냐! 낚시 방해꾼!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
				{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'release' },
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_2', skip = true })

		-- 가디언(up, idle, bomb_idle) question 이모티콘 출력
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'bomb_idle' })

		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self,
				'up',
				'bomb_idle',
				nil,
				'question')

		-- 고블린(down, attack, cast): 네가 위에서 시끄럽게 하는 바람에 물고기들이 다 숨어버렸다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
				{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast' },
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_3', skip = true })

		-- 고블린(down, attack, embarrassed): 낚시 방해꾼! 책임 져라!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_appear_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
				{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'embarrassed' },
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_4', skip = true })
	else
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(fisher_goblin)
	end

	-- 고블린(down, attack, release): 날 도와서 물고기를 잡아라! 할당량 채우기 전까진 집에 못간다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
			{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_5', skip = true })

	-- 선택지
	do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- (mercy) 고블린을 도와준다.
			{ 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_choose_1', 'mercy' },
			-- (normal) 무시한다.
			{ 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_choose_2', 'normal' },
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--고블린(down, idle, nod 2회): 좋다. 시간 없으니 바로 시작하자.
			character_util.remove_emotion(fisher_goblin)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
					{ dir = 'down', sfx = false },
					{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
					nil,
					{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_7', skip = true })

			-- 수락 이벤트 실행
			self:activity_start_scene()
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			-- 거절 이벤트 실행
			fx_star_piece.gameObject:SetActive(true)

			--고블린(down, attack, embarrassed): 어디 가냐! 거기 서라!
			scene_util.set_anim(fisher_goblin, self, 'embarrassed')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fisher_goblin,
					{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_6', skip = false })

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:activity_start_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fisher_goblin = self.npc:fisher_goblin()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	--화면 0.75초간 서큘러 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_03')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, interpolations_constants.linear)

	--set
	do
		local default_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('diving_goblin_play_pos')

		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		leader.Position = default_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 0)

		scene_util.set_direction(fisher_goblin, 'right', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fisher_goblin)
		fisher_goblin.Position = default_pos + vector(0, -0.35, 0)

		self.door:close()

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, interpolations_constants.linear)

	if self.current_state == self.states.after_interact then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_activity

		-- 고블린(right, idle, cast): 난 지금부터 잠수해서 물고기들을 수면 위로 끌어올릴거다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast' },
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_8', skip = true })

		-- 고블린(right, idle, nod 2회): 그럼 넌 그걸 부메랑으로 던져서 잡으면 된다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_9', skip = true })

		-- 고블린(right, idle, release): 난 잠수 시간이 최대 1분밖에 안되니까 그 전에 끝내야 한다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'release' },
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_10', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')

		-- 카메라 shake(0.2, 0.1)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

		-- 고블린(right, attack, embarrassed): 목표는 {0}마리다! 이거 다 채우기 전까진 너 집에 못간다!
		local string_key = game_string:Format('pw_challenge_diving_s1_11', self.number_ui.max)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'embarrassed', keep = true },
				{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
				{ key = string_key, skip = true })

		-- 가디언(left, idle, nod 2회) 끝날 때까지 대기
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	end

	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	--고블린 위치에 fx_common_water_splash_out 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_02')
	self.fx:water_splash_out():Instantiate(fisher_goblin.Position)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(fisher_goblin, active_state_type.disabled)

	--고블린(shout 말풍선, 크기 1.3, 위치 중앙 상단): 그럼 시작!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_appear_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(fisher_goblin, 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_12', true, {
		viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.75),
		scale = 1.3,
	})

	--액티비티 진행
	start_coroutine(self.activity_routine, self)
end

function local_class:activity_routine()
	self.is_playing = true
	self.current_state = self.states.start_activity

	--field ui
	field_ui_util.hide_target_ui({
		hide_target = nil,
		hide_minimap = true,
		hide_navigation_bar = false,
	})

	self.number_ui:load()
	self.number_ui:show()
	self.number_ui:set_count(0)

	--물고기 스테이트
	local count = 3
	for num = 1, count do
		local npc = self.npc:fish(num)

		self.fish_info:add(npc.Name, {
			fo = npc,
			current_state = self.fish_state.wait,
			next_state = self.fish_state.surfacing,
			time_passed = 0,
			max_duration = self:get_diving_duration(),
		})

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_car_crash', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	--timer
	local duration = 60
	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = duration, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished', show_ui = true })

	local dt = 0
	while self.is_playing and not self.stage_end do
		dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		self.fish_info:foreach(function(key, _)
			self:fish_update(key, dt)
		end)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--스테이지 나갔을 경우
	if self.stage_end then
		return
	end

	self.number_ui:hide()
	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	if self.is_clear then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.finish_scene, self)
		return
	end

	sp_util.start_scene(self.fail_scene, self)
end

function local_class:fish_update(key, dt)
	local current_info = self.fish_info:get(key)
	local fo = current_info.fo

	if current_info.current_state == self.fish_state.diving then
		--다이빙
		local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0), -0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_03')
		self.fx:water_splash_out():Instantiate(fx_pos)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)

		--스테이트 전환
		current_info.current_state = self.fish_state.wait
		current_info.next_state = self.fish_state.surfacing
		current_info.time_passed = 0
		current_info.max_duration = self:get_diving_duration()
	elseif current_info.current_state == self.fish_state.surfacing then
		local random_pos = self:get_donut_random_pos()

		--물속에서 등장
		--물고기(left, idle, catch)
		scene_util.set_direction(fo, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'catch')
		character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 90, 0)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
		fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(random_pos, -0.8)

		local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0), -0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_03')
		self.fx:water_splash_out():Instantiate(fx_pos)

		--스테이트 전환
		current_info.current_state = self.fish_state.wait
		current_info.next_state = self.fish_state.diving
		current_info.time_passed = 0
		current_info.max_duration = 3
	elseif current_info.current_state == self.fish_state.hit then
		--물고기 랜덤한 방향으로 airSpin
		local dir = unity_class.vector3.right * 3
		local random = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)

		if random == 1 then
			dir = unity_class.vector3.left * 3
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')

		self:air_spin_sync(fo, { offset = dir, play_deathsfx = false })

		--카운트 +1
		self.number_ui:add_count(1)

		if self.number_ui:finish() then
			self.is_clear = true
			self.is_playing = false
		end

		current_info.current_state = self.fish_state.air_spin
	elseif current_info.current_state == self.fish_state.air_spin_end then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fish_stamp_01' })

		current_info.current_state = self.fish_state.wait
		current_info.next_state = self.fish_state.surfacing
		current_info.time_passed = 0
		current_info.max_duration = self:get_diving_duration()
	elseif current_info.current_state == self.fish_state.wait then
		current_info.time_passed = current_info.time_passed + dt

		if current_info.time_passed > current_info.max_duration then
			current_info.current_state = current_info.next_state
		end
	end

	self.fish_info:set(current_info)
end

function local_class:finish_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fisher_goblin = self.npc:fisher_goblin()
	local fx_star_piece = self.fx_data:get('star_piece')

	self.current_state = self.states.activity_clear

	--가디언(smile, victory_extra)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_extra')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	--‘액티비티 완료’ 표시
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--화면 0.75초간 서큘러 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, interpolations_constants.linear)

	--set
	do
		local default_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('diving_goblin_play_pos')

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local npc = self.npc:fish(i)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		leader.Position = default_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 0)

		scene_util.set_direction(fisher_goblin, 'right', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fisher_goblin)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(fisher_goblin, self.controller)
		fisher_goblin.Position = default_pos + vector(0, -0.35, 0)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fisher_goblin, active_state_type.enabled)

		fx_star_piece.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		self.door:open()
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1, volume = 0.6 })

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, interpolations_constants.linear)

	-- 고블린(right, idle, cast): 수고했다, 인간! 덕분에 오늘 굶지 않게 됐다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'cast' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_13', skip = true })

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	-- 고블린(right, idle, eat): 답례로 인간들이 좋아할만한 선물 준다. 잠시만 기다려라….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'eat' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_14', skip = true })

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	-- 고블린(right, idle, get)
	self.fx_data:dispose('star_piece')
	scene_util.set_direction(fisher_goblin, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(fisher_goblin, self, { name = 'get' })

	-- 고블린 위치에서 스타피스 생성되어 이미지의 별표 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	local star_piece = get_field_object('diving_challenge_star_piece')
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, fisher_goblin.Bounds.center, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -2))

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 고블린(right, idle, nod 2회): 인간들은 반짝이는거 좋아한다. 아까 연못 밑에서 주웠다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_15', skip = true })

	-- 고블린(right, idle, release): 난 밥먹으러 이만 가봐야 한다. 잘 있어라, 인간!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fisher_goblin, self,
			{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_16', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_water_splash_03' })

	--고블린 위치에 fx_common_water_splash_out 이펙트 생성
	self.fx:water_splash_out():Instantiate(fisher_goblin.Position)

	--고블린 NPC 제거
	field_object_util.set_active_state(fisher_goblin, active_state_type.disabled)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
	self.controller:complete_quest()
end

function local_class:fail_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fisher_goblin = self.npc:fisher_goblin()
	local fx_star_piece = self.fx_data:get('star_piece')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

	--“실패…” 텍스트 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('pw_challenge_diving_s1_failed'))

	--2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--화면 0.75초간 서큘러 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, interpolations_constants.linear)

	--set
	do
		local default_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('diving_goblin_start_pos')

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local npc = self.npc:fish(i)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		leader.Position = default_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5)

		fx_star_piece.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		scene_util.set_direction(fisher_goblin, 'down', false)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fisher_goblin)
		fisher_goblin.Position = default_pos + vector(0, -0.35, 0)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(fisher_goblin, active_state_type.enabled)

		camera_util.move_async(vector(-500, 0, 500), 0)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, interpolations_constants.linear)

	--선택지
	do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--(mercy) 재시도
			{ 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_choose_3', 'mercy' },
			--(brutal) 포기
			{ 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_choose_4', 'brutal' },
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			fx_star_piece.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self:activity_start_scene()
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, interpolations_constants.linear)
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

			scene_util.set_emotion(fisher_goblin, self, 'attack')

			self.current_state = self.states.before_activity
			self.door:open()

			--고블린(down, attack, embarrassed): 어디 가냐! 거기 서라!
			scene_util.set_anim(fisher_goblin, self, 'embarrassed')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fisher_goblin,
					{ key = 'pw_challenge_diving_s1_6', skip = false })

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, interpolations_constants.linear)

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 1, volume = 1 })
		end
	end
end

--도넛 모양 랜덤 위치 반환
function local_class:get_donut_random_pos()
	local result = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local random_num = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
	local zone_name = 'main_s10_pond_zone_' .. random_num

	result = zone_util.get_random_pos(zone_name)

	return result

end

function local_class:pre_setting()

	self:set_npc_by_data(self.npc_data)

	local fx_star_piece = self.fx:star_piece_in_character():Instantiate(

	for npc_name, info in pairs(data) do

		character_util.set_direction(npc, info.dir)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, info.anim)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, info.emo)
		npc.Interactable.Talk = info.oneline

		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(info.marker_name)
		npc.Position = pos + info.offset
	end

function local_class:air_spin_sync(target, data)

	local speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'speed', 1)
	local stay_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'stay_time', 0.15)
	local explode = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'explode', true)
	local play_deathsfx = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'play_deathsfx', true)

	local spin_state = CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState.Create(target,
			offset, speed, stay_time, explode, play_deathsfx)
	message_system:SendSync(target.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(spin_state))

end

return local_class

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class PixyWorldDokkaebiController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldDokkaebiController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)

	end

	end

function local_class:load_resource()

function local_class:on_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()

	local princess = self.get_princess()

	if user_party:Contains(princess) then
		table.insert(self.party_npc, princess)
	end

		self:setting()
	end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

--- 해당 스테이지 클리어 여부 불러오기
function local_class:load_clear_stage()
	local data = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.clear_stage_custom_key)

	if data < 0 then
		data = 0
	end

	self.is_clear_stage = {}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		self.is_clear_stage['pixyworld_' .. i] = data >> (i - 1) & 0x1
	end
end

--- 해당 스테이지 클리어 여부 저장
function local_class:save_clear_stage()
	local data = 0

	for i = 1, 4 do
		data = data + (self.is_clear_stage['pixyworld_' .. i] << (i - 1))
	end

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.clear_stage_custom_key, data)
end

--- 도망가는 은하
function local_class:runaway_stage()
	local dokkaebi = self.get_dokkaebi()

	local emotion = 'attack'
	local is_run = true
	local speed = 5

	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress == 3 then
		emotion = 'smile'
		is_run = false
		speed = 4
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion(dokkaebi, self, emotion)

	if stage.Name == 'pixyworld_1' then
		local out_screen_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', dokkaebi.Position, -1)

		local wp = {
			dokkaebi.Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5),
			dokkaebi.Position + vector(4, 0, -2.5),
			dokkaebi.Position + vector(4, 0, -5),
			dokkaebi.Position + vector(4, -1, -6),
			vector_util.get_xy0(dokkaebi.Position + vector(4, -1, 0), out_screen_pos.z)
		}

		wp_util.move_async(dokkaebi, wp, speed, nil, { run = is_run, play_sfx = is_run })

	elseif stage.Name == 'pixyworld_2' then
		wp_util.move_async(dokkaebi, dokkaebi.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			speed, nil, { run = is_run, play_sfx = is_run })

		local out_screen_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up',
			dokkaebi.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0), 1)

		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(dokkaebi, out_screen_pos, { z = dokkaebi.Position.z + 1.5 })

		wp_util.move_async(dokkaebi, wp, speed, nil, { run = is_run, play_sfx = is_run })

	elseif stage.Name == 'pixyworld_3' then
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress == 3 then
			local out_screen_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down',
				dokkaebi.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), -1)

			local wp = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(dokkaebi, out_screen_pos, { z = dokkaebi.Position.z - 0.5 })

			wp_util.move_async(dokkaebi, wp, speed, nil, { run = is_run, play_sfx = is_run })
		else
			local wp = {
				dokkaebi.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
				dokkaebi.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
			}

			wp_util.move_async(dokkaebi, wp, speed, nil,
				{ run = is_run, play_sfx = is_run, last_direction = 'right' })

			local duration = 0.5

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = dokkaebi })
			character_util.jump(dokkaebi, 1, duration)

			character_util.move_to_async(dokkaebi, dokkaebi.Position + vector(4, 0, 0), duration)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			for i = 1, 4 do
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = dokkaebi })
				character_util.jump(dokkaebi, 1, duration)

				character_util.move_to_async(dokkaebi, dokkaebi.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), duration)

				wait_for_sec(0.2)
			end
		end

	elseif stage.Name == 'pixyworld_4' then
		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress ~= 3 then
			local duration = 0.7

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = dokkaebi })
			character_util.jump(dokkaebi, 1, duration)

			character_util.set_direction(dokkaebi, 'left')
			character_util.move_to_async(dokkaebi, dokkaebi.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), duration)
		end

		local out_screen_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left',
			dokkaebi.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), -1)

		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(dokkaebi, out_screen_pos)

		wp_util.move_async(dokkaebi, wp, speed, nil, { run = is_run, play_sfx = is_run })
	end

	dokkaebi.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(dokkaebi, active_state_type.disabled)

	self.is_clear_stage[stage.Name] = 1

	self:save_clear_stage()
end

--- 은하 등장 연출
function local_class:appear_dokkaebi(str_key)
	local dokkaebi = self.get_dokkaebi()
	local hide_obj = self.get_hide_obj()

	local hide_obj_center = vector_util.get_x0z(hide_obj.Bounds.center, hide_obj.Position.y)

	-- 플레이어 은하옵젝에 인터렉트 시 지정 위치에 right, idle, idle로 정렬. 이후 나레이션 출력.
	character_util.align_npc_group(self.party_npc,
		hide_obj_center + self.align_offset, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	local stage_data = {
		pixyworld_1 = {
			-- …나뭇가지의 색 하나가 묘하게 다르다…
			narration_key = 'pw_dokkaebi_narration_1',
			sfx = '03_runaway_01'
		},
		pixyworld_2 = {
			-- …픽시 마을의 음식과는 다른 것 같다…
			narration_key = 'pw_dokkaebi_narration_2',
			sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_02'
		},
		pixyworld_3 = {
			-- …바위에 색이 다른 무엇인가가 솟아있다…
			narration_key = 'pw_dokkaebi_narration_3',
			sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_01'
		},
		pixyworld_4 = {
			-- …이 꽃만 색이 다른 것 같다…
			narration_key = 'pw_dokkaebi_narration_4',
			sfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01'
		},
	}

	local data = stage_data[stage.Name]

	-- 나레이션
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = data.narration_key, mintotalduration = 1 })

	-- 나레이션 종료 후 은하 옵젝 세기 0.03으로 shake 지속 상태 2초 진행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_01')

	field_object_util.shake(hide_obj, 0.03, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 은하옵젝
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(data.sfx)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hide_obj, self, nil, nil, nil, str_key)

	-- 이후 은하 옵젝 중심으로 아래의 연출들 순서대로 실행.
	-- FX_Common_SmokeScreen 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

	self.get_smoke_pool():Instantiate(hide_obj_center + vector(0, 0.03, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 이펙트로 가려ㄴ진 타이밍에 은하 옵젝 제거.
	dokkaebi.Position = hide_obj_center
	character_util.set_direction(dokkaebi, 'down')
	field_object_util.set_active_state(dokkaebi, active_state_type.enabled)

	hide_obj.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

--- 스타피스 등장
function local_class:appear_star_piece()
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, self.get_dokkaebi().Position, star_piece.Position)
end

function local_class:setting()
	if star_piece_util.has_star_piece('dokkaebi_star_piece') == true then
		return
	end

	self:load_clear_stage()

	if (self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil and self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete) or self.is_clear_stage[stage.Name] == 1 then
		-- 해당 스테이지 클리어 했을 때
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.get_star_piece(), active_state_type.enabled)

	elseif self.is_clear_stage[stage.Name] == 0 then
		-- 아직 클리어 하지 못 했을 때
		local hide_obj = self.get_hide_obj()
		hide_obj.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('dokkaebi_obj_pos')
		hide_obj.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		if stage.Name == 'pixyworld_4' then
			local obj = self.get_hide_obj()
			obj.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(5, 1, 1))
			self.align_offset = vector(-3, 0, 0)
		else
			self.align_offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		end
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldDokkaebiPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = PixyWorldDokkaebi @
		Comment = PixyWorldDokkaebi 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldDokkaebiController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'pixyworld_1'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		meeting = 2,
		talking = 3
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- npc
	self.get_garam = function()
		return get_character('dokkaebi_garam')
	end

	self.get_blink_pool = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blink')
	end
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_blink_pool()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.get_garam(), active_state_type.enabled)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_garam(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.meeting and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_garam()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talking

		sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_garam, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'dokkaebi_meet_garam_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.meeting

		local garam = self.get_garam()

		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(garam)

		-- 가람 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 흠… 이건 아니군…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(garam, { key = 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_1' })

		character_util.add_listener(garam, self.controller)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 가람과 대화
function local_class:talk_garam()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local garam = self.get_garam()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(garam)

	quest_icon_util.remove(garam)

	-- 플레이어 인터렉트 시 지정된 위치에 정렬.
	character_util.align_npc_group(self.controller.party_npc, garam.Position, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	if self.is_talked then
		-- 가람 (left, idle, idle) : 아, 자네군. 날 도와줄 마음이 들었나?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_16')

	else
		-- 가람 (left, idle, idle) : 아, 자네인가. 이런 곳에서 만나다니. 참으로 기묘하군.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(garam)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_2')

		-- 플레이어 up, idle, release 2회 실행 후 0.5초 대기.
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 가람 (left, idle, idle) : 우리 신선들이야 바람에 몸을 맡겨 여행다닐 뿐이니.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_3')

		-- 가람 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 자네가 날 찾아온 것이나 다름이 없지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_4')

		-- 가람 (left, idle, idle) : 그리고 이번에는…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_5')

		-- 가람 right, idle, idle을 실행하며 머리 위로 이모션 버블(silence)를 실행한다.
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(garam, self, 'right', nil, nil, 'silence')

		-- 가람 (right, idle, idle) : 한 아이의 수행을 돕고 있었다네.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_6')

		-- 가람 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 흠. 사실은…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_7')

		-- 가람 left, idle, idle 상태로 머리 위에 이모션 버블(notice)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')

		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(garam, self, 'left', nil, nil, 'notice')

		-- 가람 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : …미리 알려주지 않는 편이 자네와 그 아이에게 도움이 되겠군.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_8')

		-- 가람 (left, idle, idle) : 내 부탁 하나 하지. 이 근처에 뭔가 신묘한 것들이 있다면 한번 확인해주겠나?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_9')

		-- 가람 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 이 근방이나… 저 멀리 다른 곳에 있을 수도 있다네.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_10')

		-- 가람 (left, tired, idle) : 나는… 너무 쉽게 찾아버려 방해가 되고 있거든.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_11')

		-- 가람 (left, idle, idle) : 어때, 괜찮겠나?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_12')
	end

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.cs_controller.QuestId, false)

	if not accepted then
		-- 플레이어 (right, idle, cross_arm)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cross_arm')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 가람 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 흠… 아쉽게 되었군.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_15')

		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(garam)

		self.current_state = self.states.meeting

		self.is_talked = true

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		return
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(garam, self.controller)

	-- 플레이어 right, idle, nod 2회 실행 후 0.5초 대기.
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(leader, self.cs_controller.QuestSpec.QuestName, 0)
	screen_util.quest_accept_event(false, false)

	-- 가람 (left, idle, idle) : 좋네. 그럼 부탁하지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
		nil, nil, 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_13')

	-- 가람 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 부디… 그 아이를 즐겁게 해주게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, 'left',
		nil, 'sleep_deep', 'pw_dokkaebi_pre_14')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')

	-- 가람 Fx_blink를 실행하며 제거.
	self.get_blink_pool():Instantiate(garam.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))
	garam.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(garam, active_state_type.disabled)

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀
	self.controller:setting()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.controller:activate_quest()
end

return local_class

function local_class:find_dokkaebi()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local dokkaebi = self.get_dokkaebi()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		garam = 'pw_garam'
	})

	local garam = dynamic_npcs.garam

	-- ……으으 포기할게요…! 정말 대단한 통찰력이시군요!
	self.controller:appear_dokkaebi('pw_dokkaebi_s4_1')

	if stage.Name == 'pixyworld_4' then
		local duration = 0.7

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = dokkaebi })
		character_util.jump(dokkaebi, 1, duration)

		character_util.set_direction(dokkaebi, 'left')
		character_util.move_to_async(dokkaebi, dokkaebi.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), duration)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 은하 (left, damaged, cast) : 에구… 이제 변신할 도력이 떨어졌네요…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, 'left',
		nil, nil, 'pw_dokkaebi_s4_2')

	-- 은하 (left, attack, jump 1회) : 정말이지 신묘한 분이시군요! 제 변신을 이리 쉽게도 간파하다니…!

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dokkaebi)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, 'left',
		nil, 'attack', 'pw_dokkaebi_s4_3')

	-- 은하 (left, tired, idle) : 어쩌면 신선님들처럼 도술을 쓰신다거나…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dokkaebi, self, 'left',
		nil, 'tired', 'pw_dokkaebi_s4_4')

	-- 대사는 화면 상단에 말풍선 없이 출력.
	-- 가람 : 은하야, 놀랄 필요는 없다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(garam, self, nil, nil, nil,
		{ key = 'pw_dokkaebi_s4_5', skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-100, 300) })

	-- 이후 플레이어 1타일 아래에 위치에 Fx_blick를 실행하며 가람 right, idle, idle 상태로 생성.
	garam.Position = leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_direction(garam, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')

	self.get_blink_pool():Instantiate(garam.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))

	-- 은하 (left, attack, jump 1회) : 신선님? 신선님의 손님일까요?
	character_util.normal_jump(dokkaebi, '01_small_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(pixy_2, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(pixy_2, self, { name = 'attack',count = 1, sfx_name = '01_throw_far_01' })

	item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = pixy_2.Position,
		target = pixy_2.Position + vector(-8, 0, 20),
		itemid = self.item_id.boomerang,
		--show_on_character = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		-- 획득시 아이템 이름은 표시되지 않음
		skip_text = true,
		-- 크기 0.5
		sprscale = 0.5,
	})

	-- 동시에 화면 shake 0.05세기로 0.3초간 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.07,0.3)

	-- 부메랑아이템 스프라이트는 (-62, 0 ,65) 위치에서 0.3초에 걸쳐 (-70, 20, 65) 위치로 이동
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 동시에 1번 NPC, 2번 NPC (left, surprise, idle) 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', parent = pixy_2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', parent = pixy_2 })

	scene_util.set_direction(pixy_1, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pixy_1, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(pixy_1, false)

	scene_util.set_direction(pixy_2, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pixy_2, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(pixy_1, false)

	item:ConsumeComplete()
	item = nil

	wait_for_sec(2)

	self:setting_clear_npc()

end

function local_class:setting_clear_npc()
	local pixy_1 = self.npc.pixy(1)
	local pixy_2 = self.npc.pixy(2)


	-- 1번 NPC (right, smile, idle): 이제 약하게 던져야 돼! 알겠지?
	scene_util.set_direction(pixy_1, 'right', false)

	scene_util.set_direction(pixy_2, 'left', false)

end

		enter_zone_before = 2,

		on_going_doodle_jump = 4,
		retry_doodle_jump = 5,
		success_doodle_jump = 6
	}
	self.current_state = self.states.enter_zone_before

	--두들점프 관련 변수들
	self.game_constants_key = 'pixy_world_rock_climb_hard'

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	self:setting_on_enter()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.interact_npc_before and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npc.pixy(1)) or
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npc.pixy(2)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_npc, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.retry_doodle_jump and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npc.pixy(1)) or
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npc.pixy(2)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_npc_retry, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.enter_zone_before and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.hard_npc) then
		start_coroutine(self.enter_hard_zone, self)
		--start_coroutine(self.start_mini_game, self)
		--start_coroutine(self.controller.epilogue, self.controller)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.mini_game_name or
			self.current_state ~= self.states.on_going_doodle_jump then
		return false
	end

	if e.Success then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.clear_mini_game, self)
	else
		sp_util.start_scene(self.fail_mini_game, self)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:setting_on_enter()
	local pixy_1 = self.npc.pixy(1)
	local pixy_2 = self.npc.pixy(2)

	-- 1 (right, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(pixy_1, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pixy_1, self, 'tired')
	pixy_1.Interactable.Talk = nil

	-- 2 (left, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(pixy_2, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pixy_2, self, 'tired')
	pixy_2.Interactable.Talk = nil

end

function local_class:enter_hard_zone()
	local pixy_1 = self.npc.pixy(1)
	local pixy_2 = self.npc.pixy(2)

	self.current_state = self.states.interact_npc_before
	-- 아래 존 진입 시 비 강제 연출 진행

	-- 1번 NPC (right, tired, idle): 그러게 왜 이리 세게 날린 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pixy_1, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_doodle_jump_5', skip = false })

	-- 2번 NPC (left, tired, cast): 너무 신나서 그만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pixy_2, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_doodle_jump_6', skip = false })

	--이후 1번, 2번 NPC 인터렉트 가능
	character_util.add_listener(pixy_1, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(pixy_2, self.controller)
end

function local_class:interact_npc()
	local pixy_girl = self.npc.pixy_girl()
	local pixy_1 = self.npc.pixy(1)
	local pixy_2 = self.npc.pixy(2)

	--컨트롤 뻇길 떄 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 인터렉트 하면 아래와 같이 정렬
	party_util.align_to_target(pixy_1, 'left', 1)

	if not self.is_interacted_npc then
		-- 코르네 (right, idle, idle): 너희들 여기서 뭐 하는 거야?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(pixy_1, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(pixy_2, 'left', false)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pixy_girl, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,

function local_class:start_mini_game()
	self:move_leader_for_hide_marker()

	self.current_state = self.states.on_going_doodle_jump

	--실제 진짜 함수
	start_coroutine(self.start_mini_game_routine, self)
end

-- 퀘스트 마커 지우는 걸 퀘스트 마다 하나하나 처리하는 건 너무 종속적임
-- 미니게임 중 리더를 퀘스트 마커 데이터가 none_data가 들어가 있는 존으로 잠시 옮겨 줌.
function local_class:move_leader_for_hide_marker()
	local quest_marker_hide_pos = self.marker.doodle_jump_game_pos(3)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	leader.Position = quest_marker_hide_pos
end

function local_class:start_mini_game_routine()
	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

	self.mini_game_loaded = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, self.game_constants_key, function()
		self.mini_game_loaded = true
	end)

	while not self.mini_game_loaded do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

	self.key_stone_event_zone_names = {

		[self.key_stone_event_zone_names.third]  = false
	}

	self.each_key_stone_area_scene = {
		[self.key_stone_event_zone_names.first]  = self.scene_entered_first_key_stone_area,
		[self.key_stone_event_zone_names.second] = self.scene_entered_second_key_stone_area,
		[self.key_stone_event_zone_names.third]  = self.scene_entered_third_key_stone_area
	}

	self.key_stone_quest_marker = {
		constants_key = 'sub_eastworld',
		key_fmt = 'east_world_%d',
		zone = 'main_field',

		add = function(this, target, key)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.constants_key, {
				{ zone = this.zone, target = target }
			}, key)
		end,

		remove = function(this, key)
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(nil, key)
		end
	}

	self.warp_device_quest_marker = {
		constants_key = 'sub_eastworld',
		key = 'warp_device',

		add = function(this)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.constants_key, {
				{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.gimmicks.warp_device() }
			}, this.key)
		end,

		remove = function(this)

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_item_get_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:add_quest_marker_on_each_key_stone_if_not_acquired()
	self.gimmicks.warp_device().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.gimmicks.warp_device().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.game_ended = true
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))

end

	self.controller = nil

	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if e.FullEnter and
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) and
		not self.has_entered_key_stone_zone[zone_name] and
		self.each_key_stone_area_scene[zone_name] ~= nil then

		self.has_entered_key_stone_zone[zone_name] = true

		sp_util.start_scene(self.each_key_stone_area_scene[zone_name], self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.gimmicks.warp_device()) then
		local has_acquired_all_key_stone = self.num_acquired_key_stones == 3

		if has_acquired_all_key_stone then
			start_coroutine(self.scene_interacted_warp_device_with_all_key_stones, self)
		else
			if not self.is_warp_device_showing_message then
				start_coroutine(self.scene_interacted_warp_device_without_all_key_stones, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if table_util.contain_value(self.key_stone_id, e.Item.ItemId) then
		self.key_stone_quest_marker:remove(e.Item.ItemId)
		self.num_acquired_key_stones = self.num_acquired_key_stones + 1

		if self.num_acquired_key_stones == 3 then
			self.warp_device_quest_marker:add()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:add_quest_marker_on_each_key_stone_if_not_acquired()
	if not self.key_stones[self.key_stone_id.first]().IsGetted then
		self.key_stone_quest_marker:add(self.key_stones[self.key_stone_id.first](), self.key_stone_id.first)
	end

		self.key_stone_quest_marker:add(self.key_stones[self.key_stone_id.second](), self.key_stone_id.second)
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do

		wp_util.move(user_party[i], target_pos, nil, party_align_duration, {

	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_shield_01')

	-- 가디언은 FX_teleportsphere_red 이펙트

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 화면 1초간 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	magic_circle:Dispose()
	magic_circle = nil

	local lily = self.characters.lily()

	self.controller:progress_section()

return local_class

local sfx_controller = newclass('SfxController')

function sfx_controller:init(sfx_name)
	self.sfx_name = sfx_name
	self.instance = nil
end

function sfx_controller:play(volume, mix_duration)
	if self.instance == nil then
		self.instance = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = self.sfx_name,
			volume = volume,
			fade_in_time = mix_duration,
			loop = true
		})
	else
		self:change_volume(volume, mix_duration)
	end
end

function sfx_controller:stop()
	self.instance:Stop()
end

function sfx_controller:dispose()
	self.instance = nil
end

function sfx_controller:change_volume(target_volume, duration)
	music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(self.instance, target_volume, duration)
end

local local_class = newclass('PixyworldPixyEastWorldSection2')

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능

	self.pamplet_name_prefix = 'pamphlet_'

		pamplets = {},

		create = function(this)
			local item_id = 21294
			local num_items = 3
			local fo_name_fmt = 'pamphlet_%d'

			for i = 1, num_items do
				local fo = get_field_object(fo_name_fmt:format(i))
				local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
					pos = fo.Position,
					itemid = item_id,
					lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				})
				table.insert(this.pamplets, item)
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			for _, v in ipairs(this.pamplets) do
				v:ConsumeComplete()
				v = nil
			end

			this.pamplets = nil
		end,

		show = function(this)

				v.SpriteTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				v.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end

				v.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.controller:load_typing_text()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	self:set_field_tint()

	self.controller:remove_all_party_members_except_knight_n_princess()

	self:set_playable_characters_at_start_point()

	animator_util.play(self.gimmicks.warp_device(), 'on')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.quest_marker_controller:add(self.gimmicks.lever())

	self.potion:create()
	self.pamplet_controller:create()

	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.characters.princess(), self, 'scared')
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_stage_entry, self)
	else
		self.lab_bgm_sfx:play(0.8, 6)
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.characters.princess(), self, 'tired')
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self:remove_darkness_stencil_mask()
	self.potion:dispose()
	self.pamplet_controller:dispose()

	self.lab_bgm_sfx:dispose()
	self.computer_bgm_sfx:dispose()
	self.error_bgm_sfx:dispose()

	if self.crt_filter_screen ~= nil then
		self.crt_filter_screen:Dispose()
		self.crt_filter_screen = nil
	end

	if self.glitch_effect_screen ~= nil then
		self.glitch_effect_screen:Dispose()
		self.glitch_effect_screen = nil
	end

	if self.glitch_effect_no_white ~= nil then
		self.glitch_effect_no_white:Dispose()
		self.glitch_effect_no_white = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.dected_by_cctv_key then
			switch(e.Sender, {
				[self.characters.cctv_by_idx(1)] = function()
					if not self.cctv_detection_state[1] then
						start_coroutine(self.cctv_detection_routine, self, 1)
					end
				end,

				[self.characters.cctv_by_idx(2)] = function()
					if not self.cctv_detection_state[2] then
						start_coroutine(self.cctv_detection_routine, self, 2)
					end
				end
			})
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target
	local target_name = target.Name

	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.gimmicks.lever()) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_lever_interacted, self)
		elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.gimmicks.monitor()) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_monitor_interacted_no_power, self)
		end
	elseif self.current_state >= self.states.power_on and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.gimmicks.monitor()) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_monitor_interacted, self)

	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.gimmicks.potion()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_found_the_cure, self)

	elseif string.match(target_name, self.pamplet_name_prefix) ~= nil then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.pamplet_interact_callback[target_name], self)
	end
end

function local_class:set_playable_characters_at_start_point()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(princess, active_state_type.enabled)

	local leader_init_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('leader_ruins_start')
	local princess_init_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('princess_ruins_start')

	local height_adj = vector(0, 8, 0)

	local leader_pos = self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis and leader_init_pos
														or leader_init_pos + height_adj

	local princess_pos = self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis and princess_init_pos
														or princess_init_pos + height_adj

	camera_util.move((leader_init_pos + princess_init_pos) / 2, 0)

	character_util.set_position(leader, leader_pos)
	character_util.set_position(princess, princess_pos)

	character_util.set_group_direction({ leader, princess }, 'down')
end

function local_class:set_field_tint()
	field_util.darken('ruin_field', 0.5, 0)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	self.darkness_stencil_mask = self.fx.darkness_target()
		:Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 4.7, -3), unity_class.quaternion.identity, leader.Transform)
	self.darkness_stencil_mask.transform.localScale = vector(1, 0, 1)
	self.darkness_background = self.fx.darkness_background()
		:Instantiate(stage_camera.transform.position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
	unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.transform)
	self.darkness_background.transform.localScale = vector(6, 1, 3)
end

function local_class:remove_field_tint(duration)
	field_util.undarken('ruin_field', duration)
end

function local_class:remove_darkness_stencil_mask()
	if self.darkness_stencil_mask ~= nil then
		self.darkness_stencil_mask:Dispose()
		self.darkness_stencil_mask = nil
	end

	if self.darkness_background ~= nil then
		self.darkness_background:Dispose()
		self.darkness_background = nil
	end
end

function local_class:cctv_detection_routine(idx)
	self.cctv_detection_state[idx] = true

	local cctv = self.characters.cctv_by_idx(idx)

	while self.cctv_detection_state[idx] do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_focus_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(cctv, 'pw_eastworld_61', false)

		wait_for_sec(0.125)

		self.cctv_detection_state[idx] = self:is_player_contains_detection_range(cctv)
	end
end

function local_class:is_player_contains_detection_range(cctv)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local diff = leader.Bounds.center - cctv.Bounds.center;
	local sight_dist = 4

	if (diff.magnitude > sight_dist) then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0;
	diff:Normalize()

	if (unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff, direction_util.to_vector3(cctv.Direction)) > 30) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:show_typing_text(key, wait, with_sfx)
	if wait then
		if with_sfx then
			start_coroutine(function()
				-- Progress = 0 실행까지 한프레임 대기
				coroutine.yield(nil)

				local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '03_dialogue_02', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
				})

				while self.controller.typing_text.Progress < 1 do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				sfx:Stop()
			end)
		end

		yield_return_func(self.controller.typing_text.SetTypedText, self.controller.typing_text,
				game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key), 1000, 0.03)
	else
		start_coroutine_enumerator(self.controller.typing_text:SetTypedText(
				game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key), 1000, 0.03))
	end
end

function local_class:warp_turning(fo, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local dir_step = {
		'left',
		'up',
		'right',
		'down'
	}
	local dir_idx = 1

	local dir_term = 0.1
	local dir_time_paseed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		dir_time_paseed = dir_time_paseed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if dir_time_paseed >= dir_term then
			character_util.set_direction(fo, dir_step[dir_idx])
			dir_idx = (dir_idx % #dir_step) + 1
			dir_time_paseed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:scene_stage_entry()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()

	local warp_move_dist = vector(0, -8, 0)

	local move_duration = 2.5

	--화면 1초간 페이드인. 끝날 때까지 대기
	self.lab_bgm_sfx:play(0.8, 6, true)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_04')
	start_coroutine(self.warp_turning, self, princess, move_duration)
	start_coroutine(self.warp_turning, self, leader, move_duration)

	wp_util.move(princess, princess.Position + warp_move_dist, nil, move_duration)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + warp_move_dist, nil, move_duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_princess_shoot_02')

	character_util.remove_anim(princess)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	self.controller.warp_red.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.controller.warp_blue.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.controller.warp_red.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.controller.warp_blue.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.controller.warp_red:Dispose()
	self.controller.warp_blue:Dispose()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(princess, user_party, false)
end

function local_class:scene_monitor_interacted()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()
	local monitor = self.gimmicks.monitor()

	-- 가디언&공주 1초간 이미지와 같이 정렬. 끝날 때까지 대기
	-- 가디언(up, idle, idle)
	-- 공주(up, tired, idle)
	local move_duration = 1
	local num_ended = 0

	wp_util.move(princess, field_util.get_marker_pos('princess_monitor_pos'), nil, move_duration, {
		last_direction = 'up',
		end_callback = function()
			num_ended = num_ended + 1
		end
	})

	wp_util.move(leader, field_util.get_marker_pos('leader_monitor_pos'), nil, move_duration, {
		last_direction = 'up',
		end_callback = function()
			num_ended = num_ended + 1
		end
	})

	while num_ended ~= 2 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 모니터 : 시스템 전력이 부족하여 기능이 제한됩니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(monitor, 'pw_eastworld_62', true)

	-- 모니터 : 최근 감시 카메라 영상을 확인하시겠습니까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(monitor, 'pw_eastworld_63', true)

	-- 플레이어 선택지
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- (intellect) 연구실 복도 감시카메라 영상
		{ 'pw_eastworld_branch_1_1', 'intellect', function()
			self.lab_bgm_sfx:change_volume(0, 4)
			self.computer_bgm_sfx:play(1, 4)
			self.error_bgm_sfx:play(0.3, 4)

			-- 화면 1초간 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			-- 연구실 복도 영상 이벤트 실행
			self:scene_lab_isle_event()
		end },
		-- (forced) 배양실 감시카메라 영상
		{ 'pw_eastworld_branch_1_2', 'forced', function()
			self.lab_bgm_sfx:change_volume(0, 4)
			self.computer_bgm_sfx:play(1, 4)
			self.error_bgm_sfx:play(0.3, 4)
			
			-- 화면 1초간 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			-- 배양실 영상 이벤트 실행
			self:scene_culture_room_event()
		end },
		-- (normal) 물러난다.
		{ 'pw_eastworld_branch_1_3', 'normal', },
	})

	if not self.has_interacted_monitor then
		self.has_interacted_monitor = true
		self.quest_marker_controller:add(self.gimmicks.potion())
	end
end

function local_class:prepare_for_cctv_video_scene()
	self.lab_bgm_sfx:change_volume(0, 4)

	local lily = self.characters.lily()
	local fairy = self.characters.fairy()

	self.pamplet_controller:hide()

	self.crt_filter_screen = self.fx:crt_filter():Instantiate(
		stage_camera.transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)

	self.glitch_effect_screen = self.fx:glitch_effect_screen():Instantiate(
			stage_camera.transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)

	field_util.tint('cctv', unity_color({ 0 / 255, 280 / 255,  0/ 255 }), 0)

	local fo_tint = unity_color({ 70 / 255, 100 / 255, 70 / 255, 0.5 })

	field_object_util.set_active_state(lily, active_state_type.enabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(fairy, active_state_type.enabled)

	character_util.add_color(lily, lily.Name, fo_tint, 1, 0)

	character_util.add_color(fairy, fairy.Name, fo_tint, 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fairy, 0.0, 0)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local cctv = self.characters.cctv_by_idx(i)
		character_util.add_color(cctv, cctv.Name, fo_tint, 1, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:set_fairty_effect()
	
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.glitch_effect_no_white, nil) then
		local fairy = self.characters.fairy()
		
		self.glitch_effect_no_white = self.fx:glitch_effect_no_white():Instantiate(
			fairy.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, fairy.Transform
		)
		local effect_material = self.glitch_effect_no_white.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

		effect_material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 0.15 }))
		self.glitch_effect_no_white.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:fairy_talk_routine()
	local fairy = self.characters.fairy()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_05')
	self.glitch_effect_no_white.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fairy, 0.15, 0)

	scene_util.set_anim(fairy, self, { name = 'cast' })

	-- 3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(3)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fairy, 0, 0)

	self.glitch_effect_no_white.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
end

function local_class:scene_lab_isle_event()
	self:prepare_for_cctv_video_scene()

	local lily = self.characters.lily()
	local fairy = self.characters.fairy()

	character_util.set_position(lily, field_util.get_marker_pos('lily_isle_start_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(lily, 'up')

	character_util.set_position(fairy, field_util.get_marker_pos('fairy_isle_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(fairy, 'down')

	camera_util.move_async(lily.Position, 0, { end_target = lily })

	-- 화면 1초간 페이드 인 시작
	screen_util.fade_in(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 리리 3초간 위로 6칸 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 리리(up, idle, idle) silence 이모티콘 출력

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(lily, nil, 'silence')

	-- 리리(up, idle, idle): …뜻밖의 장소에서 뵙는군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lily, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_8', skip = true })

	-- 리리(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(lily, 'up', false)

	-- 카메라 2초간 이미지의 노란색 마름모 지점으로 이동 .끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('isle_video_cam_pos'), 2)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:set_fairty_effect()

	self:fairy_talk_routine()

	-- 인도자(down, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim(fairy)

	-- 리리(up, idle, idle): 아, 절 감시하는 거였군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lily, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_9', skip = true })

	-- 리리(up, idle, bomb_idle): 이걱정말아요. 저는… 이미 제 길을 정했으니까.

				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_10', skip = true })

	-- 리리(left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(lily, 'left', true)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 리리(right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(lily, 'right', true)

	-- 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 리리(up, idle, release): 그나저나 이 시설은 정령들의 고향이라기엔 너무 삭막하네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lily, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = '01_swing_01' },
				{ name = 'release' },
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_14', skip = true })

	self:fairy_talk_routine()

	-- 인도자(down, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim(fairy)

	-- 리리(up, idle, idle): 당신의 작품들이 아름답다는 건 알아요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lily, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_15', skip = true })

	-- 리리(up, idle, bomb_idle): 다만 좀더 완벽했으면, 챔피언이 역병으로 죽어갈 일은 없었을 거라는 거죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lily, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_16', skip = true })

	self:fairy_talk_routine()

	-- 인도자(down, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim(fairy)

	-- 리리(up, idle, idle): …그 이름은 빠지지 않는 곳이 없군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lily, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_17', skip = true })

	-- 리리(up, idle, idle): 그 사람이 세 번째 구도자였죠?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lily, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_18', skip = true })

	self:fairy_talk_routine()

	-- 인도자(down, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim(fairy)

	-- 리리(up, idle, idle): 뭐… 저도 그게 최선이었다고는 생각해요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lily, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_19', skip = true })

	-- 리리(up, idle, idle): 케이든은 그렇게 되지 않으면 좋겠는데 말이죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lily, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_20', skip = true })

function local_class:end_cctv_video()
	self.computer_bgm_sfx:change_volume(0, 4)
	self.error_bgm_sfx:change_volume(0, 4)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	field_util.remove_tint('cctv', 0)

	self.pamplet_controller:show()

	character_util.remove_group_anim({ self.characters.lily(), self.characters.fairy() })
	character_util.remove_group_emotion({ self.characters.lily(), self.characters.fairy() })

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local cctv = self.characters.cctv_by_idx(i)
		character_util.remove_color(cctv, cctv.Name, 0)
	end

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.characters.lily(), active_state_type.disabled)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.characters.fairy(), active_state_type.disabled)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	self.crt_filter_screen:Dispose()
	self.crt_filter_screen = nil

	self.glitch_effect_screen:Dispose()
	self.glitch_effect_screen = nil

	self.glitch_effect_no_white:Dispose()
	self.glitch_effect_no_white = nil

	self.lab_bgm_sfx:change_volume(0.8, 4)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()

	local door_top = self.gimmicks.door_top()
	local door_bottom = self.gimmicks.door_bottom()

	if door_top.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpen and door_bottom.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpen then
		return
	end

	local cam_pos = (door_top.Position + door_bottom.Position) / 2

	character_util.set_group_direction({ leader, princess }, 'right')

	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 1)

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_top.Name, false))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_bottom.Name, false))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:scene_reading_second_pamphlet()

	-- 이용시 주의사항
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'pw_eastworld_36' })
