function local_class:scene_found_the_cure()
	self.quest_marker_controller:remove()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.characters.princess()

	-- 가디언&공주 1초간 이미지의 위치로 정렬. 끝날 때까지 대기
	local move_duration = 1
	local num_ended = 0

	wp_util.move(princess, field_util.get_marker_pos('princess_positon_pos'), nil, move_duration, {
		last_direction = 'up',
		end_callback = function()
			num_ended = num_ended + 1
		end
	})

	wp_util.move(leader, field_util.get_marker_pos('leader_positon_pos'), nil, move_duration, {
		last_direction = 'up',
		end_callback = function()
			num_ended = num_ended + 1
		end
	})

	while num_ended ~= 2 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true
	})

	-- 가디언(right, idle, eat)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'eat' })

	-- 공주(left, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'tired')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 공주(left, tired, idle): 저… $name, 이제 그만 나가면 안될까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				nil,
				{ name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_44', skip = true })

	-- 공주(left, tired, cast): 전에 이런곳을 본 적이 있어. 캔터베리 성 지하에 있었는데….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast' },
				{ name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_45', skip = true })

	-- 공주(left, scared, idle, jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'scared')
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)

	-- 가디언 타겟으로 포션 아이템 획득 처리
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	self.potion:consumed_to(leader)

	-- 획득시 아이템 이름은 출력하지 않음

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- ItemGet 연출

	-- sprite: blue_potion
	-- title: 정체불명의 포션
	-- subtitle: 유통기한은 안 지났나?
	-- desc: 플라스크에 붙은 스티커에 “오류 객체 보완용” 이라 적혀있습니다.
	screen_util.item_get_event('pw_eastworld_potion',
		'pw_eastworld_potion_title',
		'pw_eastworld_potion_sub_title',
		'pw_eastworld_potion_desc')

	-- 가디언(right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

	-- 공주(left, damaged, embarrassed): 그, 그걸 왜 주워!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'embarrassed' },
				{ name = 'damaged' },
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_48', skip = true })

	-- 공주(left, damaged, cast2): 언니가 유적의 물건은 함부로 건드리지 말라고 했는데….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast2' },
				{ name = 'damaged' },
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_49', skip = true })

	-- 공주(left, damaged, cast2)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, { name = 'cast2' })

	-- 선택지

	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- (intellect) 잡템 하나도 소중히 해야 부자가 되는거에요.
		{ 'pw_eastworld_branch_2_1', 'intellect', function()
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		end },
		-- (brutal) 그렇게 겁줘도 포기 안해요. 이건 제꺼에요.
		{ 'pw_eastworld_branch_2_2', 'brutal', function()
			-- 가디언(right, attack, release)
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'release' })

			-- 1초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1)

			-- 가디언(right, attack, idle)
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		end },
	})

	local earth_quake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_earthquake_05', loop = true, volume = 0.8, fade_in_time = 3
	})

	-- 카메라 shake(0.4, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.05, 99999)
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 99999)

	-- 가디언(right, scared, embarrassed, jump 1회)
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)

	-- 공주(left, damaged, embarrassed, jump 1회)
	character_util.normal_jump(princess)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)

	-- 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 자막: 허가받지 않은 움직임을 감지했습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bunker_ui_01')
	self:show_typing_text('pw_eastworld_announce_2', true, true)

	-- 자막: 보안을 위해 시설을 폐쇄합니다.
	self:show_typing_text('pw_eastworld_announce_3', true, true)

				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'cast2' },
				{ name = 'damaged' },
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_52', skip = true })

	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0)

	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = get_party_leader()
	})
	-- 가디언과 공주 2초간 아래 방향으로 14칸 달려서 이동 시작

	local run_duration = 2

	wp_util.move(princess, princess.Position + run_dist,  nil, run_duration)

	wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position + run_dist, nil, run_duration )

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 화면 2초간 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
	self.lab_bgm_sfx:change_volume(0, 5)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.lab_bgm_sfx:stop()

	earth_quake_sfx:Stop()
	earth_quake_sfx = nil

	run_sfx:Stop()
	run_sfx = nil

	-- 화면 가려진 동안 세팅

	-- 파티 멤버 2~4(left, surprise, idle)

	for i = 1, #self.controller.cached_party_members do

		character_util.set_position(self.controller.cached_party_members[i], target_pos)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.controller.cached_party_members[i], active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_direction(self.controller.cached_party_members[i], 'left')

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')

	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'tired')

	self.controller.warp_red = self.fx.warp_red():Instantiate(leader.Position + z_fighting_sentinel,

	-- 다음 동작 동시에 실행

	-- 가디언&공주 2.5초간 0.1초 간격으로 방향 전환
	local princess = self.characters.princess()

	local move_duration = 2.5

	-- left -> up, -> right -> down 순서
	start_coroutine(self.warp_turning, self, princess, move_duration)
	start_coroutine(self.warp_turning, self, leader, move_duration)
	
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_04')
	-- 가디언&공주 2.5초간 처음 위치 기준 vector(0, -8, 0) 위치로 이동
	wp_util.move(princess, princess.Position - pos_adj, nil, move_duration)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position - pos_adj, nil, move_duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_princess_shoot_02')

	-- 두 동작 모두 끝날 때까지 대기

	self.controller.warp_red.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.controller.warp_blue.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.controller.warp_red.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.controller.warp_blue.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.controller.warp_red:Dispose()
	self.controller.warp_blue:Dispose()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 가디언(right, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 공주(left, tired, idle): 휴우… 겨우 탈출했네.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,

				nil,
				{ name = 'tired' },
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_53', skip = true })

	-- 파티 멤버 2~4(left, idle, idle)
	for i = 1, #self.controller.cached_party_members do
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.controller.cached_party_members[i])
	end

	-- 공주(left, attack, cast, shout 말풍선, 크기 1.2): 그러니까 내가 아무것도 건드리지 말라고 했잖아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'release' },
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_55', skip = true })

	-- 가디언(up, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)

	-- 공주(up, idle, idle): …응?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_56', skip = true })

	-- 카메라 shake(0.1, 3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 3)

	-- 카메라 2초간 워프 장치 중심 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(self.gimmicks.warp_device(), 2)

	-- 워프 장치 열쇠 이탈 애니메이션 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_beacon_lock_01')
	animator_util.play(self.gimmicks.warp_device(), 'off')

	-- 3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.6)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	-- 1.4초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.4)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.4, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카메라 1초간 가디언과 공주 이미지 위치의 중심 지점으로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_async((leader.Position + princess.Position) / 2, 1)

	-- 공주(up, idle, idle): …열쇠들이 뿔뿔이 흩어졌어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,

				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_57', skip = true })

	-- 공주(up, idle, release): 이제 아무도 이 유적 안으로 들어갈 수 없겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,

				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_58', skip = true })

				{ dir = 'up', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_59', skip = true })

	-- 가디언(right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

	-- 공주(left, idle, idle): 이만 돌아가자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_eastworld_60', skip = true })

	-- 가디언(right, idle, nod 2회)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	-- 동작 끝날 때까지 대기

	-- 카메라 1초간 이미지의 노란색 마름모 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_async((get_field_object('exit_gate_1').Position + get_field_object('exit_gate_2').Position) / 2, 1)

	-- 문 FullOpening으로 열림 처리. 끝날 때까지 대기
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('exit_gate_1', false))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('exit_gate_2', false))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	animator_util.play(self.gimmicks.warp_device(), 'idle')

	-- 카메라 1초간 가디언 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(princess)

	for i = 1, #self.controller.cached_party_members do
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.controller.cached_party_members[i], user_party, false)
	end

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(princess, user_party, false)

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	-- 이동 완료 후 카메라 가디언 따라감

	-- 컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
	self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

return local_class

end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()

		local is_manager_created = false

		is_manager_created, self.game_manager = global_table_util.try_get(
				'Quest/Main/PixyWorld/GrandMarch/Game/GameManager')

		if not is_manager_created then
			return
		end

		self.game_manager:set_game_flowers(self.game_level)

		if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress ~= nil then
			if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress >= 2 or self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
				self.game_manager:set_center_flowers('after_normal_cleared')
			elseif self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress == 1 then
				self.game_manager:set_center_flowers('before_normal_cleared')
			elseif self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress == 0 then
				self.game_manager:set_center_flowers('on_start')
			end
		end
	else
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_open_stage_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_open_stage_zone_leave_event')
	end
end

function local_class:on_open_stage_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.hint_zone.entered and e.Zone.Name == self.hint_zone.name and not e.FullEnter and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		self.hint_zone.entered = true

		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.5)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_open_stage_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.hint_zone.entered and e.Zone.Name == self.hint_zone.name and e.FullLeave and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		self.hint_zone.entered = false

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = PixyWorldGrandMarch @
		Comment = @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'pixyworld_1'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		before_loaded = 2,

		before_solve = 3,
		puzzle_solved = 4,

		before_enter_pipe_area = 5,
		in_pipe_area = 6,

		before_talk_with_flower = 7,
		talking_with_flowers = 8,

		done = 99,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
		switch_failed = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_pw_grand_march_switch_off')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.get_princess = function()
		return get_character('princess')
	end

	local request_base = {
		---@param this self
		progress = function(this)
			this.current_id = this.current_id + 1
		end,

		---@param this self
		get_id = function(this)
			return this.current_id
		end,

		---@param this self
		is_valid = function(this, req_id)
			return req_id == this.current_id
		end,
	}

	---@generic T1, T2
	---@param container T1
	---@param base T2
	---@return T1 | T2
	local function inherit(container, base)
		return setmetatable(container, {
			__index = base
		})
	end

	self.hint_routine_requester = inherit({
		current_id = 0
	}, request_base)

	self.wrong_order_routine_requester = inherit({
		current_id = 0
	}, request_base)

	self.hint = {
		zone = self.controller.hint_zone.name,
		pop_out_done = false,
		states = {
			before_first = 1,
			before_pop_out = 2,
			can_speech = 3,
			got_wrong = 4,
		},
		current_state = nil,
		init = function(this)
			this.current_state = this.states.before_first
		end
	}

	self.hint:init()

	self.flowers = {
		prefix = 'grand_march_pre_flower_',
		count = 5,

		---@param this self
		get = function(this, index)
			return get_character(this.prefix .. index)
		end,

		---@param this self
		get_start_pos = function(this, index)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos(this.prefix .. index)
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param action fun(index:number, flower:ICharacter) | "function(index, npc) end"
		foreach = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				action(i, this:get(i))
			end
		end,
	}

	self.flower_prince = {
		get = function(this)
			return get_character('grand_march_pre_flower_prince')
		end,

		set_interactable = function(this, listener)
			local npc = this:get()

			character_util.add_listener(npc, listener)
		end,

		unset_interactable = function(this, listener)
			local npc = this:get()

			character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, listener)
		end
	}

	self.switch = {
		prefix = 'grand_march_pre_switch_',
		count = 5,
		next_order_index = 1,
		order = {
			2,
			4,
			3,
			1,
			5,
		},

		get = function(this, index)
			return get_field_object(this.prefix .. index)
		end,

		get_next_switch = function(this)
			return get_field_object(this.prefix .. this.order[this.next_order_index])
		end,

		---@param this self
		try_change = function(this, target_switch)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target_switch, this:get_next_switch()) then
				this:send_turn_on(target_switch)

				this.next_order_index = this.next_order_index + 1

				return true
			else
				this:turn_off_all()

				this.next_order_index = 1

				return false
			end
		end,

		turn_off_all = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				local switch = this:get(i)

				if switch.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsTurnedOn then
					this:send_turn_off(switch)
				end
			end
		end,

		send_turn_on = function(this, target)
			message_system:SendSync(target.FieldObjectBehaviour,
					CS.Oak.LimitSwitchChangedEvent.Create(get_party_leader()))
		end,

		send_turn_off = function(this, target)
			message_system:SendSync(target.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
		end,

		---@param this self
		is_done = function(this)
			return this.next_order_index > #this.order
		end,

		---@param this self
		contains = function(this, target)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				local switch = this:get(i)

				if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, switch) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end,

		---@param this self
		foreach = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				local switch = this:get(i)

				action(i, switch)
			end
		end,

		---@param this self
		reset_damaged_behaviour = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				local switch = this:get(i)

				switch.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.LimitSwitchDamagedBehaviour()
			end
		end,
	}

	self.pipe = {
		twinkle_effect = nil,

		get = function()
			return get_field_object('grand_march_pre_pipe')
		end,

		---@param this self
		set_interactable = function(this)
			local pipe = this.get()

			--이후 배치된 [GIMMICK]trap_cliff가 인터렉트 가능 상태로 변경되며,
			pipe.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			--FX_Object_Twinkle이 출력된다.
			this.twinkle_effect = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(pipe.Position)
		end,

		---@param this self
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
				this.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
				this.twinkle_effect = nil
			end

			local pipe = this.get()

			pipe.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end
	}

	self.blocking_gate = {
		name = 'grand_march_pre_blocking_gate',

		get = function(this)
			return get_field_object(this.name)
		end,

		block = function(this)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(this.name, false))
		end,

		unblock = function(this)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(this.name, true))
		end
	}

	self.pipe_grid_name = 'grand_march_pre_pipe'

	self.switch_target_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick

	-- loop 사운드
	self.loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	--파랑 1 ~ 5 : pw_sing_flower (down, smile, hide[임시 : prostrate])
	self.flowers:foreach(function(index, npc)
		character_util.set_position(npc, self.flowers:get_start_pos(index))
		character_util.set_direction(npc, direction_constants.right)

		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'hide')
	end)

	self.blocking_gate:block()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.before_solve
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.current_state = self.states.done

	self:stop_hint_routine()
	self.pipe:dispose()
	self.wrong_order_routine_requester:progress()
	self.flower_prince:unset_interactable(self)

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_solve and
			(e.Info.type & self.switch_target_damage_type) == self.switch_target_damage_type and
			self.switch:contains(e.Info.target) then
		if not self.switch:try_change(e.Info.target) then
			start_coroutine(self.show_wrong_order_routine, self)

		elseif self.switch:is_done() then
			self.current_state = self.states.puzzle_solved

			self:stop_hint_routine()
			self.switch:reset_damaged_behaviour()

			sp_util.start_scene(self.flower_moving_scene, self):Then(function()
				self:set_flowers_after_puzzle()

				self.current_state = self.states.before_enter_pipe_area
			end)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_enter_pipe_area and
			type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.pipe_grid_name) then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_pipe_area

		start_coroutine(self.flower_jump_routine, self, function()
			return self.current_state == self.states.in_pipe_area
		end):Then(function()
			-- 내부에서 Valid 체크로 탈출하는 방식이기 때문에, 에러가 발생한게 아니라서 여기서 별도로 체크해줘야 함
			if self.current_state == self.states.done then
				return
			end

			self.pipe:set_interactable()
			self.flower_prince:set_interactable(self)

			self.current_state = self.states.before_talk_with_flower
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_talk_with_flower and
			(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.pipe.get()) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.flower_prince:get())) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talking_with_flowers

		sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_with_flowers_scene, self, self.pipe.get())

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_solve and
			e.Zone.Name == self.hint.zone and not e.FullEnter and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		self:start_hint_routine()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_solve and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.hint.zone) then
		self:stop_hint_routine()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_hint_routine()
	if self.hint.current_state == self.hint.states.before_first then
		self.hint.current_state = self.hint.states.before_pop_out

		start_coroutine(self.pop_out_routine, self)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 3)

	self.hint_routine_requester:progress()

	local routine_id = self.hint_routine_requester:get_id()

	start_coroutine(self.hint_routine, self, function()
		return self.hint_routine_requester:is_valid(routine_id)
	end)
end

function local_class:stop_hint_routine()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.hint_routine_requester:progress()
end

function local_class:pop_out_routine()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	--플라워들 1초간 일제히 down, smile, hide_out[임시 : jump]를 실행하여 down, smile, idle 상태가 됨.
	self.flowers:foreach(function(index, npc)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)

		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'hide_out', loop = false })
	end)

	local end_time = unity_class.time.time + 1

	while unity_class.time.time <= end_time and self.current_state ~= self.states.done do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.done then
		return
	end

	self.flowers:foreach(function(index, npc)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, direction_constants.down)
	end)

	self.hint.current_state = self.hint.states.can_speech
end

function local_class:hint_routine(is_valid_checker)
	local wait_for_valid_sec = function(duration)
		local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration

		while unity_class.time.time <= end_time and is_valid_checker() do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	--1초 대기.(재입장 시 반복 시작 지점)
	while self.hint.current_state ~= self.hint.states.can_speech and is_valid_checker() do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if not is_valid_checker() then
		return
	end

	local npc_data = {}
	local npc_one_shot_sfxs = { '01_flower_sing_02', '01_flower_sing_04', '01_flower_sing_03', '01_flower_sing_01', '01_flower_sing_05' }

	self.flowers:foreach(function(index, npc)
		npc_data[index] = {
			fo = npc,
			speech_key = 'pw_grand_march_pre_hint_flower_' .. index
		}
	end)

	while is_valid_checker() do
		--플라워 1 (down, sing, sing) : 레~~~
		--위 대사를 2초간 실행. 실행 후 완료하면 해당 플라워 down, smile, idle로 원복.
		--플라워 2 (down, sing, sing) : 파~~~
		--위 대사를 2초간 실행. 실행 후 완료하면 해당 플라워 down, smile, idle로 원복.
		--플라워 3 (down, sing, sing) : 미~~~
		--위 대사를 2초간 실행. 실행 후 완료하면 해당 플라워 down, smile, idle로 원복.
		--플라워 4 (down, sing, sing) : 도~~~
		--위 대사를 2초간 실행. 실행 후 완료하면 해당 플라워 down, smile, idle로 원복.
		--플라워 5 (down, sing, sing) : 솔~~~
		--위 대사를 2초간 실행. 실행 후 완료하면 해당 플라워 down, smile, idle로 원복.
		for i = 1, #npc_data do
			local npc = npc_data[i].fo

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(npc_one_shot_sfxs[i])

			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'sing')
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'sing')

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, {
				key = npc_data[i].speech_key,
				skip = false,
				type_speed = 0,
				keep_display = true,
			})

			wait_for_valid_sec(2)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'smile')
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)

			if not is_valid_checker() then
				break
			end
		end

		--1초 대기 시점으로 복귀하여, 1초 대기한 후, 플라워 이벤트를 재반복.
		wait_for_valid_sec(1)
	end
end

function local_class:show_wrong_order_routine()
	self.wrong_order_routine_requester:progress()

	local req_id = self.wrong_order_routine_requester:get_id()

	local is_valid = function()
		return self.wrong_order_routine_requester:is_valid(req_id)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_fail_01')

	local effects = {}

	self.switch:foreach(function(index, fo)
		effects[index] = self.fx.switch_failed():Instantiate(fo.Bounds.center)
	end)

	do
		local end_time = unity_class.time.time + 1.5

		while unity_class.time.time <= end_time and is_valid() do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.5, function(progress)
		if not is_valid() then
			return false
		end

		local current_scale = (1 - progress) * unity_class.vector3.one

		for _, effect in pairs(effects) do
			effect.transform.localScale = current_scale
		end
	end)

	-- FIXME : 다음 루틴이 시작한 이후 반환하기 때문에, 이펙트가 총 10개 클론된다. 즉시 삭제하면 5개로 줄일 수 있을 것
	for _, effect in pairs(effects) do
		effect:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:flower_moving_scene()
	--카메라 1번 지점으로 이동합니다.
	local blocking_gate = self.blocking_gate:get()

	do
		local target_pos = field_object_util.get_center_pivot(blocking_gate)

		camera_util.move_async(target_pos, 1)
	end

	do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_flower_march_01')

		--이후 5번에서부터 1번 순서대로 right, sing, sing(upper), walk(속도 4)를 실행하며
		local blocking_gate_min_x = blocking_gate.Bounds.min.x
		local end_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('grand_march_pre_flower_move_end')
		local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(self.flowers:get(1), end_pos, {
			x = blocking_gate_min_x - 2
		})

		local is_close_to_gate = false

		--이후 5번에서부터 1번 순서대로 right, sing, sing(upper), walk(속도 4)를 실행하며
		self.flowers:foreach(function(index, npc)
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'sing', upper = true })
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'sing')

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, waypoints, 4, nil, self, nil, {
				callback = function(wp_index)
					if wp_index == 0 then
						is_close_to_gate = true
					end
				end
			})
		end)

		while not is_close_to_gate do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		self.blocking_gate:unblock()

		--비밀길 안쪽으로 사라진다.
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀되며
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:set_flowers_after_puzzle()
	local setting_data = {
		{
			offset = unity_class.vector3.left,
			direction = direction_constants.right,
			anim = 'sing',
			emotion = 'smile',
			active_state = active_state_type.visible
		},
		{
			offset = unity_class.vector3.forward,
			direction = direction_constants.down,
			anim = 'sing',
			emotion = 'smile',
			active_state = active_state_type.visible
		},
	}

	local pipe_pos = self.pipe.get().Position

	self.flowers:foreach(function(index, npc)
		local data = setting_data[index]

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc, true)

		if data ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pipe_pos + data.offset)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data.direction)

			if data.emotion ~= nil then
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, data.emotion)
			end

			if data.anim ~= nil then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, data.anim)
			end

			if data.active_state ~= nil then
				field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, data.active_state)
			end
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
			npc.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:flower_jump_routine(is_valid_checker)
	local pipe_pos = self.pipe:get().Position

	local move_to_pipe_async = function(npc)
		local duration = 1

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = npc,
													   type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', parent = npc,
									 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		character_util.jump(npc, 1.5, duration)
		character_util.spine_scale(npc, unity_class.vector3.zero, duration)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, pipe_pos, nil, duration, self, nil, {
			locked_dir = npc.Direction,
			end_callback = function()
				character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
				field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
			end
		})

		while is_valid_checker() and wp_util.is_moving_with_end_callback(self) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	--플레이어 트리거 존 입장 시 컨트롤 빼앗지 않고
	--NPC 2번 (down, smile, jump)을 사용하여
	--1타일 아래로 1초의 속도로 이동하여,
	--[GIMMICK]trap_cliff를 향해 스케일이 다운되어 아래로 내려가듯 묘사된다.
	move_to_pipe_async(self.flowers:get(2))

	if not is_valid_checker() then
		return
	end

	--앞 완료까지 대기한 후, 0.5초 대기.
	do
		local end_time = unity_class.time.time + 0.5

		while unity_class.time.time < end_time and is_valid_checker() do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	if not is_valid_checker() then
		return
	end

	--NPC 1번 (right, smile, jump)을 사용하여 1타일 우측으로 1초의 속도로 이동하여, [GIMMICK]trap_cliff를 향해 스케일이 다운되어 아래로 내려가듯 묘사된다.
	--앞 완료까지 대기.
	move_to_pipe_async(self.flowers:get(1))
end

function local_class:talk_with_flowers_scene(pipe)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local flower = self.flower_prince:get()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_flower_march_02', loop = true,
												   type_priority = 'event' })

	do
		local duration = 1
		local offset_factor = 0
		local align_pivot = pipe.Position + unity_class.vector3.left
		local direction = direction_constants.right

		for i = 1, user_party.Count do
			local member = user_party[i - 1]

			if member.ActiveState == active_state_type.enabled then
				local target_pos = align_pivot + offset_factor * unity_class.vector3.left
				local move_diff = target_pos - member.Position
				local speed = math.max(move_diff.magnitude / duration, 1)

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos, speed, nil, self, nil, {
					last_direction = direction
				})

				offset_factor = offset_factor + 1
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(duration)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--인터렉트 시 컨트롤 빼앗으며, 아래의 나레이션 출력.
	-- 나레이션 : 구멍 아래로 즐거운 노랫소리가 들려온다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({
		key = 'pw_grand_march_pre_1'
	})

	-- NPC 3 (left, smile, idle) : 잠깐, 두 분 모두 평범한 인간으로 보이는데… 어떻게 찾아오셨죠?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_grand_march_pre_2')

	-- 플레이어 선택지 출력.
	-- 리듬이 절 불렀어요…(초록)
	choose_util.play_async({
		{ 'pw_grand_march_pre_3', 'mercy' }
	})

	-- 플레이어 right, smile, sing을 1초간 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'right',
			'sing', 'smile', 1)

	-- NPC 3 (left, smile, idle) : 하하, 그러신 분들이 가끔 있으시죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_grand_march_pre_4')

	-- NPC 3 (left, smile, idle) : 하지만 여기는 원칙 상 특수한 드레스 코드를 갖추지 않으면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_grand_march_pre_5')

	-- 대사 종료하면 NPC 3번 left, attack, jump 1회 실행하며 이모션 버블(notice)를 출력.
	character_util.normal_jump(flower, '01_small_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(flower, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'notice')

	-- NPC 3 (left, smile, idle) : 실례지만, 저 뒤에 아리따운 꽃님도 같이 참석하시는 걸까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'pw_grand_march_pre_6')

	-- 꼬마 공주 (right, smile, jump 1회) : 어… 응! 노랫소리가 엄청 좋아 보여!!
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'pw_grand_march_pre_7')

	-- NPC 3 (left, smile, idle) : 하하! 그러시다면 어쩔 수 없죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_grand_march_pre_8')

	-- NPC 3 left, smile, attack을 실행하여, 플레이어와 공주에게 package 2개를 각각 증정한다.
	scene_util.set_anim(flower, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })

	do
		local package_item_id = 21274

		local drop_package = function(target, skip_text)
			local item

			item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = flower.Position + unity_class.vector3.up,
				item_id = package_item_id,
				unique_id = 'grand_march_pre_package_' .. target.Name,
				target = target.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.4,
				show_on_character = true,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				skip_text = skip_text,
				bounce_callback = function()
					quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, target)
				end
			})
		end

		drop_package(leader)
		drop_package(princess, true)

		wait_for_sec(1.2)
	end

	-- NPC 3 (left, smile, idle) : 소중한 원칙을 어겨서라도 부디 모시고 싶은 손님일 줄이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'pw_grand_march_pre_9')

	local last_speech_key = 'pw_grand_march_pre_10'

	-- NPC 3 (left, smile, cast2) : 자, 어서 들어오시죠. 축제는 이제 곧 시작합니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flower, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast2', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', }, nil, last_speech_key)

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	--이후 스테이지 개방 연출 실행.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = 'substage_19_3'
	})

	--NPC 3 마지막 대사로 원라인 배치.
	flower.Interactable.Talk = last_speech_key

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.controller:activate_quest()
	--실행 완료 후 컨트롤 풀림.
end

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = PixyWorldGrandMarch @
		Comment = @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_19_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		before_loaded = 1,

		before_trying = 2,
		try_enter_game = 3,
		in_game = 4,

		done = 99
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.before_loaded

	self.game_callbacks = {
		on_game_start = function()
			self.current_state = self.states.in_game
		end,

		on_succeed = function()
			self.controller:progress_section()
		end,

		on_failed = function()
			self.current_state = self.states.before_trying
		end,

		on_escape = function()
			self.current_state = self.states.before_trying
		end
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.controller.game_manager:subscribe_interacting_flower(self.controller.game_level, self)

	self.current_state = self.states.before_trying
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.current_state = self.states.done

	self.controller.game_manager:unsubscribe_interacting_flower(self.controller.game_level, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_flower()
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_trying then
		self.current_state = self.states.try_enter_game

		start_coroutine(self.controller.game_manager.try_play_routine,
				self.controller.game_manager, self.controller.game_level, false, self.game_callbacks)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchController
	self.controller = controller

	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_19_3'

	self.get_princess = function()
		return get_character('princess')
	end

	self.get_flower_prince = function()
		return get_character('flower_prince')
	end

	---@generic T
	---@field create_all fun(self:self)
	---@param fx_spec_names T
	---@return T | table<string, UnityObjectPool>
	local function create_fx_manager(fx_spec_names)
		local create_all = function()
			for _, spec_name in pairs(fx_spec_names) do
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(spec_name)
			end
		end

		return setmetatable({}, {
			__index = function(this, key)
				if key == 'create_all' then
					return create_all
				else
					return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_spec_names[key])
				end
			end
		})
	end

	self.fx = create_fx_manager({
		last_hit = 'FX_lasthit',
	})
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx.create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(function()
		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			-- 페이드 모드 스위칭
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black)
			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0)

		self.controller:complete_quest({
			return_control = false,
			run_chapter_end_ui = false,
			run_fame_alignment = false,
		})

		--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀. 2섹션 종료 + 꼬마 공주 플레이어 파티에 합류 상태로 추가.
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.get_princess(), user_party, true)

		if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
		end
	end)
end

end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

	return false

	self.controller.game_manager:set_center_flowers('after_hard_cleared')

	end

	return false
end

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class PixyWorldHellDiversController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldHellDiversController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = true,
		NormalSectionCount = 5,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.get_diver_leader = function()
		return get_character('diver_leader')
	end

	self.get_divers = function(number)
		return get_character('trainee_diver_' .. number)
	end

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		custom_sprite = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
		end,
		dark_missile_preset = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_DarkMagicMissile_Proj')
		end,
		dark_missile_explosion_preset = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_DarkMagicMissile_Proj_Explosion')
		end,
		blink = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blink')
		end,
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		fairy_spawn = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_fairy_spawn')
		end,
		Common_CannonFire_middle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_CannonFire_middle')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.nowhere = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.my_party_list = {}

	self.qte_swipe = {
		enum = {
			none = 0,
			left = 1,
			up = 2,
			right = 3,
			down = 4,
		},
		qte_target = 0,
		qte_result = 0,
		is_cancel = false
	}

	self.quest_marker_name = 'helldivers_quest'
	self.quest_marker_key = 'helldivers_marker'

	self.pre_section_stage_name = 'pixyworld_2'

	self.trap_room_zone_name = 'trap_zone'

	self.is_spike_dead = false

	self.arrow_data ={
		pos = {
			up = {},
			down = {}
		},
		pooled_table = {},

		is_unique = false,
		end_flag = false,
		is_moving = false,

		is_play_fire_sfx = false
	}

	self.kill_zone = true
	self.play_arrow_fire_sfx = false

	self.door_data = {
		clear_door_1 = 's5_door_1',
		clear_door_2 = 's5_door_2',

		end_door_1 = 'end_door_1',
		end_door_2 = 'end_door_2',
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.fx:create_all()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	if stage.Name ~= self.pre_section_stage_name then

		if self.arrow_data.end_flag then
			self:stop_arrow()
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil then
		return
	end

	if stage.Name ~= self.pre_section_stage_name then
		self:remove_party_member()

		if self.cs_controller.StartingInnerProgress < 2 then
			self.kill_zone = false
		end

		start_coroutine(self.create_arrow, self)

		if not self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.IsComplete then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_data.clear_door_1))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_data.clear_door_2))

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_data.end_door_1))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_data.end_door_2))
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_data.end_door_1))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_data.end_door_2))

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_data.clear_door_1))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_data.clear_door_2))
		end

	elseif self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress >= 0 and stage.Name == self.pre_section_stage_name then

		local object = get_field_object('sub_hell_interact_wall_1')
		object.Position = self.nowhere
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.pre_section_stage_name and not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return false
	end

	if self.qte_swipe.qte_target ~= self.qte_swipe.enum.none then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.qte_swipe.qte_result = self.qte_swipe.enum.left
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.qte_swipe.qte_result = self.qte_swipe.enum.up
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.qte_swipe.qte_result = self.qte_swipe.enum.right
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.qte_swipe.qte_result = self.qte_swipe.enum.down
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, leader)
			and (e.Info.type & CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap) ~= CS.Oak.DamageType.None then
		if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HP <= 1 and self.is_spike_dead == false then
			self.is_spike_dead = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.reset_spike_dead, self):Then(function()
				self.is_spike_dead = false
			end)
			return true

		elseif not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, leader) then
			-- 가시블록 데미지인 경우
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
			damage_info.sender = leader
			damage_info.target = leader

			-- 기본 배율이 0.05이어서 0.2로 맞춰줌
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
					* (0.3 - CS.Oak.ConstantsData.Value.GimmickSpikeDamage:GetDecrypted()))
			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.trap_room_zone_name) then

		character_util.set_immortal(get_party_leader(), true)
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_arrow_zone') then

		self:start_arrow()

	elseif self.kill_zone and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'arrow_kill_zone') then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.kill_zone_scene, self)

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.trap_room_zone_name) then
		character_util.set_immortal(get_party_leader(), false)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_arrow_zone') then

		start_coroutine(self.stop_arrow, self)
	end

--- @return boolean 성공 여부
function local_class:qte_event(type_str, scale, show_success, goal, time_limit)
	scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
	goal = lua_helper.get_or_default(goal, 12)
	time_limit = lua_helper.get_or_default(time_limit, 9999)
	show_success = lua_helper.get_or_default(show_success, false)

	self.qte_swipe.qte_target = self.qte_swipe.enum[type_str]
	self.qte_swipe.qte_result = self.qte_swipe.enum.none

	-- QTE 이벤트
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(false))

	if scale < 0 then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type_str)
	end

	while self.qte_swipe.qte_result == self.qte_swipe.enum.none and not self.qte_swipe.is_cancel do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))

	local success = (self.qte_swipe.qte_target == self.qte_swipe.qte_result) and (not self.qte_swipe.is_cancel)

	self.qte_swipe.qte_target = self.qte_swipe.enum.none
	self.qte_swipe.qte_result = self.qte_swipe.enum.none

	self.qte_swipe.is_cancel = false

	return success
end

function local_class:qte_routine(command_data, narration_func, fail_func)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local success = false
	local command = command_data

	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1')

	--이후 NPC에게 인터렉트 시 아래의 순서대로 연출 실행
	--ShortStoryLinaTowerSection1(193줄) 유사하게 진행될 예정이니 참조 부탁드립니다.
	--플레이어 right, attack, cast 상태로 손 위치에 전술 무전기 스프라이트를 들려준다.
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, {name = 'dualgun_attack_right', loop = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')

	local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = leader.Position + vector(0, 0.4, 0),
		item_id = 21276,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
		skip_item_text = true,
	})

	quest_drop_item_util.set_shadow_active(item, false)

	if character_util.get_look_direction(leader) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		item.Position = item.Position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0)
		item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	else
		item.Position = item.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0)
		item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	end

	while not success do

		narration_func()

		--플레이어 제외하고 배경 검은 틴트 실행.
		--틴트색은 ShortStoryLinaTowerSection1(213줄) 과 동일하게 진행.
		--이후 QTE 드래그 방향을 띄우지 않은 채, 나레이션 박스에 나온 순서대로 QTE 드래그를 진행.

		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
		field:Tint('leader_command_tint', unity_color({ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1 }), 1)
		--QTE 드래그 방향 화면에 띄우지 않음, 나레이션 박스에 나온 순서를 기억했다가 QTE 드래그하는 액티비티.

		for i, input in ipairs(command) do
			success = self:qte_event(input, nil, i == #command)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if not success then
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine(false)
				stage.Field:Undarken('tutorial')

				--실패 시
				--플레이어 현재 상태에서 tired로 표정이 1초간 유지되며 틴트 풀림.
				--나레이션 박스 출력.
				--나레이션 : 지원에 실패했습니다.
				--
				--나레이션 : 대원 사망 시 지원
				--                 왼쪽, 오른쪽, 왼쪽, 위.
				--이후 배경 검은 틴트 실행하여 QTE 시작 시점으로 복귀.
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')

				field:RemoveTint('leader_command_tint', 1)
				wait_for_sec(1)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_01')
				fail_func()

				--(이후 배경 어두워지며 재시작.)
				break
			end

			--QTE 성공시마다 dualgun_attack_right를 1회 실행시킨 뒤, 애니 마지막 시점에 전술 스프라이트 위치에
			--FX_twinkle 에서 light 이펙트만 따로 뺴서 사용.
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)

			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, {name = 'dualgun_attack_right', loop = false})

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_enhance_light_01')
			local fx = self.fx.fairy_spawn():Instantiate(item.Position)
			fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.00001

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			if success and i == #command then
				yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
			end
		end
	end

	--성공 시
	--검은 틴트 배경 원복.
	field:RemoveTint('leader_command_tint', 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	return item
end

function local_class:qte_cancel()
	self.qte_swipe.is_cancel = true

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Proceed()
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()
end

function local_class:create_arrow()
	local arrow_count = 13

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	for index = 1, arrow_count do
		local arrow_object = self.fx.custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local arrow_sprite = arrow_object.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		arrow_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		arrow_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
		arrow_sprite.SpriteName = 'arrow'
		arrow_sprite:Rebuild()

		arrow_sprite:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 3)

		table.insert(self.arrow_data.pooled_table, arrow_sprite)
	end

	-- Subscribe 타이밍을 pooled_table 생성 완료된 뒤로 시점 변경
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	-- 화살 생성 및 Subscribe 이후 leader가 s2_arrow_zone 안에 위치해 있다면 start_arrow
	if zone_util.contains_fo(field:GetZone('s2_arrow_zone'), get_party_leader()) then
		self:start_arrow()
	end
end

function local_class:start_arrow()
	local arrow_up_count = 7
	local arrow_down_count = 13
	local data_index = 1

	self.arrow_data.end_flag = false

	if table_util.is_empty(self.arrow_data.pos.up) then

		for index = 1, arrow_up_count do
			local arrow = self.arrow_data.pooled_table[index]
			local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_fireball_down_pos_' .. index)

			arrow.transform.position = pos
			arrow.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))

			table.insert(self.arrow_data.pos.down, pos)
		end

		for index = 8, arrow_down_count do
			local arrow = self.arrow_data.pooled_table[index]
			local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_fireball_up_pos_' .. data_index)

			data_index = data_index + 1

			arrow.transform.position = pos
			arrow.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(-90, 0, 0))

			table.insert(self.arrow_data.pos.up, pos)
		end
	end

	if self.arrow_data.is_unique == false then
		self.arrow_data.is_unique = true
		start_coroutine(self.arrow_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:arrow_routine()
	local arrow_move_distance = 14

	--트리거 존 입장한 시점부터 붉은색 화살표 방향(그리드 바깥)에서부터 FX_Arrow_proj_b 프로젝타일이 7의 속도로, 2초마다 발사되는 상태.
	--배치될 NPC 1 ~ 3, 플레이어를 피격하지 않음. 특정 이벤트에 맞춰서만 연출로서 피격됨.
	while self.arrow_data.end_flag == false do
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 1.3

		self.arrow_data.is_moving = true

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bow_shot_02')

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			for index = 1, #self.arrow_data.pos.down do
				local arrow = self.arrow_data.pooled_table[index]

				arrow.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
						self.arrow_data.pos.down[index],
						self.arrow_data.pos.down[index] + vector(0, 0, arrow_move_distance), progress)
			end

			for index = 1, #self.arrow_data.pos.up do
				local arrow = self.arrow_data.pooled_table[index + 7]

				arrow.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
						self.arrow_data.pos.up[index],
						self.arrow_data.pos.up[index] + vector(0, 0, -arrow_move_distance), progress)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		self.arrow_data.is_moving = false

		self.arrow_data.is_unique = false
	end
end

function local_class:stop_arrow()
	local arrow_up_count = 7
	local arrow_down_count = 13

	self.arrow_data.end_flag = true

	while self.arrow_data.is_moving do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.arrow_data.end_flag == false then
		return
	end

	for index = 1, arrow_up_count do
		local arrow = self.arrow_data.pooled_table[index]

		arrow.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	for index = 8, arrow_down_count do
		local arrow = self.arrow_data.pooled_table[index]

		arrow.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
end

function local_class:kill_zone_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local leader_tine_key = 'leader_dead'

	local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('kill_zone_pos')
	local move_pos = leader.Position + vector(-10, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move(leader, move_pos, 4, nil, { run = true })

	self:stop_arrow()

	self:start_arrow()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.stop(leader)

	--섹션 종료에 맞춰 화살 사망 이벤트 상시 실행.
	--컨트롤 복귀한 시점에서부터 플레이어 후면 공간에 화살들은 지속적으로 발사중인 상태.
	--이때 플레이어가 이 화살에 피격당하면(요 처리가 어렵다면 그냥 존엔터로 진행.)
	--이후 플레이어 사망 연출 실행.
	--날아오는 화살에 Fx+hit를 출력하며 피격.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)

	--피격되며 right, hurt, dead2 + 틴트 90% 다운하여 어둡게 변경된다.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'hurt')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dead2')
	character_util.add_fade_color(leader, leader_tine_key, unity_class.color.black, 0.9, 1)

	wait_for_sec(2)
	--위 연출 종료하면 화면 페이드 아웃.
	--페이드 인 시 2섹션 종료 시점의 위치로 복귀.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_fade_color(leader, leader_tine_key, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	local reset_pos = pos + vector(5, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(leader, reset_pos)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:diver_landing(fo, pos, func_data)
	local func = lua_helper.get_or_default(func_data, nil)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(fo, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, { name = 'jingak', loop = false })

	local set_pos = pos + vector(0, 10, 0)

	character_util.set_position(fo, set_pos)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	wp_util.move_async(fo, pos, nil, 0.5, {y_mode = 'flying'})

	self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	if func ~= nil then
		func()
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
end

return local_class

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local name = e.Target.Name

	if self.current_state == self.states.none then

		if self.kid_find_data[name] == nil then
			return false
		end

		sp_util.start_scene(self.align_kid_scene, self, e.Target)

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.find_kid then

		if self.kid_find_data[name] == nil then
			return false
		end

		self.current_state = self.states.interact_kid

		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_kid_scene, self)

	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			self.is_first_zone_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_hell_find_kid_zone') then

		self.is_first_zone_enter = false

		--NPC 3번의 대사가 1회 실행
		start_coroutine(function()
			local npc = self.get_kids(2)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, {key = 'pw_helldivers_pre_3', skip = false})
		end)

	elseif self.current_state == self.states.interact_kid and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_hell_save_kid_zone') then

		self.current_state = self.states.save_kid

		sp_util.start_scene(self.save_kid_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:align_kid_scene(kid)
	local current_data = self.kid_find_data[kid.Name]

	--컨트롤 뻇길 떄 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--NPC 1 ~ 3번 모두 인터렉트 가능 상태이며, 인터렉트 시 플레이어 해당 캐릭터 2타일 좌 or 우측에 해당 캐릭터를 바라보며 정렬한 뒤 아래의 연출 실행.
	--연출중인 NPC는 플레이어 방향 0.5타일 앞으로 0.2 높이만큼 점프하며 틀어진 각도를 원복하고, 플레이어를 바라본다.
	current_data.find = true

	current_data.align(self)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(kid, self.get_kids(1)) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	end
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			kid,
			self,
			current_data.dir,
			'idle',
			nil,
			current_data.talk.find_1
	)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			kid,
			self,
			current_data.dir,
			'idle',
			nil,
			current_data.talk.find_2
	)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			kid,
			self,
			current_data.dir,
			'idle',
			nil,
			current_data.talk.find_3
	)

	do
		--각자의 이벤트에 해당하는 NPC들은 가야할 방향, smile, run(속도 7)로 지정된 위치까지 이동한 뒤, 아래의 원라인 상태로 배치합니다
		local pos = current_data.get_pos
		local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(kid, pos, false)

		wp_util.move_async(kid, waypoints, 4, nil)

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(kid, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	end

	kid.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	kid.Interactable.Talk = current_data.talk.online

	local end_find_flag = true

	for _, data in pairs(self.kid_find_data) do
		if data.find == false then
			end_find_flag = false
		end
	end

	if end_find_flag then
		local npcs = self:get_kids_setting()

		self.current_state = self.states.find_kid

		for index = 1, #npcs do
			local npc = npcs[index]

			npc.Interactable.Talk = ''
			character_util.add_listener(npc, self.controller)
		end
	end

	--컨트롤 복귀에 BGM 볼륨 1로 전환, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:interact_kid_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local npcs = self:get_kids_setting()

	--컨트롤 뻇길 떄 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--이후 3인 모두 찾아내에 좌측에 정렬되었다면 NPC들 인터렉트 가능 상태로 변경되고, 인터렉트 시 NPC들 우측에 left, idle, idle로 정렬.
	--NPC 3 (right, smile, idle) : 우릴 모두 찾다니 대단한데! 인정할게!
	--NPC 2 (right, smile, idle) : 그럼 우리 비밀기지 가서 또 놀자!
	--NPC 1 (right, smile, idle) : 이번엔 뭐하고서 놀까?
	do
		local pos = npcs[3].Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

		party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(pos, 'right', 1, 'arc')
	end

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[3],
			self,
			'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			'pw_helldivers_pre_16'
	)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[2],
			self,
			'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			'pw_helldivers_pre_17'
	)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[1],
			self,
			'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			'pw_helldivers_pre_18'
	)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(npcs[3], {dir = 'left', sfx = false})
	do
		local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})

		scene_util.play_wait_action(
				npcs[3],
				self,
				nil,
				'eat',
				nil,
				1
		)
		sfx:Stop()
	end

	--이후 대사 종료되면 NPC 3번 left, smile, eat를 1초간 실행한 뒤, Fx_dead가 인비저블 월 위치에 실행되며 월 사라짐.
	--이후 NPC 좌측 비밀길로 이동하여 지정된 위치에 배치. 이동 완료하면 컨트롤 복귀.
	do
		local pos = npcs[3].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		self.fx.dead():Instantiate(pos)

		local object = get_field_object('sub_hell_interact_wall_1')
		object.Position = self.nowhere
	end

	for index = 1, #npcs do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_hell_kid_save_pos_' .. index)

		wp_util.move(npcs[index], pos, 4, nil, {
			end_callback = function()
				scene_util.set_direction_by_args(npcs[index], { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
			end
		})
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--컨트롤 뻇길 떄 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:field_setting()
	local npcs = self:get_kids_setting()
	local diver_leader = get_character('sub_hell_diver_leader')

	character_util.set_position(diver_leader, self.nowhere)

	for index = 1, #npcs do
		local npc = npcs[index]
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_hell_kid_pos_' .. index) + self.kid_find_data[npc.Name].hide_pos_offset

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
	end

end

function local_class:get_kids_setting()
	local kid_count = 3
	local npcs = {}

	for index = 1, kid_count do
		local npc = self.get_kids(index)

		table.insert(npcs, npc)
	end

	return npcs
end

function local_class:save_kid_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local npcs = self:get_kids_setting()
	local diver = get_character('sub_hell_diver_leader')
	local monsters = {}

	--컨트롤 뻇길 떄 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--이후 플레이어 비밀길을 진입하며 트리거 존 입장 시 비밀길 앞 지정된 위치에 left, idle, idle로 정렬.
	--카메라 1번 상태에서부터 연출 시작
	do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_hell_save_leader_pos') + vector(1,0,0)

		party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(pos, 'right', 1, 'arc')
	end

	do
		local pos = leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

		camera_util.move_async(pos, 0.5)
	end

	--NPC 3 (right, smile, jump 1회) : 하하! 빨리 와요!
	character_util.normal_jump(npcs[3], '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[3],
			self,
			'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			'pw_helldivers_pre_19'
	)

	--NPC 1 (right, smile, sing) : 이번에는 뭐하고 놀까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[1],
			self,
			'right',
			'sind',
			nil,
			'pw_helldivers_pre_20'
	)

	--플레이어 선택지 출력.
	--아이들과 이렇게 편하게 놀아본 게 얼마만인지…(초록)
	choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'pw_helldivers_pre_21', 'mercy' } })

	--플레이어 선택지 선택 시 아래의 사항들 동시에 실행.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--left, sleep_deep, cross_arm을 실행하며 머리 위로 이모션 버블(happy) 가 실행
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			scene_util.play_emoticon_action(
					leader,
					self,
					'left',
					{name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false},
					'sleep_deep',
					'happy'
			)
		end),

		util.cs_generator(function()
			--버블이 실행되는 시간동안 4 ~ 9가 맵 바깥에서부터 right, attack, walk로 걸어 들어온다.
			local monster_count = 6

			for index = 1, monster_count do
				local monster = self.get_hulks(index)
				local pos = self.get_monster_pos(index) + vector(-15, 0, 0)

				table.insert(monsters, monster)

				character_util.set_position(monster, pos)
			end

			local wait_move_key = 'monster_move'

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_soldiers_02')
			camera_util.shake(0.02, 999)

			for index = 1, #monsters do
				local pos = self.get_monster_pos(index) + vector(-2, 0, 0)

				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(monsters[index], pos, 4, nil, self, wait_move_key)
			end

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wait_move_key)

			camera_util.cancel_shake()
		end)
	})

	--연출 종료하면 하단 대사 실행.
	--NPC 2 (down, smile, idle) : 음? 무슨 소리가 들렸는데?
	--상단 대사와 함께 플레이어 이모션 idle로 변경.
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[2],
			self,
			'down',
			nil,
			nil,
			'pw_helldivers_pre_22'
	)

	--대사 종료되면 플레이어 left, attack, jump 1회 실행.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_jump_01')

	--점프 완료된 후 0.7초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local time_key = 'monster_attack_slow'

	--슬로우모션 시작에 BGM 종료, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	time_util.mod(time_key, 0.5)

	--아래 정리된 연출 동시에 1초 안에 모두 실행.
	--1 ~ 3번 left, surprise, embarrassed 실행 후 유지.
	for index = 1, #npcs do
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(npcs[index], { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

		scene_util.set_emotion(npcs[index], self, 'surprise')

		scene_util.set_anim(npcs[index], self, 'embarrassed')
	end

	for index = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		scene_util.set_emotion(user_party[index], self, 'surprise')
	end

	--4 ~ 9의 오거는 right, attack, charge / 헐크는 right, attack, run로 지정된 위치까지 이동한 뒤, 플레이어와 맞춰 attack 애니메이션의 준비 자세까지 실행하여 타격 직전까지 실행.
	do
		local monster_count = 6

		for index = 1, monster_count do
			local monster = monsters[index]
			local pos = self.get_monster_pos(index)

			scene_util.set_emotion(monster, self, 'attack')

			wp_util.move(monster, pos, 3, nil, {run = true})
		end

		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_hell_save_leader_pos')

		wp_util.move_async(leader, pos, 4, nil, { run = true })
	end

	do
		for index = 1, #monsters do
			local monster = monsters[index]

			scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, { name = 'attack', scale = 0.6, sfx_name = '02_heavy_slash_02' })
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'frustration')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	--두 애니메이션을 정확히 맞출 필요는 없이, 꼬마 아이들을 타격하기 직전으로 묘사하시면 되겠습니다.
	--플레이어 left, attack, run으로 지정된 위치까지 이동한 뒤, 몬스터와 맞춰 left, damaged, frustration 자세를 실행.
	--
	--해당 애니메이션을 정확히 맞출 필요는 없이 그대로 실행되어 있으면 됩니다.
	--
	--몬스터들의 NPC 타격 직전에 NPC 1 ~ 9 현재 상태에서 정지하고, 플레이어는 left,damaged, frustration 애니메이션을 완료 후 유지상태로 1초간 대기.
	do
		for index = 1, #monsters do
			local npc = monsters[index]

			npc.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
		end

		for index = 1, #npcs do
			local npc = npcs[index]

			npc.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	time_util.unmod(time_key)

	--NPC 10 (down, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 아아, 이런 안타깝군요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			diver,
			self,
			'down',
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_helldivers_pre_23', viewport_pos = vector(0.5,0.8), skip = true }
	)

	--10번 : pw_diver_leader (down, sleep_deep, cross_arm)
	--해당 상태에서 10번 NPC가 down, sleep_deep, cross_arm 상태로 Y축 모든 기종 세로 화면비 이탈하는 높이에서부터 2초 안에 지정된 위치까지 내려온다.
	-- Fx_lasthit + 화면 0.2만큼 0.2초간 shake 실행.

	do
		local pos = leader.Position + vector(-1,10,1)

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(diver, {dir = 'down', sfx = false})
		scene_util.set_emotion(diver, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim(diver, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })

		character_util.set_position(diver, pos)

		local move_pos = pos + vector(0,-10,0)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_reverse_01')
		wp_util.move_async(diver, move_pos, nil, 0.5)

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(diver, {dir = 'down', sfx = false})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_mech_land_01')
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(move_pos)
		camera_util.shake(0.2,0.2)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--NPC 10 (down, tired, cross_arm) : 우리의 고향, 우리의 자유의 울타리가…
	--위 대사와 함꼐 BGM 재생, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_agora_02', state = 'event', volume = 0.6})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			diver,
			self,
			'down',
			nil,
			'tired',
			'pw_helldivers_pre_24'
	)

	--NPC 10 (down, tired, cross_arm) : 잠깐의 환락과 모두의 방심으로 뚤리면서… 이런 참사가 생겨 버렸군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			diver,
			self,
			'down',
			nil,
			'tired',
			'pw_helldivers_pre_25'
	)

	--NPC 10 (down, idle, cross_arm) : 이런 참사를 두 눈으로 보고… 혹시 무슨 생각이 드셨나요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			diver,
			self,
			'down',
			nil,
			nil,
			'pw_helldivers_pre_26'
	)

	--플레이어 선택지 출력
	--아이를 구하고 싶었어요…(초록)
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'pw_helldivers_pre_27', 'mercy'}
	})

	--플레이어 left, cry, frustration을 2초간 실행 후 유지 + 머리 위로 이모션 버블(sweat) 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(
			leader,
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			{name = 'cry', keep = true},
			'sweat'
	)

	--NPC 10 (down, attack, release 2회) : 맞습니다. 우리들의 가족이 사악한 괴물들에게 유린당한다면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			diver,
			self,
			'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'pw_helldivers_pre_28'
	)

	--NPC 10 (down, sleep_deep, idle) : 우리들이 몸 속 깊이 느끼고 있는 ‘자유’를 빼앗긴 기분이 들겠죠…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			diver,
			self,
			'down',
			nil,
			'idle',
			'pw_helldivers_pre_29'
	)

	--NPC 10 (down, attack, jump 1회) : 그렇다면 이 ‘자유’를 빼앗기지 않기 위해서는 어찌해야 할까요?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(diver)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			diver,
			self,
			'down',
			nil,
			'attack',
			'pw_helldivers_pre_30'
	)

function local_class:kid_align_setting_1()
	local kid = self.get_kids(1)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	do
		local pos = kid.Position + (self.kid_find_data[kid.Name].player_set_dir_vector)

		party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member (pos, 'down', 1, 'linear')

		self:look_at_user_party(kid)
	end

	--NPC 1, 2는 모두 아래와 같이 동작한다.
	--NPC 1 left, smile, walk4leg(속도 2)을 사용하여 플레이어 우측 1타일 지점까지 이동한 후 진행.
	local pos = leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
	local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(kid, pos, false)

	scene_util.set_emotion(kid, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(kid, self, 'walk4legs')

	local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_dash_04', loop = true})

	character_util.look_at(kid, leader)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)
end

function local_class:kid_align_setting_2()
	local kid = self.get_kids(2)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	do
		local pos = kid.Position + (self.kid_find_data[kid.Name].player_set_dir_vector * 2)

		party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member (pos, 'left', 1, 'linear')

		self:look_at_user_party(kid)
	end

	--NPC 1, 2는 모두 아래와 같이 동작한다.
	--NPC 2 right, smile, jump(get)을 사용하여 플레이어 좌측 1타일 지점까지 이동한 후 진행.

	local pos = leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
	local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(kid, pos, false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)

	scene_util.set_emotion(kid, self, 'smile')

	wp_util.move_async(kid, waypoints, 2, nil)

	character_util.look_at(leader, kid)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)
end

function local_class:kid_align_setting_3()
	local kid = self.get_kids(3)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	do
		local pos = kid.Position + (self.kid_find_data[kid.Name].player_set_dir_vector)

		party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member (pos, 'right', 1, 'linear')

		self:look_at_user_party(kid)
	end

	--연출중인 NPC 3은 플레이어 방향 0.5타일 앞으로 0.2 높이만큼 점프하며 틀어진 각도를 원복하고, 플레이어를 바라본다.

	local pos = leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left

	scene_util.set_emotion(kid, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(kid, self, 'get')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(kid, pos, 4, 0.2, true, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	character_util.look_at(kid, leader)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)
end

function local_class:align_party_linear(pos, dir)
	local move_offset = 1
	local move_key = 'align_party'
	local align_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if user_party[i].ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i],
					pos + (align_vector * move_offset),
					4,
					nil,
					self,
					move_key
			)
			move_offset = move_offset + 1
		end
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
end

function local_class:look_at_user_party(fo)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if user_party[i].ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			character_util.look_at(user_party[i], fo)
		end
	end
end

return local_class
