				pixy_party_move_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' }
		)

		for index = 1, #npcs do
			local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s4_invader_pos_' .. index)
			local set_pos = pos + vector(10, 0, 0)

			character_util.set_position(npcs[index], set_pos)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
					npcs[index],
					pos,
					6,
					nil,
					self,
					pixy_party_move_key, { run = true }
			)
		end
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, leader_party_move_key)
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, pixy_party_move_key)

	--NPC 1 (left, idle, idle) : 좋아, 그놈이 맞아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[1],
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			nil,
			'pw_main_s4_3'
	)

	--NPC 2 (left, attack, release 2회) : 멈추는 게 좋을 거다. 얌전히 따라오면 목숨은 부지할테니.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[2],
			self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'pw_main_s4_4'
	)

	--코르네 (right, doyagao, idle) : 하! 남의 나라 보물을 훔쳐 놓고… 참 당당하시네!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			pixy,
			self,
			'right',
			nil,
			'doyagao',
			{ key = 'pw_main_s4_5', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' }
	)

	--코르네 (right, attack, staff_idle) : [shout] 네깟 놈들에게 넘겨줄까보냐!
	--상단 대사 1.3배 + 화면 0.3 세기로 0.2초간 shake. 그와 함께 코르네 손에 champion_staff(임시 : firefly_staff)를 들려줌.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')

	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(
			pixy,
			self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'staff_idle', keep = true, upper = true },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'pw_main_s4_6', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt', scale = 1.3, skip = true }
	)

	--대사 종료되면 챔피언 포착 연출(ShowChampDetectEffect)이 실행되고 어두운 상태에서 하단의 대사 실행.
	--나레이션 : 챔피언 소드가 약하게 반응하고 있다!
	--이후 화면 틴트 원복.
	self:show_champ_detect_effect()

	--플레이어, 꼬마 공주 right, surprise, jump 1회 실행 후 완료될 때 까지 대기.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'surprise')

	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(princess)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	--이후 아래의 상황들 동시에 실행.
	--코르네 / NPC 1 ~ 6 현재 방향 / 이모션 유지한 채 1타일 좌측으로 walk(속도 1) 실행. 해당 실행완료 대기하지 않아도 됨.
	do
		character_util.remove_anim(pixy, true)

		wp_util.move(pixy, pixy.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 1, nil,
				{ locked_dir = 'right' })

		for index = 1, #npcs do

			wp_util.move(npcs[index], npcs[index].Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 1, nil)
		end
	end

	--플레이어 left, attack, release 2회를 실행.
	scene_util.play_custom_action(
			leader,
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
			end
	)

	--꼬마 공주 (right, attack, cast2) : 나도 봤어! 분명 이 반응은…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			princess,
			self,
			nil,
			'cast2',
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'pw_main_s4_8'
	)

	--NPC 1 : [shout] 모두 덮쳐!!!
	--상단 대사 1.3배 + 화면 0.3 세기로 0.2초간 shake + 플레이어 / 꼬마 공주 right, attack, jump 1회 실행.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)

	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(princess)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_appear_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(
			npcs[1],
			self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_main_s4_9', scale = 1.3, skip = true }
	)

	--대사 종료하면 각자 아래와 같이 퇴장
	--투 팀 모두 attack, run(속도 5)로 지정된 위치를 달려가서 화면 퇴장.
	--코르네 down 방향으로 일직선으로 달려 퇴장.
	--NPC 1 ~ 6 벽까지 left로 달린 후 down으로 다시 달려 퇴장.
	local pixy_before_battle_move = 'pixy_battle_zone_move'

	do
		local pos_offset = vector(0, 0, -10)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
				pixy,
				pixy.Position + pos_offset,
				6,
				nil,
				self,
				pixy_before_battle_move, { run = true, play_sfx = true, end_callback = function()

					character_util.set_position(pixy, self.get_pixy_battle_pos())

					scene_util.set_direction_by_args(pixy, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
				end }
		)

		for index = 1, #npcs do
			local pos_1 = npcs[index].Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)

			local npcs_waypoint = {
				pos_1,
				pos_1 + pos_offset
			}

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
					npcs[index],
					npcs_waypoint,
					6,
					nil,
					self,
					pixy_before_battle_move,
					{ run = true, play_sfx = true, end_callback = function()
						character_util.set_position(npcs[index], self.invader_battle_pos_data['invader_' .. index].pos)
						scene_util.set_emotion(npcs[index], self, 'attack')
						scene_util.set_direction_by_args(
								npcs[index],
								{ dir = self.invader_battle_pos_data['invader_' .. index].dir, sfx = false
								})
					end })
		end
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, pixy_before_battle_move)

	--퇴장 완료하면, 카메라 플레이어에게 복귀한 후 다음 대사 실행.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--꼬마 공주 (right, attack, idle) : 이대로면 인베이더들에게 잡히겠어! 우리가 도와주자!!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			princess,
			self,
			'right',
			'idle',
			'attack',
			'pw_main_s4_10'
	)

	--플레이어 left, attack, nod 2회 실행.
	scene_util.play_custom_action(
			leader,
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			'attack',
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')
			end
	)

	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point('main_quest', 412, true,
			field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s4_pixy_battle_pos'))

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:before_battle_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local pixy = self.get_pixy()
	local npcs = self:get_invader_party()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)
	quest_marker_util.remove('main_quest')

	--플레이어 트리거 존 입장 시 지정된 위치에 정렬.
	--코르네 : [shout] 치잇! 끈질기게 따라오네!!
	--상단 대사 화면 하단에 1.3배 + 이와 함께 화면 세기 0.3 / 시간 0.2만큼 shake.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(
			pixy,
			self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_main_s4_11', skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) }
	)

	--대사 종료되면 화면 빠르게 카메라 1번 지점으로 패닝.
	camera_util.move_async(pixy.Position, 0.5)

	--코르네 (right, attack, staff_idle) : 이게 그렇게 가지고 싶어? 앙?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			pixy,
			self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'pw_main_s4_12'
	)

	--NPC 5 (left, attack, idle) : 더러운 오염생물 주제에…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[5],
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			'attack',
			'pw_main_s4_13'
	)

	--NPC 6 (right, attack, idle) : 타겟이 손상되지만 않는다면 어떻게든 해도 된다고 했었지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[6],
			self,
			'right',
			nil,
			'attack',
			'pw_main_s4_14'
	)

	--NPC 5 (left, attack, idle) : 잘됐네. 시간도 없으니, 바로 쏴버리자고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[5],
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			'attack',
			'pw_main_s4_15'
	)

	--대사 종료되면 아래의 연출 동시에 진행.
	--NPC 1 ~ 6 전체 코르네 방향, attack, walk(2초 동안)로 0.5타일 만큼 코르네에게 다가감.
	local npc_move_key = 'invader_move_key'
	do
		local npc_left_data = { 3, 6, 4 }
		local npc_right_data = { 1, 5, 2 }
		local npc_count = 3

		for index = 1, npc_count do
			local left_npc = npcs[npc_left_data[index]]
			local right_npc = npcs[npc_right_data[index]]

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
					left_npc,
					left_npc.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
					nil,
					1,
					self,
					npc_move_key
			)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
					right_npc,
					right_npc.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
					nil,
					1,
					self,
					npc_move_key
			)
		end
	end

	--이 과정에서 코르네 아래의 연출 순서대로 실행
	--1초 대기.
	--left, attack, staff_idle
	do
		local wait_duration = 1

		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)
		scene_util.set_emotion(pixy, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(pixy, 'left')

		--1초 대기.
		--right, tired, staff_idle
		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)
		scene_util.set_emotion(pixy, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(pixy, 'right')

		--1초 대기.
		--left, damaged, staff_idle

		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)
		scene_util.set_emotion(pixy, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(pixy, 'left')

		--1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, npc_move_key)

	--위 연출 종료되면 하단의 연출 순서대로 실행.
	--슬로우모션 (0.2배) 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	local time_slow_key = 'time_slow'
	time_util.mod(time_slow_key, 0.2)

	--NPC 1 ~ 6 코르네 방향, attack, prostrate + jump(높이 2)를 실행하며 코르네 방향으로 리얼 타임 1.5 초간 달려듭니다.
	local npc_before_pos_data = {}
	do
		local duration = 1.5

		for index = 1, #npcs do
			scene_util.set_emotion(npcs[index], self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(npcs[index], self, 'prostrate')

			local offset = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(npcs[index].Direction))
			local wp = npcs[index].Position + offset
			table.insert(npc_before_pos_data, wp)

			character_util.jump(npcs[index], 1, duration)
			wp_util.move(npcs[index], pixy.Position, nil, duration)
		end
	end

	--인베이더 출발과 함께 플레이어, 꼬마 공주 각자 위치를 향해 down, attack, twohand_attack4를 실행하여 목표 위치에 리얼 타임 1초간 달려듭니다.
	--플레이어 무기 착용 스펙.
	--꼬마 공주 / 플레이어 도착 시점에 맞춰 슬로우모션 종료.
	do
		local princess_pos = pixy.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		local leader_pos = pixy.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
		local duration = 0.5

		scene_util.show_weapon(princess)
		scene_util.show_weapon(leader)

		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')

		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', scale = 2, loop = false })
		scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', scale = 2, loop = false })

		wp_util.move(leader, leader_pos, nil, duration)
		wp_util.move_async(princess, princess_pos, nil, duration)
	end

	time_util.unmod(time_slow_key)

	--리얼타임이 앞선 플레이어, 꼬마공주 도착 시점에 Fx_last_hit + 화면 0.3세기, 0.2시간만큼 shake.
	do
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(princess.Position)
	end

	--위 이펙트에 맞춰 NPC 1 ~ 6 Fx_hit, 레드 펄스를 적용하며, 자신 방향, damaged, damaged 로 2타일 크로네에게서 멀어진다.
	local npc_wait_key = 'npc_move'
	do
		for index = 1, #npcs do
			character_util.stop(npcs[index])
			character_util.cancel_jump(npcs[index])

			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npcs[index])
			self.fx.hit(npcs[index].Position)

			scene_util.set_emotion(npcs[index], self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(npcs[index], self, 'damaged')

			local dir = character_util.get_look_direction(npcs[index])
			character_util.set_locked_dir(npcs[index], dir)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(
					npcs[index],
					npc_before_pos_data[index],
					6,
					nil,
					self,
					npc_wait_key
			)
		end
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, npc_wait_key)

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--이후 꼬마 공주 left, attack, twohand_idle / 플레이어 right, attack, 무기 장착 상태 + NPC 1 ~ 6 jump 로 기상 후 코르네 방향, attack, idle.
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'twohand_idle')

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	do
		for index = 1, #npcs do
			local dir = character_util.get_look_direction(npcs[index])

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
			character_util.mario_jump_new(npcs[index], dir, 0.5)

			character_util.set_direction(npcs[index], dir)
			character_util.reset_locked_dir(npcs[index])
		end
	end

	--연출 완료한 후 대사 실행.
	--코르네 (left, damaged, staff_idle) : 뭐, 뭐야 너희들은! 오늘따라 처음 보는 것들이 달라붙어!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			pixy,
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			'damaged',
			'pw_main_s4_16'

	)

	--꼬마 공주 (left, attack, twohand_idle) : 괜찮아! 널 도와주러 온 거니까!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			princess,
			self,
			'left',
			'twohand_idle',
			nil,
			'pw_main_s4_17'
	)

	--NPC 5 (left, attack, idle) : 저놈들은 또 뭐야?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[5],
			self,
			'left',
			nil,
			'attack',
			'pw_main_s4_18'
	)

	--NPC 6 (right, attack, idle) : 젠장! 시간도 없는데 방해꾼이…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[6],
			self,
			'right',
			nil,
			'attack',
			'pw_main_s4_19'
	)
	--NPC 5 (left, attack, release 2회) : 뭐해! 얼른 공격해!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_appear_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(
			npcs[5],
			self,
			'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'pw_main_s4_20'
	)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	for idx = 1, 4 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('main_s4_battlegate_' .. idx, true))
	end

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleEndEffect = false

	self:custom_convert_to_monster(0, true)
	self:custom_convert_to_monster(1, false)
	self:custom_convert_to_monster(2, false)

	--대사 종료되면 전투 실행. 웨이브 전투 2회 진행.
	--전투 완료되면 화면 페이드 아웃.

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(pixy, user_party, false,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep, -(user_party.Count - 1))
end

function local_class:monster_wave(wave)
	local npcs = self:get_invader_party(wave)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_invader_beam_01',
		play_pos = self.get_pixy_battle_pos(),
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	for index = 1, #npcs do
		local npc = npcs[index]
		local pos = self.invader_battle_pos_data['invader_' .. index].pos

		self.fx.invader_beam():Instantiate(pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(npc, { dir = self.invader_battle_pos_data['invader_' .. index].dir })

		-- 몬스터가 리더를 발각
		npc.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false

		command_util.publish_monster_notice(npc, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	end
end

function local_class:custom_convert_to_monster(wave, notice)
	local npcs = self:get_invader_party(wave)

	for index = 1, #npcs do
		local npc = npcs[index]

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(npc, self.battle.group_name[wave + 1], self.battle.zone_name)
		npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = self.battle.notice_link_name[wave + 1]
		npc.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true

		if notice then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
			npc.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
			command_util.publish_monster_notice(npc, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		end
	end
end

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(

	--퇴장한 후 플레이어 컨토를 복귀.
	self.controller:progress_section()

	-- exit 에 마커 표시

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo('main_quest', 412, true, exit)

function local_class:get_invader_party(wave)
	local npcs = {}
	wave = lua_helper.get_or_default(wave, 0)

	do
		local npc_warrior_count = 4
		local warrior_start_index = 1 + (wave * npc_warrior_count)
		local warrior_max_index = npc_warrior_count * (wave + 1)

		for index = warrior_start_index, warrior_max_index do
			local npc = self.get_invader_warrior(index)

			table.insert(npcs, npc)
		end

		local npc_archer_count = 2
		local archer_start_index = 1 + (wave * npc_archer_count)
		local archer_max_index = npc_archer_count * (wave + 1)

		for index = archer_start_index, archer_max_index do
			local npc = self.get_invader_archer(index)

			table.insert(npcs, npc)
		end
	end

	return npcs
end

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldMainSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	self.available_stage_names = 'pixyworld_2'

function local_class:start_section_scene()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(leader, 0, 0)
	leader.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.5)

	local princess = self.get_princess()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(princess, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(princess, 0, 0)
	princess.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.5)

	local pixy_girl = self.get_pixy_girl()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(pixy_girl, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(pixy_girl, 0, 0)
	pixy_girl.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'walk'
	pixy_girl.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'idle'
	pixy_girl.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.5)

	local pixy_guards = {}
	local guard_count = 2

	for i = 1, guard_count do
		local guard = self.get_pixy_guard(i)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(guard, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guard, 0, 0)
		guard.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.5)
		table.insert(pixy_guards, guard)
	end

	--  이벤트 시작 전 세팅
	local barrier_pos = self:get_barrier_pos()

	-- 카메라 이미지의 노란색 마름모 지점에 위치
	camera_util.move_async(barrier_pos, 0)
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 화면 0.75초간 서큘러 페이드인. 끝날 때까지 대기
	local forest_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_forest_01',
		volume = 0.6, fade_in_time = 5, loop = true
	})

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 이미지의 “결계 이펙트” 지점에 fx_pw_barrier_enter_start 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_02')
	local barrier = self.fx.barrier_enter_start():Instantiate(barrier_pos)

	-- 경비 A(right, idle, idle) 결계 이펙트와 같은 위치에 투명도 0 상태로 배치
	pixy_guards[1].Position = barrier_pos
	scene_util.set_direction(pixy_guards[1], 'right', false)

	-- 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 경비 A shake 1회
	character_util.shake(pixy_guards[1], 0.03, 0.3)

	-- 경비 A 0.5초간 서서히 투명도 1로 설정. 끝날 때까지 대기
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(pixy_guards[1], 1, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 경비 A 3의 속도로 이미지의 도착 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	wp_util.move_async(pixy_guards[1], barrier_pos + vector(5.5, 0, 0), 5, nil,
			{ play_sfx = true, run = true })

	-- 0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 경비 A(left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(pixy_guards[1], 'left')

	-- 0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 경비 A(left, idle, release): 이렇게 들어오시면 됩니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pixy_guards[1], self, nil, 'release',
			nil, 'pw_main_s5_1')
	-- 경비 A(left, idle, idle)

	local move_end_key = 'move_end'

	local show_routine = function(character, target_pos)
		-- NPC(right, idle, idle) 결계 이펙트와 같은 위치에 투명도 0 상태로 배치
		character.Position = barrier_pos

		-- NPC shake 1회
		character_util.shake(character, 0.03, 0.3)

		-- NPC 0.5초간 서서히 투명도 1로 설정. 끝날 때까지 대기
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(character, 1, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- NPC 2의 속도로 이미지의 도착 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(character, target_pos, 4, nil, self, move_end_key)
	end

	-- 나머지 NPC들도 결계 안으로 진입한다
	-- 가디언 -> 공주 -> 코르네 -> 경비 B 순으로 진입한다
	-- 첫번째 NPC부터 아래의 동작들을 순서대로 진행한다
	-- 현재 NPC의 마지막 동작이 끝난 즉시 다음 NPC가 처음 동작부터 진행한다
	-- 모든 NPC의 동작이 끝난 후 다음 동작을 진행한다
	show_routine(leader, barrier_pos + vector(4.5, 0, 0))
	show_routine(princess, barrier_pos + vector(3.5, 0, 0))
	show_routine(pixy_girl, barrier_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 0))
	show_routine(pixy_guards[2], barrier_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0))

	character_util.hide_weapon(pixy_girl, true)
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- fx_pw_barrier_enter_start 이펙트 제거
	barrier:Dispose()

	-- 같은 위치에 fx_pw_barrier_enter_end 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_11')
	self.fx.barrier_enter_end():Instantiate(barrier_pos)

	-- 1초간 카메라 가디언 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	-- 이후 카메라 가디언 따라감
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 공주(right, idle, idle): 이건…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'pw_main_s5_2')

	-- 경비 A(left, idle, bomb_idle): 저희 마을은 이렇게 결계로 숨겨져 있어서….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pixy_guards[1], self, nil, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'pw_main_s5_3')

	-- 경비 A(left, idle, nod 2회): 지금처럼 픽시들의 안내를 받지 않으면 들어올 수 없도록 되어 있습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pixy_guards[1], self, nil, 'nod',
			nil, 'pw_main_s5_4')

	-- 경비 A(left, smile, bomb_idle): 외부인이 저희 마을에 들어온게 얼마만인지 모르겠군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pixy_guards[1], self, nil, 'bomb_idle',
			'smile', 'pw_main_s5_5')
	-- 경비 A(right, idle, idle)

	scene_util.set_direction(pixy_guards[1], 'right', false)

	local loop_end = false

	-- 길 따라 걷기 시작
	-- 5명의 모든 NPC(right, idle, walk) 2의 속도로 오른쪽으로 이동 시작
	-- 이후 대사들에서는 방향과 애니메이션은 유지한 채 표정만 기입한다
	-- 별도 언급 전까지는 이미지에 표시된 구간을 무한 루프한다
	--FIXME: 나중에 더미 타일셋 교체되면 배경이랑 맞춰봐야함
	start_coroutine(function()
		local loop_group = { pixy_guards[1], leader, princess, pixy_girl, pixy_guards[2] }
		local start_pos = self.get_loop_pos(1)
		local end_pos = self.get_loop_pos(2)

		for i = 1, #loop_group do
			scene_util.set_anim(loop_group[i], self, 'walk')
		end

		local dir_vec = vector(1, 0, 0)
		local speed = 2
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		while not loop_end do
			if loop_group[1].Position.x >= end_pos.x then
				for i = 1, #loop_group do
					loop_group[i].Position = start_pos - vector(i - 1, 0, 0)
				end
			end

			dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			for i = 1, #loop_group do
				loop_group[i].Position = loop_group[i].Position + dir_vec * speed * dt
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.remove_group_anim(loop_group)
	end)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 경비 B(smile): 이야~ 그나저나 정말 놀랐습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pixy_guards[2], self, nil, nil,
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'pw_main_s5_6')

	-- 경비 B(smile): 설마 했는데 진짜로 예언의 용사가 나타날 줄이야….
	-- 경비 B(smile)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pixy_guards[2], 'pw_main_s5_7')

	-- 선택지
	-- (normal) 예언의 용사? / (brutal) 벌써 여기까지 소문이 나다니. 이놈의 인기란….
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'pw_main_s5_8', 'normal' }, { 'pw_main_s5_9', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- (normal) 예언의 용사?
		-- 가디언 question 이모티콘 출력
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')
	else
		-- (brutal) 벌써 여기까지 소문이 나다니. 이놈의 인기란….
		-- 경비 B(tired)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(pixy_guards[2], self, 'tired')

		-- 가디언(doyagao) happy 이모티콘 출력
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')

function local_class:action_tap(field_ui_type)
	local need_process_gamepad = CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled

	local event_listener = {}
	local wait_check = false

	local tap_event = function()
		wait_check = true
	end

	-- TouchEvent EventListener 생성
	event_listener.on_touch_event = function(_, e)
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown then
			tap_event()
		end

		return false
	end

	-- GamepadEvent EventListener 생성
	event_listener.on_gamepad_event = function(_, e)
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown then
			tap_event()
		end

		return false
	end

	event_listener.on_stage_end_event = function(_, _)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	if need_process_gamepad then
		message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
	end

	message_system:SubscribeOnce(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	qte_play_util.show_action_tap(field_ui_type, true, 1, false)

	while not wait_check do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if need_process_gamepad then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	return wait_check == true
end

function local_class:action_tap(field_ui_type)
	local need_process_gamepad = CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled

	local event_listener = {}
	local wait_check = false

	local tap_event = function()
		wait_check = true
	end

	-- TouchEvent EventListener 생성
	event_listener.on_touch_event = function(_, e)
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown then
			tap_event()
		end

		return false
	end

	-- GamepadEvent EventListener 생성
	event_listener.on_gamepad_event = function(_, e)
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown then
			tap_event()
		end

		return false
	end

	event_listener.on_stage_end_event = function(_, _)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	if need_process_gamepad then
		message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
	end

	message_system:SubscribeOnce(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	qte_play_util.show_action_tap(field_ui_type, true, 1, false)

	while not wait_check do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if need_process_gamepad then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	return wait_check == true
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:set_event_npc()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local pixy_girl = self.get_pixy_girl()
	character_util.remove_anim(pixy_girl)
	scene_util.set_anim(pixy_girl, self, 'seat')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_name)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state >= self.states.interact_all_pixy_villager then
		return false
	end

	local event_spec = self.event_specs[self.cur_event_index]

	if event_spec == nil then
		return false
	end

	local target_npc = event_spec:npc()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, target_npc) then
		sp_util.start_scene(event_spec.event_func, self, target_npc)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state == self.states.interact_all_pixy_villager and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's8_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.pixy_girl_join
		start_coroutine(self.pixy_girl_after_all_meet_villager, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	-- (brutal) 이번 챔피언 뽑기는 실패다….
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'pw_main_s8_42', 'mercy' },
		{ 'pw_main_s8_43', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- (mercy) 우리가 제자로 받아들이죠!
		-- 가디언(right, doyagao, victory_get 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 공주(left, idle, idle) notice 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'notice')

		-- 가디언(right, idle, idle)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- 공주(left, smile, release): $name은 천재야!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, { name = 'release', keep = true },
				'smile', 'pw_main_s8_43_1')
	else
		-- (brutal) 이번 챔피언 뽑기는 실패다….

		-- 공주(left, attack, idle)
		character_util.remove_anim(princess)
		scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')

		-- 가디언(right, tired, frustration 1회, 마지막 프레임 유지) 애니메이션 끝날 때까지 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'frustration')

		-- 1.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		-- 가디언(right, tired, idle)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		-- 공주(left, attack, release): 그런말 하지마! 코르네도 기회가 있었으면… 
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'release',
				'attack', 'pw_main_s8_43_2')

		-- 공주(left, idle, idle) notice 이모티콘 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'notice')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 공주(left, smile, release): 우리가 코르네에게 기회를 주는거야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'release',
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'pw_main_s8_43_3')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'cast',
			nil, 'pw_main_s8_43_4')

	-- 가디언(right, idle, nod 2회) 끝날 때까지 대기
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')

	-- 공주(left, smile, idle, jump 2회) jump 끝날 때까지 대기
	character_util.normal_double_jump(princess, true)

	-- 공주(left, smile, release): 어서 가자, $name!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'release',
			'smile', 'pw_main_s8_43_5')
	-- 공주(left, smile, idle)

	-- 컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
	-- 이벤트 종료 후 경비에게 상호작용시 원라인 대사 출력
	-- 픽시(right, idle, idle): 도움이 됐으면 좋겠네요.
	character_util.remove_relate_event(pixy, self.controller)
	pixy.Interactable.Talk = 'pw_main_s8_oneline_3'

	self.current_state = self.states.interact_all_pixy_villager

	-- 코르네에게 퀘스트 마커
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.controller.quest_name,
			412, true, self.get_pixy_girl())

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- 이벤트 진행용 npc 배치 및 퀘스트 마커 세팅
function local_class:set_event_npc()
	local event_spec = self.event_specs[self.cur_event_index]

	if event_spec == nil then
		return
	end

	local npc = event_spec:npc()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

	if event_spec.dir ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_direction(npc, event_spec.dir, false)
	end

	if event_spec.emotion ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, event_spec.emotion)

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class PixyWorldMuscleController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldMuscleController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = true,
		NormalSectionCount = 1,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.quest_name = 'pixyworld_muscle'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.event_section_conditions = {
		is_not_complete = -1,
		pre_section = 0,
		section_1 = 1,
		is_complete = 2,
	}

	self.characters = {
		muscle			= function() return get_character('muscle') end,
		ending_muscle			= function() return get_character('ending_muscle') end,
		kiwi			= function() return get_character('kiwi') end,
	}

	self.star_piece_name = 'muscle_starpiece'

	-- field object
	self.field_object = {
		star_piece = function() return get_field_object(self.star_piece_name) end,
		dumbbell = function() return get_field_object('muscle_dumbbell') end,
		start_button   = function() return get_field_object('muscle_start_area_switch_1') end,
	}

	self.quest_id = 424

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		muscle      = function(pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_muscle_muscle_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		kiwi      = function(pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_muscle_kiwi_' .. pos_idx)
		end,
	}

	self.events = nil

	-- item
	-- 사용할 아이템들 id
	self.item_id = {
		dumbbell = 21293,
	}

	self.items = {
		data = nil,
		add_item = function(this, item_key, item_id, pos, scale, create_on_character, dont_show_loot_text)
			if this.data == nil then
				this.data = {}
			end

			create_on_character = lua_helper.get_or_default(create_on_character, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = pos,
				item_id = item_id,
				spr_scale = scale,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				show_on_character = create_on_character,
				skip_text = dont_show_loot_text
			})

			this.data[item_key] = item
		end,
		pop_item = function(this, item_id)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for key, item_data in pairs(this.data) do
					if item_data.ItemId == item_id then
						local item = item_data

						this.data[key] = nil

						return item
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end,
		pop_item_list = function(this, item_id_list)
			local item_list = {}

			if this.data ~= nil then
				linq(item_id_list):foreach(function(idx, item_id_data)
					for key, item_data in pairs(this.data) do
						if item_data.ItemId == item_id_data then
							local item = item_data

							table.insert(item_list, item)

							this.data[key] = nil
						end
					end
				end)
			end

			return item_list
		end,

		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.data[i])
					this.data[i] = nil
				end

				this.data = nil
			end
		end
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)
	local quest_inner_progress = quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.InnerProgress or -1
	local quest_complete = quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete or false

	local zone_event = self.events['zone_enter']

	if zone_event ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #zone_event do
			local condition_index = quest_complete and self.event_section_conditions.is_complete or self.event_section_conditions.is_not_complete

			if condition_index == self.event_section_conditions.is_not_complete then
				local progress = quest_inner_progress + 1

				if zone_event[i].condition == progress then
					condition_index = progress
				end
			end

			if zone_event[i].condition == condition_index then
				if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, zone_event[i].zone_name) then
					if zone_event[i].control then
						if zone_event[i].once and not zone_event[i].passed then
							zone_event[i].passed = true

							start_coroutine(zone_event[i].func, self)
						elseif not zone_event[i].once then
							start_coroutine(zone_event[i].func, self)
						end
					else
						if zone_event[i].once and not zone_event[i].passed then
							zone_event[i].passed = true

							sp_util.start_scene(zone_event[i].func, self)
						elseif not zone_event[i].once then
							sp_util.start_scene(zone_event[i].func, self)
						end
					end

					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.events = {
		['zone_enter'] = {
			{ zone_name = 'sub_muscle_start_attracting', once = false, passed = false, condition = self.event_section_conditions.is_not_complete,
			  func = self.play_muscle_oneline_ment, control = true },
		},
	}

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)
	local quest_complete = quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete or false
	local star_piece = self.field_object.star_piece()

	if quest_complete then
		local ending_muscle = self.characters.ending_muscle()
		local kiwi = self.characters.kiwi()

		field_object_util.set_active_state(ending_muscle, active_state_type.enabled)
		scene_util.set_direction(ending_muscle, 'left', false)
		character_util.set_position(ending_muscle, self.markers.muscle(2) + vector(0, -0.1, 0))

		field_object_util.set_active_state(kiwi, active_state_type.enabled)
		scene_util.set_direction(kiwi, 'down', false)
		character_util.set_position(kiwi, self.markers.muscle(2) + vector(0, 0, 0.5))

		kiwi.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		kiwi.Interactable.Talk = 'pw_muscle_s1_2_22'

		ending_muscle.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		ending_muscle.Interactable.Talk = 'pw_muscle_s1_2_23'

		if not star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name) then
			star_piece.Position = self.markers.muscle(2) + vector(1, 0, 0.5)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(star_piece, active_state_type.enabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(star_piece, active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		local dumbbell = self.field_object.dumbbell()

		dumbbell.Position = self.field_object.start_button().Position

		self.items:add_item('dumbbell', self.item_id.dumbbell, dumbbell.Position, 0.5, false)

		message_system:SendSync(self.field_object.start_button(), CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(dumbbell))
	else
		star_piece.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.items ~= nil then
		self.items:dispose_all()
	end
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc_data(section)
	local pre_npc_data = section.pre_npc_data[section.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			return
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, section, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, section, { name = npc_data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if npc_data.string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.string
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_1_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
					npc_data.weapon_1_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_2_id then
			character_util.set_equipment(npc, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2,
					npc_data.weapon_2_id, true)
		end

		if npc_data.show_weapon then
			scene_util.show_weapon(npc)
		end

		if npc_data.active_state == false then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
		end

		return self:on_interact_event(e)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local interact_event = self.events['interact'][self.current_state]

	if interact_event ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #interact_event do
			if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, interact_event[i].target) then
				if interact_event[i].control then
					start_coroutine(interact_event[i].func, self)
				else
					sp_util.start_scene(interact_event[i].func, self)
				end

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_event = self.events['zone_enter'][self.current_state]

	if zone_event ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #zone_event do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, zone_event[i].zone_name) then
				if zone_event[i].control then
					if zone_event[i].once and not zone_event[i].passed then
						zone_event[i].passed = true

						start_coroutine(zone_event[i].func, self)
					elseif not zone_event[i].once then
						start_coroutine(zone_event[i].func, self)
					end
				else
					if zone_event[i].once and not zone_event[i].passed then
						zone_event[i].passed = true

						sp_util.start_scene(zone_event[i].func, self)
					elseif not zone_event[i].once then
						sp_util.start_scene(zone_event[i].func, self)
					end
				end

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:request_muscle_search()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local kiwi = self.characters.kiwi()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	quest_icon_util.remove(kiwi)

	-- 인터렉트시 플레이어는 right를 바라보며 키위 앞에 정렬.
	party_util.align_party_ignore_deactivated_party_member(kiwi.Position, 'left', 1)

	if not self.first_encounter_with_kiwi then
		-- 키위 인터랙트시 키위(left,idle,cast) 로 전환.
		scene_util.set_direction(kiwi, 'left', true)
		scene_util.set_anim(kiwi, self, { name = 'cast' })

		-- 키위(left,idle,idle) : 당신은… 마을에 들어왔다는 용사님?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_2', skip = true })

		-- 키위(left,smile,victory_extra) : 마침 잘 됐어요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'victory_extra' },
				{ name = 'smile' },
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_3', skip = true })

		-- 키위(left,idle,idle) : 제 부탁 하나만 들어주실 수 있나요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_4', skip = true })

		-- 키위(left,smile,sing) : 용사님이라면, 불가능도 가능으로 만드실 수 있을 것 같거든요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'sing' },
				{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_5', skip = true })

		-- 플레이어 right, smile, nod 2회 를 실행.
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

		-- 키위 (left,idle,idle) : 다른 건 아니고, 이곳에서 머슬이라는 친구와 만나기로 약속을 했는데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_6', skip = true })

		-- 키위 (left,tired,idle) : 약속을 잊었는지 오지 않네요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_7', skip = true })

		-- 키위 (left,tired,idle) : 함께 하기로 한 게 있는데, 이러다가는 늦어버리겠어요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_8', skip = true })

		-- 키위 (left,tired,idle) : 아마 멀지 않은 곳에 있을텐데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_9', skip = true })

		-- 키위 (left,tired,idle) : 저는 이곳에서 준비할 게 있어서 직접 찾으러 갈 수가 없어요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_10', skip = true })

		-- 키위 (left,smile,idle) : 혹시 용사님께서 머슬을 데려와주실 수 있으신가요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_11', skip = true })
	else
		-- 재인터랙트 시
		-- 키위 (left, idle, idle) : 용사님! 이제 절 도와줄 생각이 드셨나요?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_13', skip = true })
	end

	-- 퀘스트 수락 UI
	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.cs_controller.QuestId, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	if not accepted then
		-- 플레이어 (right, idle, cross_arm)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })

		-- 키위 (left, tired, idle) : 아쉽네요… 그럼 누구한테 부탁하지…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
				{ dir = 'left', sfx = false },
				nil,
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_12', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		self.first_encounter_with_kiwi = true

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		return
	else
		-- 플레이어 (right, smile, nod 2회)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

		-- 퀘스트 수락 연출 진행.
	end

	floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party.Leader, self.cs_controller.QuestSpec.QuestName, 0)

	-- 키위 (left,smile,jump 1회) : 부탁을 들어주셔서 감사해요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(kiwi, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_16', skip = true })

	-- 키위 (left,attack,idle) : 아참, 혹시 머슬이 고집을 부린다면 이걸 사용해주세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_17', skip = true })

	-- 이후 키위 left, attack, attack을 실행하여 mashle_puff(임시 : birthday_cake)를 플레이어에게 던지고, 플레이어 아이템 획득 연출과 함께 획득.
	self.controller.items:add_item('custard_cream', self.item_id.custard_cream, vector(999, 0, 999), 0.5, false)

	scene_util.set_anim(kiwi, self, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(kiwi, 'attack')

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.75)

	local item = self.controller.items:pop_item(self.item_id.custard_cream)

	item.Position = kiwi.Position
	drop_item_util.throw_item(item, leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0))

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, leader)

	-- 상단 머릿말 : 폭신폭신 달콤해보입니다.
	-- 아이템명 : 슈크림
	-- 아이템 설명 : 고열량과 맛까지 책임져 운동하는 사람에게는 필수입니다.
	screen_util.item_get_event('pw_custard_cream',
			'pw_custard_cream_title',
			'pw_custard_cream_sub_title',
			'pw_custard_cream_desc')

	-- 키위 (left, smile, idle) : 이 한정판 슈크림만 있다면 무엇이든 해결 가능하답니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'pw_muscle_pre_1_18', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(kiwi)
	scene_util.set_emotion(kiwi, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_direction(kiwi, 'down', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 섹션1로
	self.controller:activate_quest(0)
end

return local_class

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.muscle(), self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.kiwi(), self)

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local interact_event = self.events['interact'][self.current_state]

	if interact_event ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #interact_event do
			if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, interact_event[i].target) then
				if interact_event[i].control then
					start_coroutine(interact_event[i].func, self)
				else
					sp_util.start_scene(interact_event[i].func, self)
				end

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_event = self.events['zone_enter'][self.current_state]

	if zone_event ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #zone_event do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, zone_event[i].zone_name) then
				if zone_event[i].control then
					if zone_event[i].once and not zone_event[i].passed then
						zone_event[i].passed = true

						start_coroutine(zone_event[i].func, self)
					elseif not zone_event[i].once then
						start_coroutine(zone_event[i].func, self)
					end
				else
					if zone_event[i].once and not zone_event[i].passed then
						zone_event[i].passed = true

						sp_util.start_scene(zone_event[i].func, self)
					elseif not zone_event[i].once then
						sp_util.start_scene(zone_event[i].func, self)
					end
				end

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local switch_fo = self.field_object.start_button()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, switch_fo) then
		if e.IsTurningOn then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('forest_door_1'))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('forest_door_2'))
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('forest_door_1', false))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('forest_door_2', false))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:chase_event_routine()
	self.is_muscle_chasing = true
	self.muscle_move_duration = 0

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_chasing' })

	self.current_activity_states = self.activity_states.start

	self.current_state = self.states.activity_playing

	local muscle = self.characters.muscle()
	local cur_route_option = self.move_route_opt[self.muscle_route_index]
	local rock_list = {}

	local catch_player = function()
		local check = self:check_catch_dist(user_party.Leader.Position, muscle.Position)

		if check then
			self.current_activity_states = self.activity_states.fail
			self.is_muscle_chasing = false

			-- 플레이어, 머슬 현재 위치에서 정지.
			character_util.stop(muscle)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, self.rock_count do
		table.insert(rock_list, self.field_object.rock(i))
	end

	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true,
												 parent = muscle, max_distance = 6 })

	wp_util.move(muscle, self.muscle_move_routes[self.muscle_route_index],
			cur_route_option.speed, cur_route_option.duration, { run = cur_route_option.run })

	while self.is_muscle_chasing do

		if self.muscle_move_duration > cur_route_option.duration then

			self.muscle_route_index = self.muscle_route_index + 1
			cur_route_option = self.move_route_opt[self.muscle_route_index]

			if self.muscle_route_index > self.muscle_route_last_index then

				self.current_activity_states = self.activity_states.clear
				self.is_muscle_chasing = false

				break
			end

			if not cur_route_option.jump then
				wp_util.move(muscle, self.muscle_move_routes[self.muscle_route_index],
						nil, cur_route_option.duration, { run = true })
			else
				character_util.move_to(
						muscle,
						self.muscle_move_routes[self.muscle_route_index],
						cur_route_option.duration,
						nil,
						false,
						false)
				scene_util.set_anim(muscle, self, 'get')
				scene_util.set_direction(muscle, 'right', false)
				character_util.jump(muscle, 0.8, cur_route_option.duration)
			end

			local catch = catch_player()

			if catch then
				break
			end

			self.muscle_move_duration = 0
		else
			self.muscle_move_duration = self.muscle_move_duration + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if not self.is_muscle_chasing and self.current_activity_states == self.activity_states.clear then
				return
			end

			if not cur_route_option.jump then
				local catch = catch_player()

				if catch then
					break
				end
			end


			for i = 1, #rock_list do
				local collision = self:check_collision_bounds(rock_list[i], muscle)

				if collision then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_01')

					for j = 1, #self.camera_shake_by_rock_idx do
						if rock_list[i].Name == self.camera_shake_by_rock_idx[j] then
							camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
						end
					end

					table.remove(rock_list, i)

					break
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.muscle_move_duration = 0
	self.muscle_route_index = 1

	for idx, group in ipairs(rock_list) do
		table.remove(rock_list, idx)
	end

	rock_list = nil

	if self.current_activity_states == self.activity_states.fail then
		if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
			self.loop_sfx:Stop()
			self.loop_sfx = nil
		end

		sp_util.start_scene(self.catch_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:check_catch_dist(pos1, pos2)
	local target_dist = (pos1 - pos2).magnitude

	if target_dist <= self.catch_distance then
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:catch_event()
	local muscle = self.characters.muscle()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local leader_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	-- 슬로우모션 0.5배 실행.
	time_util.mod('slow_motion', 0.5)

	local muscle_pos = self:party_side_pos()

	-- 머슬 플레이어 위치를 기준으로 right, attack, hold(정지 상태로) 실행하며 0.5초 안에 빠르게 접근.
	character_util.look_at(muscle, leader)
	local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(muscle.Direction)
	scene_util.set_direction(muscle, side_dir, false)

	scene_util.set_anim(muscle, self, { name = 'hold', scale = 0, loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false })

	local move_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.move_to_async(
				muscle,
				muscle_pos,
				0.25,
				nil,
				true,
				false)

		move_end = true

		character_util.look_at(muscle, leader)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_02')
	end)

	-- 머슬 도착하면 플레이어 surprise, embarrassed를 실행하고 1초(리얼 타임) 동안 유지.
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, nil,
			{ name = 'embarrassed', keep = true }, { name = 'surprise', keep = true }, 0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition, 0)

	-- 슬로우모션 1배로 원복.
	time_util.unmod('slow_motion')

	while not move_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 현재 상태에서 정지한 뒤, 하단의 대사 실행.
	-- 머슬 (down, sleep_deep, hold[정지]) : 트리플 숄더 스킬…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(muscle, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true },
			{ key = 'pw_muscle_s1_1_8', skip = true })

	-- 머슬 (right, attack, hold) : [shout] 스카이 트래블!!!
	-- 말풍선 1.5배 + 실행 타이밍에 화면 0.4 크기로 0.2초간 shake + 캐릭터들 가리지 않는 위치에 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(muscle, 1)
	scene_util.set_anim(muscle, self, { name = 'hold', loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)
	local ment_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(muscle, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
				{ key = 'pw_muscle_s1_1_9', scale = 1.5, viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.8), skip = true })

		ment_end = true
	end)

	local item = self.controller.items.data['custard_cream']

	self:detach_item_to_leader_head(item)

	item.Position = leader_pos

	-- 이후 머슬 플레이어 방향, attack, hold를 실행하며
	-- 플레이어 + 공주 surprise, cast2 상태로 0.5초 안에 Y축 화면 바깥으로 날려버리며, 플레이어 머리에 부착된 mashle_puff 제거.

	side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(leader.Direction)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, side_dir, false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')

	start_coroutine(function()
		if muscle.Position.z < item.Position.z then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(muscle, 'Top Effects', 1)
		end

		drop_item_util.throw_item(item, vector(leader.Position.x, 0, leader.Position.z), { rotation_num = 3.1 })

		item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.01, -0.03)
	end)

	-- 02_hit_critical_02 + 01_fall_down_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	character_util.move_to(
			leader,
			leader.Position + vector(0, 10, 0),
			0.5,
			nil,
			false,
			false)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	while not ment_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 연출 종료된 뒤 머슬 right, smile, eat를 실행하며 아래의 대사 실행
	if muscle.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down or muscle.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		if muscle.Position.x > item.Position.x then
			scene_util.set_direction(muscle, 'left', false)
		else
			scene_util.set_direction(muscle, 'right', false)
		end
	end
	-- 머슬 (right, smile, eat) : 냠냠…
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true,
												 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(muscle, 1)
	character_util.remove_anim(muscle)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(muscle, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'pw_muscle_s1_1_10', skip = true })

	-- 머슬 : 이 다음 루틴은… 데드 리프트…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(muscle, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_muscle_s1_1_11', skip = true })

	self:choose_restart()
end

	local muscle = self.characters.muscle()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.move_async(vector(777, 0, 777), 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 나레이션 : 키위가 준 슈크림을 꺼내겠습니까?
	local nar_data = {
		key = 'pw_muscle_s1_2_24'
	}

	local choose_data = {}
	table.insert(choose_data, { 'pw_muscle_s1_2_25', 'mercy' })
	table.insert(choose_data, { 'pw_muscle_s1_2_26', 'brutal' })

	--나레이션 박스를 유지한 채 선택지
	local choose_result = field_ui_util.show_narration_talk_branch_async(nar_data, choose_data)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	if choose_result == 1 then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(muscle)
		scene_util.set_direction(muscle, 'right', false)
		character_util.set_position(muscle, self.markers.muscle(1) + vector(2, 0, 0))

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
		character_util.set_position(leader, self.markers.muscle(1) + vector(5, 0, 0))

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

		self:shortcut_reset()

		wait_for_sec(0.15)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:interact_muscle_post_event()
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 페이드 인 시, 머슬 인터렉트 전 위치로 복귀.
		self:reset_activity()
	end

function local_class:reset_activity()

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	muscle.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(muscle, 'Default', 0)

	wp_util.move_async(muscle, self.markers.muscle(1),
			nil, 0.25)

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.markers.muscle(1) + vector(1.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	character_util.set_position(princess, self.markers.muscle(1) + vector(2.2, 0, 0))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'left', false)
	if self.pixy_exist then
		character_util.set_position(pixy_girl, self.markers.muscle(1) + vector(2.9, 0, 0))

		scene_util.set_direction(pixy_girl, 'left', false)
	end

	local item = self.controller.items.data['custard_cream']

	item.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 돌 복구
	for i = 1, self.rock_count do
		local rock = self.field_object.rock(i)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(rock, active_state_type.enabled)
	end

	message_system:SendSync(self.field_object.start_button(), CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(muscle))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('forest_door_1'))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('forest_door_2'))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(muscle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(muscle)
	scene_util.set_direction(muscle, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(muscle, self, 'unique/exercise')

	character_util.add_listener(muscle, self.controller)

	self.current_activity_states = self.activity_states.none
	self.current_state = self.states.none

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(princess, user_party, false,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep, -(user_party.Count - 1))

	if self.pixy_exist then
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(pixy_girl, user_party, false,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep, -(user_party.Count - 2))
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:shortcut_reset()
	local muscle = self.characters.muscle()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(muscle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(muscle)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(muscle, 'Default', 0)

	scene_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, self, 'tired')

	self:attach_item_to_leader_head(item)

	for i = 1, self.rock_count do

		field_object_util.set_active_state(rock, active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

function local_class:check_collision_bounds(fo_1, fo_2)
	local bounds1 = fo_1.Bounds
	local bounds2 = fo_2.Bounds

	if bounds2.min.x <= bounds1.max.x and  bounds2.max.x >= bounds1.min.x
			and bounds2.min.z <= bounds1.max.z and  bounds2.max.z >= bounds1.min.z then

		self.fx.explode():Instantiate(fo_1.Position)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(fo_1, active_state_type.disabled)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:play_activity_end_event()

	-- 머슬 left, attack, jump를 실행하며 0.5초 만에 Y축 화면 바깥으로 날아가버린다.

	-- 화면 0.3 크기로 0.2초간 shake

	-- 플레이어 손에 mashle_puff 제거하고, 플레이어 몸에서부터 mashle_puff가 0.5의 높이로 2번 바운스하여 3타일 좌측으로 이동.
	local item = self.controller.items.data['custard_cream']

	self:detach_item_to_leader_head(item)

	quest_drop_item_util.move(item, self.markers.muscle(2) + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), {
		angle = 810,
		duration = 0.7,
		y_move = function(progress)
			--비콘은 기존 dropitem 연출이 아니라, 별도의 연출로.
			--떨어져 나오면서 바닥에 한번 튕기는 연출 진행.
			local height = 0.5
			if progress * 2 > 1 then
				height = 0.6
			end

			return math.abs(math.sin(math.pi * progress * 2)) * height
		end

	-- 플레이어 left, damaged, prostrate 상태로 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'pw_muscle_s1_2_19', skip = true })

	-- 키위 (down, smile, push) : 용사님! 저희의 사랑을 도와주셔서 감사해요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kiwi, self,

	self.controller:complete_quest({ run_fame_alignment = false })
end

function local_class:attach_item_to_leader_head(item)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.backup_item_sprite_parent = item.SpriteTransform.parent
	self.backup_item_shadow_parent = item.ShadowTransform.parent

	item.SpriteTransform:SetParent(leader.transform)
	item.ShadowTransform:SetParent(leader.transform)

	item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:detach_item_to_leader_head(item)
	item.SpriteTransform:SetParent(self.backup_item_sprite_parent)
	item.ShadowTransform:SetParent(self.backup_item_shadow_parent)

	item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	item.ShadowTransform.position = item.SpriteTransform.position + vector(0, -0.01, -0.03)
	item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.01, -0.03)
end

function local_class:party_side_pos()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local muscle = self.characters.muscle()

	local result = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local dist = leader.Position - muscle.Position
	local center = leader.Position
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(dist)

	result = center + (direction * -0.5)

	return result
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldMutationPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = PixyWorldMutation @
		Comment = @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchHardController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_19_2'

	self.cur_oneline_count = 10
	self.post_oneline_count = 19

	self.characters = {
		cur_oneline = function(number)
			return get_character('pixy_oneline_' .. number)
		end,
		post_oneline = function(number)
			return get_character('post_oneline_' .. number)
		end,
		cardboard_box_npc = function(number)
			return get_character('cardboard_box_npc_' .. number)
		end
	}

	self.markers = {
		oneline_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('post_oneline_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		cardboard_box_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_cardboard_box_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}

	self.zone_name = 'status_zone'

	self.button_icon_name = 'actbtn_ic_act_status.png'

	self.button_state = {
		none = 1,
		ready = 2,
		pressed = 3
	}

	self.cur_button_state = self.button_state.none

	self.focus_fx = nil
	self.error_fx = nil

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		status_error = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('pixy_status_error_loop')
		end,
		focus_on = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_pixy_status_focus_on')
		end,
		focus_off = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_pixy_status_focus_off')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			load_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	for i = 1, self.cur_oneline_count do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.characters.cur_oneline(i), active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	for i = 1, self.post_oneline_count do
		local npc = self.characters.post_oneline(i)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(npc, self.markers.oneline_pos(i))
	end

	local cardboard_box_npc_b = self.characters.cardboard_box_npc(2)
	cardboard_box_npc_b.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

	character_util.set_position(cardboard_box_npc_b, self.markers.cardboard_box_pos(1))
	character_util.set_direction(cardboard_box_npc_b, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(cardboard_box_npc_b, self, 'confused')
	scene_util.set_anim(cardboard_box_npc_b, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })

	self.boomerang_controller = get_stage_event_controller('PixyWorldBoomerangController')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local zone = field:GetZone(self.zone_name)

	if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(zone.Bounds, user_party.Leader.Position) then
		self:button_active()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

	self:fx_dispose()

	self.boomerang_controller = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
		self:button_active()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name) then
		self:button_deactive()
		self:fx_dispose()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.cur_button_state ~= self.button_state.ready then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown then
		self.cur_button_state = self.button_state.pressed
		start_coroutine(self.button_pressed, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if self.cur_button_state ~= self.button_state.ready then
		return false
	end

	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightTriggerDown then
		self.cur_button_state = self.button_state.pressed
		start_coroutine(self.button_pressed, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:button_active()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local ui_type = CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1
	local button = field_ui_manager:GetUI(leader)[ui_type]

	self.boomerang_controller:boomerang_active_setting(false)

	button:SetIcon(self.button_icon_name)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(ui_type, leader)

	if self.focus_fx == nil then
		self.focus_fx = self.fx.focus_on():Instantiate(self.characters.cardboard_box_npc(2).Position)
	end

	self.cur_button_state = self.button_state.ready
end

function local_class:button_deactive()
	self.boomerang_controller:boomerang_active_setting(true)

	self.cur_button_state = self.button_state.none

	self.fx.focus_off():Instantiate(self.characters.cardboard_box_npc(2).Position)
end

function local_class:button_pressed()
	local cardboard_box_npc_b = self.characters.cardboard_box_npc(2)
	local right_side_position_adjust_value = vector(2, 0, -1)

	if self.error_fx == nil then
		self.error_fx = self.fx.status_error():Instantiate(cardboard_box_npc_b.Position + right_side_position_adjust_value)
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose()
	if self.focus_fx ~= nil then
		self.focus_fx:Dispose()
		self.focus_fx = nil
	end

	if self.error_fx ~= nil then
		self.error_fx:Dispose()
		self.error_fx = nil
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldMutationPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = PixyWorldMutation @
		Comment = @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldMutationController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'pixyworld_3'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		show_detective = 3,
		talk_detective = 4,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.characters = {
		female = function()
			return get_character('mutation_female')
		end,
		guard = function()
			return get_character('mutation_guard_1')
		end,
		detective = function()
			return get_character('mutation_detective')
		end
	}

	self.zones = {
		female_zone = 'mutation_female_zone',
		detective_zone = 'mutation_detective_zone',
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local female = self.characters.female()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(female, active_state_type.enabled)
	scene_util.set_emotion(female, self, 'cry')
	female.Interactable.Talk = nil

	local guard = self.characters.guard()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(guard, active_state_type.enabled)
	guard.Interactable.Talk = nil

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.characters.detective(), active_state_type.enabled)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.characters.detective(), self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.detective()) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.show_detective then
			self.current_state = self.states.talk_detective
			sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_detective_event, self, true)
		else
			sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_detective_event, self, false)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.detective_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.show_detective
		start_coroutine(self.show_detective_event, self)

		return true
	end


	return false
end
--endregion event

--- 존 입장 시 탐정 대사 이벤트
function local_class:show_detective_event()
	local female = self.characters.female()
	local guard = self.characters.guard()
	local detective = self.characters.detective()

	--여A(left,cry,cast) : 도대체 이게 며칠째인가요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_female_cry_02', loop = false, parent = female })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(female, 'pw_mutation_pre_1', false)

	--여A(left,cry,cast) : 이제는 제발 우리 아이를 찾아주세요….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(female, 'pw_mutation_pre_2', false)

	--가드7(right,tied,idle) : 사모님, 진정하세요. 저희도 노력 중이니 조금만 기다려주십시오.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guard, 'pw_mutation_pre_3', false)

	female.Interactable.Talk = 'pw_mutation_pre_2'
	guard.Interactable.Talk = 'pw_mutation_pre_3'

	--탐정  (right,idle,question) 상태로 (silence) 버블 출력
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(detective, nil, 'silence')

	--이후 (left,idle,nod 2회)
	character_util.set_direction(detective, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(detective, self, 'nod')

	--탐정 (left, idle, question) : 풀리지 않는 미스테리… 계속되는 실종 사건…
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'question')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_pre_12', false)

	--탐정 (left, idle, question) : 역시 이 사건을 해결할 수 있는건 나, 탐정 P 밖에 없나!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_pre_13', false)

	--이후 탐정 NPC 머리에 서브 스테이지 표시 출력.
	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(detective)
	--인터렉트 가능하도록
	character_util.add_listener(detective, self.controller)
end

--- 탐정과 대화 이벤트
function local_class:talk_detective_event(is_first_talk)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local detective = self.characters.detective()

	quest_icon_util.remove(detective)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--플레이어가 탐정 NPC 인터렉트 시, 플레이어 1초에 걸쳐 ■타일로 left 방향 정렬.
	party_util.align_party(detective, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	if is_first_talk then
		--탐정 (right, idle, idle) : 오오, 당신은…! 용사님이시군요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'right',
				'idle',
				'idle',
				'pw_mutation_pre_14')

		--탐정 (right, idle, idle) : 만나뵙게되어 영광입니다!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_pre_15')

		--플레이어 (left, idle, release 2회) 이후 bomb_idle 1초.
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		--탐정 (right, idle, idle) : 저 말인가요?
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_pre_16')

		--탐정 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 제 이름은 P, 탐정이죠.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'right',
				'cross_arm',
				nil,
				'pw_mutation_pre_17')

		--탐정 (right, idle, idle) : 최근 마을에서 실종 사건이 연속으로 발생해, 주민들이 아주 불안해 하고 있습니다.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_pre_18')

		--탐정 (right, idle, victory_get) : 그래서 제가! 이 사건을 해결하려고 나타났죠!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'right',
				'victory_get',
				nil,
				'pw_mutation_pre_19')

		--탐정 NPC한테 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(detective, nil, 'notice')

		--탐정 (right, idle, idle) : 아! 그러고보니 용사님!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_pre_20')

		--탐정 (right, idle, release 2회) : 사건을 도와줄 조수가 마침 필요하던 참이었습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				nil,
				'pw_mutation_pre_21')

		--탐정 (right, idle, idle) : 괜찮으시다면, 저를 도와 함께 이 실종사건을 해결해주시지 않겠습니까?
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_pre_22')
	else
		--탐정 (right, smile, cast) : 제 조수가 되어주러 오셨나요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'right',
				'cast',
				'smile',
				'pw_mutation_pre_38')

		--상단의 선택지 재출력.
	end

	--선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--좋아! 맡겨두라고! (mercy)
		{ 'pw_mutation_pre_23', 'mercy' },
		--지금은 바빠서 이만… (brutal)
		{ 'pw_mutation_pre_35', 'brutal' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--탐정 (right, smile, idle) : 감사합니다! 그럼…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'right',
				'idle',
				'smile',
				'pw_mutation_pre_24')

		--탐정 (right, idle, eat) 1초.
		local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'eat')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--탐정 NPC가 (right, idle, throw) 하며 worker_costume(임시) 를 플레이어의 왼쪽 0.4칸에 아이템 착지.
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
		scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		--아이템 이름 : 픽시 변장복
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = detective.Position,
			target = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.4, 0, 0),
			item_id = 21266,
			unique_id = 'pixy_costume',
		})

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		--가디언 (left, tired, release 2회)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
