local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldMutationSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = PixyWorldMutation @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldMutationController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_19_2'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		talk_detective = 2,
		talk_guard = 3
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.characters = {
		princess_pixy = function()
			return get_character('princess_pixy')
		end,
		guard = function(number)
			return get_character('s1_guard_' .. number)
		end,
		detective = function()
			return get_character('pixy_detective')
		end
	}

	self.zones = {
		talk_zone = 's1_talk_zone',
		guard_zone = 's1_guard_zone',
	}

	self.markers = {
		leader_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_leader_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		detective_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_detective_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			load_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.quest_marker_name = 'mutation_main'
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.cs_controller.QuestId,
			true, self.markers.leader_pos(1) + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.talk_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_detective
		sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_detective_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.talk_detective and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.guard_zone) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_guard
		sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_guard_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

--- 마을 앞에서 탐정과 대화 이벤트
function local_class:talk_detective_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess_pixy = self.characters.princess_pixy()
	local detective = self.characters.detective()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	do
		local camera_pos = (self.markers.leader_pos(1) + self.markers.detective_pos(1)) * 0.5

		camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)
	end

	--1초에 걸쳐 꼬마공주는 ■타일, 탐정 픽시는 ■타일로 left 방향으로 정렬.
	do
		local wp_key = 'party_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, self.markers.leader_pos(1),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, self.markers.detective_pos(1),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마공주 right 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	--탐정 픽시 (left, idle, idle) : 작은 용사님! 이 앞으로 가면 사건이 벌어졌던 마을이 있습니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s1_1')

	--탐정 픽시 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 전에 말했듯이, 마을은 지금 실종 사건 때문에 상당히 어수선한 상태입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm',
			nil,
			'pw_mutation_s1_2')

	--탐정 픽시 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 큰 용사님께 받은 픽시 변장복은 잘 챙겨오셨죠?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false },
			nil,
			'pw_mutation_s1_3')

	--꼬마 공주 (right, idle, nod 1회) : 응! 까먹지 않고 잘 챙겨왔어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 },
			nil,
			'pw_mutation_s1_4')

	--꼬마공주 (right, idle, eat) 자세 1초.
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--꼬마공주 캐릭터에 FX_dead 이펙트가 출력됨과 동시에 꼬미공주 스파인 princess_gnome#princess_gnome_02 (임시) 로 스파인 변경됨.
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')
	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(leader.Position)
	character_util.set_position(princess_pixy, leader.Position)
	character_util.set_position(leader, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_active_state(princess_pixy, 'enabled')
	--스파인이 변경됨과 동시에 꼬마공주(right, idle, victory_get)
	scene_util.set_anim(princess_pixy, self, 'victory_get')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess_pixy)
	--탐정 픽시 (left, idle, nod 2회) : 흠! 좋습니다! 누가봐도 픽시 같아 보이는군요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'nod',
			nil,
			'pw_mutation_s1_5')

	--gimmick_boomerang (아이템 든 채로 get 자세)
	local boomerang_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = princess_pixy.Position + vector(0.4, 0.4, 0.2),
		item_id = 21255,
		unique_id = 'boomerang',
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = true,
		skip_item_text = true,
		spr_scale = 0.5
	})

	--꼬마공주 (right, smile, get)  : 그리고 여기! 부메랑도 빌려왔지!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess_pixy, self, 'right',
			'get',
			'smile',
			'pw_mutation_s1_6')

	quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(boomerang_item)
	--탐정 픽시 (left, idle, release) : 좋습니다! 안으로 들어가시죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'release',
			nil,
			'pw_mutation_s1_7')

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	character_util.convert_to_npc(detective)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(princess_pixy, param, true)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(detective, user_party, true)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	local boomerang_controller = get_stage_event_controller('PixyWorldBoomerangController')

	boomerang_controller:change_ui_owner(leader, princess_pixy)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.cs_controller.QuestId,
			true, self.markers.leader_pos(2) + vector(-1, 0, -0.5))
end

--- 마을 입구에서 경비와 대화 이벤트

local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldMutationSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = PixyWorldMutation @
		Comment = @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type PixyWorldMutationController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'substage_19_2'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	--self.states = {
	--	none = 1,
	--}
	--
	--self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.characters = {
		detective = function()
			return get_character('pixy_detective')
		end,
		stick_npc = function(number)
			return get_character('stick_npc_' .. number)
		end,
		knife_npc = function(number)
			return get_character('knife_npc_' .. number)
		end,
		cardboard_box_npc = function(number)
			return get_character('cardboard_box_npc_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- field objects
	self.field_objects = {
		stick = function()
			return get_field_object('stick')
		end,
		knife_sword = function()
			return get_field_object('knife_sword')
		end,
		cardboard_box = function()
			return get_field_object('cardboard_box')
		end,
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		stick_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_stick_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		knife_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_knife_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		cardboard_box_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_cardboard_box_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		out_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('out_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- fx
	self.fx = setmetatable({
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		pixy_status = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('pixy_status')
		end,
	}, {
		__index = {
			load_all = function(this)
				for _, func in pairs(this) do
					func()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.twinkle_fxs = setmetatable({
		contains = nil,
		add = nil,
		remove = nil
	}, {
		__index = {
			contains = function(this, key)
				return this[key] ~= nil
			end,
			add = function(this, key, value)
				if this:contains(key) then
					return
				end

				this[key] = value
			end,
			remove = function(this, key)
				if this[key] ~= nil then
					this[key]:Dispose()
					this[key] = nil
				end
			end
		}
	})

	-- items
	self.items = {
		data = nil,
		add_item = function(this, item_id, unique_id, pos, scale)
			if this.data == nil then
				this.data = {}
			end

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = pos,
				item_id = item_id,
				unique_id = unique_id,
				spr_scale = scale,
				skip_text = true,
				loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter
			})

			table.insert(this.data, item)
		end,
		pop_item = function(this, unique_id)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i, item in ipairs(this.data) do
					if item.UniqueId == unique_id then
						local pop_item = item

						table.remove(this.data, i)

						return pop_item
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.data ~= nil then
				for i = 1, #this.data do
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.data[i])
					this.data[i] = nil
				end

				this.data = nil
			end
		end
	}

	-- 이벤트 정보
	self.event_data = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.event_data = {
		{
			fo = self.field_objects.stick(),
			interact_event_func = self.stick_interact_event,
			interact_return_func = self.stick_return_event,
			show_interact_event = false,
			zone_name = 'stick_event_zone',
			zone_event_func = self.stick_zone_event,
			show_zone_event = false
		},
		{
			fo = self.field_objects.knife_sword(),
			interact_event_func = self.knife_sword_interact_event,
			interact_return_func = self.knife_sword_return_event,
			show_interact_event = false,
			zone_name = 'knife_event_zone',
			zone_event_func = self.knife_sword_zone_event,
			show_zone_event = false
		},
		{
			fo = self.field_objects.cardboard_box(),
			interact_event_func = self.cardboard_box_interact_event,
			interact_return_func = self.cardboard_box_return_event,
			show_interact_event = false,
			zone_name = 'cardboard_box_event_zone',
			zone_event_func = self.cardboard_box_zone_event,
			show_zone_event = false
		}
	}

	for i = 1, #self.event_data do
		local fo = self.event_data[i].fo

		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		self.twinkle_fxs:add(fo.Name, self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(fo.Position))
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	character_util.set_position(self.characters.stick_npc(1), vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(self.characters.stick_npc(2), vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(self.characters.knife_npc(1), vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(self.characters.knife_npc(2), vector(999, 0, 999))

	self.items:dispose_all()

	for i = 1, #self.event_data do
		local fo = self.event_data[i].fo

		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		self.twinkle_fxs:remove(fo.Name)
	end

	self.event_data = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.event_data do
		local data = self.event_data[i]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, data.fo) then
			if not data.show_interact_event then
				data.show_interact_event = true
				sp_util.start_scene(data.interact_event_func, self)
			else
				sp_util.start_scene(data.interact_return_func, self)
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.event_data do
		local data = self.event_data[i]

		if data.show_interact_event and not data.show_zone_event and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), data.zone_name) then
			data.show_zone_event = true
			sp_util.start_scene(data.zone_event_func, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_boss' then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_end_event, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:stick_return_event()
	local stick = self.field_objects.stick()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local detective = self.characters.detective()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	do
		local wp_key = 'party_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, stick.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, stick.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	--탐정픽시 (down, attack, release) : 이럴 때가 아니에요! 얼른 남쪽으로 가요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'down',
			'release',
			'attack',
			'pw_mutation_s2_134')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:stick_interact_event()
	local stick = self.field_objects.stick()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local detective = self.characters.detective()
	local stick_npc_a = self.characters.stick_npc(1)
	local stick_npc_b = self.characters.stick_npc(2)

	--stick 아이템에 붙어있던 FX_Object_Twinkle 이펙트 제거.

	self.twinkle_fxs:remove(stick.Name)

	--npc 미리 업데이트
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(stick_npc_a, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(stick_npc_b, 0, 0)

	stick_npc_b.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, stick.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),

	--탐정 픽시 (right, attack, idle) : 한번 조사해보겠습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_2')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--1초에 걸쳐 남A (down, idle, idle) , 남B (up, idle, idle) NPC가 알파 50%값으로 페이드 인.

	--꼬마공주 (right, scared, cast 자세로 0.03값 shake 지속) : 방… 방금…! 몽둥이로 때린다고…!

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'pw_mutation_s2_9')

	--탐정 픽시 (right, scared, cast 자세로 0.03값 shake 지속) : 분, 분명히 포대자루에 담아서 가져온다는 소리도 했었어요…!
	scene_util.shake(detective, 0.03, 999)
	scene_util.set_emotion(detective, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_10')

	--꼬마공주 (right, scared, cast 자세로 0.03값 shake 지속) : 설, 설마… 저런식으로 그 동안 사람들을 때려서 납치한건…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'pw_mutation_s2_11')

	--꼬마공주, 탐정 픽시 캐릭터 shake 멈춤.
	character_util.stop_shake(leader)
	character_util.stop_shake(detective)
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, detective })
	--꼬마공주 (up, attack, idle) / 탐정픽시 (down, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(detective, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(detective, self, 'attack')
	--꼬마공주 (up, attack, idle): 안되겠어! 큰일이 나기 전에 빨리 가봐야 해!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'pw_mutation_s2_12')

	--탐정픽시 (down, attack, idle) : 분명… 남쪽 구역에서 보자고 했었어요!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_13')

	--탐정픽시 (down, attack, release) : 그 쪽으로 가보죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'down',
			'release',
			'attack',
			'pw_mutation_s2_14')

	--npc 다시 세팅
	character_util.set_position(stick_npc_a, self.markers.stick_pos(1))
	character_util.set_direction(stick_npc_a, 'right')

	self.items:add_item(21271, 'seak', stick_npc_a.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:stick_zone_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local detective = self.characters.detective()
	local stick_npc_a = self.characters.stick_npc(1)
	local stick_npc_b = self.characters.stick_npc(2)
	local seak_item = self.items:pop_item('seak')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	--플레이어 강제 트리거 존 진입 시, 하단의 이벤트가 진행된다.
	--1초에 걸쳐 꼬마공주는 ■타일, 탐정 픽시는 ■타일로 down 방향으로 정렬.
	do
		local wp_key = 'party_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader,
				self.markers.stick_pos(2) + vector(-3, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective,
				self.markers.stick_pos(2) + vector(-2, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--꼬마공주 (down, attaack, jump 1회) 와 동시에 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'notice')

	--꼬마공주, 픽시탐정 오른쪽으로 3칸 run 자세로 이동 후 down 방향 전환.
	do
		local wp_key = 'party_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader,
				self.markers.stick_pos(2),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'down' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective,
				self.markers.stick_pos(2) + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = 'down' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 남A NPC를 향해 포커스.
	--동시에 1초에 걸쳐 카메라 사이즈 4.5로 줌아웃
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_thriller', state = 'event', mix = 6 })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.5, 1)
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(stick_npc_a, 1)

	--남A left 방향 전환 1회. 0.5초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(stick_npc_a, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--남A right 방향 전환 1회. 0.5초 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(stick_npc_a, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--남A (right, attack, twohand_idle) : 아무도 없겠지…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_15')

	--남A (right, attack, twohand_idle) : 시끄럽게 소리가 새 나가면 곤란하니까 말이야…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_16')

	--남A (right, attack, twohand_idle) : 아주 박살을 내주마…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_17')

	--남A (right, attack, 2배속으로 twohand_attack 자세 지속)
	scene_util.set_anim(stick_npc_a, self, { name = 'twohand_attack', scale = 2, sfx_name = function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
		--twohand_attack 자세로 막대기가 포대자루 아이템을 칠 때마다 타이밍에 맞춰 포대자루 아이템에 0.03값 shake 0.5초
		quest_drop_item_util.shake(seak_item, 'shake', 0.03, 0.5)
		--포대자루 아이템 맞을때마다 FX_hit FX_lasthit 이펙트와 Damage Squish, Red pulse 출력.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_harvester_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_wood_02')
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(seak_item.Position)
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(seak_item.Position)
		--막대기가 포대자루를 칠 때마다 화면 0.4값으로 0.3초 shake.
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	end})
	--대기 1.5초
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 플레이어에게로 복귀.
	--동시에 0.5초에 걸쳐 카메라 사이즈 4로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_to_default( 0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--꼬마공주(right,scared,cast), 탐정픽시(left,scared,cast) - 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(detective, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, detective }, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_group_anim({ leader, detective }, self, 'cast')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--탐정 픽시 (left,attack,release) - 0.5초
	scene_util.set_emotion(detective, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(detective, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--꼬마공주 (right,attack,nod 2회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마공주, 탐정픽시 왼쪽으로 3.5칸, 아래쪽으로 2.5칸 run 자세로 1.5초동안 이동.
	--이동을 시작하는 동시에 꼬마공주 대사 출력
	-- 꼬마공주 (down, attack, run) : 멈춰어어어!!!
	do
		local wp_key = 'party_wp'

		local leader_wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(leader,
				leader.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, -1), true)
		local detective_wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(detective,
				detective.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, -1), true)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader_wp,
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'down', run = true, play_sfx = true })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, detective_wp,
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'down', run = true, play_sfx = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(leader, { key = 'pw_mutation_s2_18', skip = true })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--슬로우 모션 진행. (타임 스케일 값: 0.5 / 총 연출은 2초에 걸쳐 진행)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 6 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	time_util.mod('slow', 0.5)
	--남A (right, surprise, embarrassed) 자세 전환.
	scene_util.set_emotion(stick_npc_a, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(stick_npc_a, self, 'embarrassed')
	--[0초 ~ 2초]] Stage Camera가 값 3으로 줌인하는 동시에 꼬마공주, 탐정픽시 (right, attack, prostrate) 자세로 남A NPC를 향해 jump.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 2)
	--꼬마공주는 남A의 0.6칸 왼쪽 위치로 jump.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.jump(leader, 1.5, 2)
	character_util.move_to(leader, stick_npc_a.Position + vector(-0.6, 0, 0), 2)
	--탐정픽시는 남A의 0.6칸 오른쪽 위치로 jump.
	scene_util.set_direction(detective, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.jump(detective, 1.5, 2)
	character_util.move_to(detective, stick_npc_a.Position + vector(0.6, 0, 0), 2)
	--꼬마공주, 탐정픽시가  jump하여 남A 위치에 착지하며 슬로우 모션 종료.
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--꼬마공주, 탐정픽시가  jump하여 착지했을 때, 카메라 0.4값으로 1초 shake.
	time_util.unmod('slow')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	--동시에 남A NPC쪽에 FX_hit 와 FX_lasthit 이펙트, Damage Squish, Red pulse 출력
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(stick_npc_a.Position)
	self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(stick_npc_a.Position)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(stick_npc_a)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(stick_npc_a)
	--남A NPC (right, scared, prostrate) 자세로 전환.
	scene_util.set_emotion(stick_npc_a, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(stick_npc_a, self, 'prostrate')
	--꼬마공주, 탐정픽시, 남A 캐릭터 모두 0.04값으로 shake 하기 시작.
	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.04, 999)
	scene_util.shake(detective, 0.04, 999)
	scene_util.shake(stick_npc_a, 0.04, 999)
	--남A NPC (right, scared, prostrate) : 뭐, 뭐야?! 당신들 누구야! 이거 놔…!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_19')

	--꼬마공주 (right, attack, prostrate) : 시치미 떼도 소용 없다, 범인!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'pw_mutation_s2_20')

	--탐정픽시 (right, attack, prostrate) : 포대자루에 사람을 담아서 납치하고 죽도록 패다니…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_21')

	--탐정픽시 (right, attack, prostrate) : 실종사건의 범인으로 널 체포하겠어!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_22')

	--남A NPC (right, scared, prostrate) : 뭐?! 대체 무슨 소릴 하는거야!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_23')

	--1.5초에 걸쳐 화면 위쪽으로 2칸 이동하는 동시에, 위쪽에서 남B 캐릭터가 run 자세로 지정된 위치로 이동.
	character_util.set_position(stick_npc_b, stick_npc_a.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 11))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(stick_npc_b)
	wp_util.move_async(stick_npc_b, stick_npc_b.Position + vector(0, 0, -9), nil, 1.5)

	--남B (down, smile, idle) : 이봐! 말한대로 시럽 가져왔어! 작업은 다 끝난거야?
	scene_util.set_emotion(stick_npc_b, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_b, 'pw_mutation_s2_24')

	--꼬마공주, 탐정픽시, 남A 캐릭터 모두 shake 멈춤.
	character_util.stop_shake(leader)
	character_util.stop_shake(detective)
	character_util.stop_shake(stick_npc_a)
	--꼬마공주, 탐정 픽시 (up, idle, idle) 로 전환하는 동시에 (question) 이모티콘 표시.
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, detective })
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ leader, detective }, 'up')
	character_util.show_group_emoticion_async({ leader, detective }, nil, 'question')

	--꼬마공주 (up, idle, idle) : 응? 시럽?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'pw_mutation_s2_25')

	--남A (right, attacak, prostrate) : 대체 무슨 소릴 하는거지 모르겠네!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(stick_npc_a, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_26')

	--남A (right, attacak, prostrate) : [shout] 난 그냥 빙수에 먹을 얼음을 깨고 있었던 것 뿐이라고!!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6, mix = 3 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(stick_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_27')

	--꼬마공주 (right, surprise, idle) , 탐정픽시 (left, surprise, idle) 로 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')

	character_util.set_direction(detective, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(detective, self, 'surprise')
	--탐정픽시 (left,  idle, idle) : 빙… 빙수?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_28')

	--탐정 픽시 (right, surprise, eat) 자세 1초
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_direction(detective, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--포대자루 아이템에 FX_dead 이펙트가 출력됨과 동시에 square_ice(임시) 아이템으로 변경됨.
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(seak_item.Position)
	self.items:add_item(21272, 'ice', seak_item.Position, 1)
	quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(seak_item)
	--탐정 픽시 (right, surprise, cast) : 정, 정말이네…!
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_29')

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.items:pop_item('ice'))

	--캐릭터 위치는 다음과 같이 변경됨.
	--꼬마공주 ■타일에서 (left, tired, cast)
	character_util.set_position(leader, stick_npc_a.Position + vector(2, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')
	--탐정픽시 ■타일로 (left, tired, cast)
	character_util.set_position(detective, stick_npc_a.Position + vector(2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(detective, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(detective, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'cast')
	--남A (right, mad, cross_arm)
	scene_util.set_emotion(stick_npc_a, self, 'mad')
	scene_util.set_anim(stick_npc_a, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })
	--남B (right, tired, idle)
	character_util.set_position(stick_npc_b, stick_npc_a.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_direction(stick_npc_b, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(stick_npc_b, self, 'tired')

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--꼬마공주, 탐정픽시 (left, tired, cast) : 죄송합니다아…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(leader, { key = 'pw_mutation_s2_30', skip = true })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_30')

	--남A (right, mad, cross_arm) : 나 참! 갑자기 사람 잡아다가 무슨 범인으로 만들어?!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_31')

	--꼬마공주 (left, tired, cast) : 그, 그치만… 아무리 봐도 실종 사건의 범인 같아 보여서…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'pw_mutation_s2_32')

	--탐정픽시 (left, tired, cast) : 게다가 시끄럽게 소리가 새어 나가면 곤란하다고…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_33')

	--남A (right, mad, cross_arm) : 얼음 깨부수는 소리가 마을안에서 나면 곤란하다는 뜻이었지!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_34')

	--남B (down, tired, idle) : 그, 그만 가지… 오해했다는데 별 수 있나.
	scene_util.set_direction(stick_npc_b, 'down')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(stick_npc_b, 'pw_mutation_s2_35')

function local_class:knife_sword_interact_event()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local detective = self.characters.detective()
	local knife_npc_a = self.characters.knife_npc(1)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, knife_sword.Position + vector(1, 0, 0.5),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'question',
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'pw_mutation_s2_39')

	--꼬마 공주 (left, tired, cast) : 어째서 이런 데 칼이…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'cast',
			'tired',
			'pw_mutation_s2_40')

	--탐정 픽시 (left, attack, idle) : 한번 조사해보겠습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_41')

	--탐정 픽시 (left, attack, staff_cast) 자세 지속
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_ball_02')
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'staff_cast')

	--대기 0.5초

	--1초에 걸쳐 여A (left, tired, cast) NPC가 알파 50%값으로 페이드 인.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	character_util.set_position(knife_npc_a, knife_sword.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(knife_npc_a, 'left')

	scene_util.set_anim(knife_npc_a, self, 'cast')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--여A (left, idle, idle) : …벌써 이곳에 머문지도 3달이 넘었군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(knife_npc_a, self, 'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'pw_mutation_s2_42')

	--여A (left, idle, idle) : …더는 계획을 지체할 수 없어.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(knife_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_43')

	--여A (left, attack, idle) : 슬슬… 마무리 지을 시간이군
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(knife_npc_a, self, 'left',
			'idle',
			'attack',
			'pw_mutation_s2_44')

	--여A (left, idle, eat) 자세 1초.

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--여A (left, attack, sword_idle) 로 전환되며 손에 monster_knife_epic 무기를 듬.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(knife_npc_a, self, 'sword_idle')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(knife_npc_a, '[base]weapon1', 'tactical_knife_sword')
	--동시에 꼬마공주, 탐정픽시 (left, surprise, jump.1회).
	character_util.group_normal_jump({ leader, detective }, true)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, detective }, self, 'surprise')
	--여A (left, attack, sword_idle) : 의뢰 내용은 살인 청부.
	scene_util.set_emotion(knife_npc_a, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(knife_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_45')

	--여A (left, attack, sword_idle) : 타겟은… 서쪽에 있는 외딴 집에서 혼자 거주 중이라 했었지.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(knife_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_46')

	--여A (left, attack, sword_idle) : 시야에 나타났을 때, 단번에 급소를 노려주마.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(knife_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_47')

	--1초에 걸쳐 배경의 틴트 원래대로 복귀되는 동시에, 여자A NPC도 1초에 걸쳐 알파 0%값으로 사라짐.

	do
		local wp_key = 'party_wp'

		character_util.remove_group_anim({ leader, detective })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, knife_sword.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left', run = true, play_sfx = true })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, knife_sword.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'pw_mutation_s2_48')

	--탐정 픽시 (right, scared, cast 자세로 0.03값 shake 지속) : 이 마을에 킬러가 있었다니… 무섭군요…!
	scene_util.shake(detective, 0.03, 999)
	scene_util.set_emotion(detective, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_49')

	--꼬마공주 (left, scared, cast 자세로 0.03값 shake 지속) : 저, 저런식으로 그 동안 사람들을 처리한건가…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'pw_mutation_s2_50')

	--꼬마공주, 탐정 픽시 캐릭터 shake 멈춤.
	character_util.stop_shake(leader)
	character_util.stop_shake(detective)
	character_util.remove_group_anim({ leader, detective })
	--꼬마공주 (left, attack, idle) / 탐정픽시 (right, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, detective }, self, 'attack')

	--꼬마공주 (left, attack, idle): 서두르자! 가서 막아야 해!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'pw_mutation_s2_51')

	--탐정픽시 (right, attack, idle) : 분명… 서쪽의 외딴 집에서 타겟이 나타날 거라 했었어요!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_52')

	--탐정픽시 (right, attack, release 2회) : 그 쪽으로 가보죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'pw_mutation_s2_53')

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.

	--여A (left, attack, sword_idle)
	character_util.set_position(knife_npc_a, self.markers.knife_pos(1))
	character_util.set_direction(knife_npc_a, 'left')
	--moster_knife_epic 무기를 듬.
	--여B (right, scared, cast)
	character_util.set_position(knife_npc_b, self.markers.knife_pos(2))
	character_util.set_direction(knife_npc_b, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knife_npc_b, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(knife_npc_b, self, 'cast')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, self.markers.knife_pos(4),

	camera_util.move_to_target_async(knife_npc_a, 1)

	scene_util.shake(knife_npc_b, 0.03, 2, '03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(knife_npc_b, 'pw_mutation_s2_54')

	--여A (left, attack, sword_idle) : 빌어도 소용 없어, 내 계획은 바뀌지 않으니까.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(knife_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_55')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(knife_npc_a, 'pw_mutation_s2_56')

	scene_util.set_anim(knife_npc_b, self, 'dead')
	--칼에 찔리는 타이밍에 맞춰 FX_lasthit 이펙트 출력되는 동시에 여B한테 Damage Squish, Red pulse 출력.
	self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(knife_npc_b.Position)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(knife_npc_b)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(knife_npc_b)
	--칼에 찔리는 동시에 화면 0.3값으로 shake 0.5초.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_onehand_stinger_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	--대기 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)
	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 플레이어한테 원상복귀.
	--동시에 1초에 걸쳐 카메라 사이즈 4로 줌인
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)


	--꼬마공주(right,scared,cast), 탐정픽시(left,scared,cast) - 1초

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--꼬마공주(down,scared,cast), 탐정픽시(up,idle,cast) - 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(detective, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_group_anim({ leader, detective }, self, 'cast')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--탐정 픽시 (left,attack,release) - 0.5초 후 다시 up 방향
	scene_util.set_direction(detective, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(detective, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(detective, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	scene_util.set_direction(detective, 'up', false)
	--꼬마공주 (down,damaged,nod 2회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')

	--꼬마공주, 탐정픽시 (left,attack,cast) 공통 적용
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ leader, detective }, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, detective }, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_group_anim({ leader, detective }, self, 'cast')
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마공주, 탐정픽시 왼쪽으로 2.5칸 run 자세로 0.5초동안 이동.
	--이동을 시작하는 동시에 꼬마공주 대사 출력
	do
		local wp_key = 'party_wp'

		scene_util.set_group_emotion({ leader, detective }, self, 'attack')
		character_util.remove_group_anim({ leader, detective })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
				nil, 0.5, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left', run = true, play_sfx = true })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, detective.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
				nil, 0.5, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left', run = true, play_sfx = true })

		-- 꼬마공주 (down, attack, run) : 안돼애애애!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(leader, { key = 'pw_mutation_s2_58', skip = true })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--슬로우 모션 진행. (타임 스케일 값: 0.5 / 총 연출은 2초에 걸쳐 진행)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 6 })
	time_util.mod('slow', 0.5)
	--여B (right, surprise, embarrassed) 자세 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(knife_npc_a, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knife_npc_a, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(knife_npc_a, self, 'embarrassed')
	--[0초 ~ 2초]] Stage Camera가 값 3으로 줌인하는 동시에 꼬마공주, 탐정픽시 (left, attack, prostrate) 자세로 여A NPC를 향해 jump.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 2)
	--꼬마공주는 여A의 0.5칸 오른쪽 위치로 jump.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.jump(leader, 1.5, 2)
	character_util.move_to(leader, knife_npc_a.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), 2)
	--탐정픽시는 여A의 0.5칸 오른쪽 위치로 jump.
	scene_util.set_direction(detective, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.jump(detective, 1.5, 2)

function local_class:cardboard_box_return_event()
	local cardboard_box = self.field_objects.cardboard_box()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local detective = self.characters.detective()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	do
		local wp_key = 'party_wp'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, cardboard_box.Position + vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(detective, cardboard_box.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0.5),
				nil, 1, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	--탐정픽시 (down, attack, release) : 지체할 시간 없습니다! 북쪽으로 가시죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'down',
			'release',
			'attack',
			'pw_mutation_s2_136')
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

	command_util.publish_monster_notice(cardboard_box_npc_b, leader, 'battle')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('battle_gate_1', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('battle_gate_2', true))
end

function local_class:battle_end_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local detective = self.characters.detective()
	local cardboard_box_npc_b = self.characters.cardboard_box_npc(2)

	--보스전 클리어 이후, 1초에 걸쳐 화면 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.5, mix = 5 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battle_gate_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battle_gate_2', false))

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--남B (right, damaged, prostrate) 자세 상태.
	field_object_util.set_active_state(cardboard_box_npc_b, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(cardboard_box_npc_b)
	character_util.set_position(cardboard_box_npc_b, self.markers.cardboard_box_pos(1))
	character_util.set_direction(cardboard_box_npc_b, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(cardboard_box_npc_b, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(cardboard_box_npc_b, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })

	--꼬마공주 ■타일, 탐정 픽시는 ■타일로 (left, idle, idle) 상태.
	character_util.set_position(leader, cardboard_box_npc_b.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	character_util.stop_shake(detective)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(detective)
	character_util.set_position(detective, cardboard_box_npc_b.Position + vector(2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(detective, 'left')

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--남B (right, damaged, prostrate 자세로 0.03값 shake 0.5초) : 내, 내가…. 이럴 수는…
	scene_util.shake(cardboard_box_npc_b, 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(cardboard_box_npc_b, 'pw_mutation_s2_127')

	--남B (right, damaged,  prostrate 자세로 0.03값 shake 0.5초) : 어째서 난…. 제대로 태어나지… 못한거야…
	scene_util.shake(cardboard_box_npc_b, 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(cardboard_box_npc_b, 'pw_mutation_s2_128')

	--돌연변이 픽시 (right,confused,prostrate)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.shake(cardboard_box_npc_b, 0.03, 0.5, false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(cardboard_box_npc_b, self, 'confused')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마공주 right 방향 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	--탐정픽시 (left, smile, clap) : 정말 대단했어요, 작은 용사님…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'clap',
			'smile',
			'pw_mutation_s2_129')

	--탐정픽시 (left, smile, idle) : 용사님 덕분에 범인을 찾을 수 있었어요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'idle',
			'smile',
			'pw_mutation_s2_130')

	--꼬마공주 (right, idle, release 2회) : 뭘! 네 능력의 도움 덕분이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			'pw_mutation_s2_131')

	--탐정픽시 (left, idle, question) : 돌연변이 픽시를 실제로 본 건 처음입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'question', keep = true },
			'idle',
			'pw_mutation_s2_131_1')

	--탐정픽시 (left, idle, question) : 돌연변이들은 선천적으로 마나 중독에 시달린다더군요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_131_2')

	--탐정픽시 (left, idle, question) : 보통은 괴물이 되기 전에 마을에서 관리를 하는걸로 압니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_131_3')

	--탐정픽시 (left, idle, question) : 설마 지금까지 숨어 지내는 돌연변이가 있었다니…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_131_4')

	--탐정픽시 (left, idle, question) : 게다가 다른 픽시를 먹어서 마나 중독을 억제한다는 건 들어본 적이 없습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective, 'pw_mutation_s2_131_5')

	--탐정픽시 (left, attack, release 2회) : 추가 조사를 해야겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'pw_mutation_s2_131_6')

	--탐정 픽시 (left,idle,eat) 자세 1초유지, 탐정픽시 자세 전환과 동시에 꼬마공주 (left,idle,idle) 전환
	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이후 탐정픽시 (right,idle,cast2) 자세 전환과 동시에 돌연변이 픽시 시체 옆으로 스테이터스 창 팝업으로 출력 연출 진행
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)
	scene_util.set_anim(detective, self, 'cast2')

	local status_window_controller = get_stage_event_controller('StatusWindowController')

	local ov_lt = CS.Oak.PixyStatusWindowLifeTime()
	ov_lt.AppearTime = 0.25
	ov_lt.LifeTime = 2
	ov_lt.DisappearTime = 0.25

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_06')
	status_window_controller:show_status_window({
		target = cardboard_box_npc_b,
		health = 31,
		mana = 87,
		sanity = 24,
		skill_rank = CS.Oak.PixyStatRank.S,
		unique_skill = 'pw_mutation_s2_131_9',
		is_right = true,
		overriden_life_time = ov_lt
	})

	--스테이터스창 2.5초 출력 후 제거.
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	--탐정픽시 (left, idle, idle) : 이건…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			'pw_mutation_s2_131_7')

	--탐정 픽시  silence 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(detective, nil, 'silence')

	--꼬마공주 (left,tired,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	--탐정픽시 (left, idle, question) : 생각보다 더 까다로운 사건이 되겠군요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'question',
			'idle',
			'pw_mutation_s2_131_8')

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	--탐정픽시 (left, attack, idle) : 탐정픽시 (left, attack, idle) : 그 전에 어서 이 사실을 마을 사람들에게 알려야겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'idle',
			'attack',
			'pw_mutation_s2_132')

	--탐정픽시 (left, attack, victory_get) : 탐정 P! 오늘도 사건 해결!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective, self, 'left',
			'victory_get',
			'attack',
			'pw_mutation_s2_133')

	--탐정 픽시 아래쪽으로 1.5초에 걸쳐 run 자세로 10칸 이동 하며 화면에서 사라짐.
	wp_util.move_async(detective, detective.Position + vector(0, 0, -10),
			nil, 1.5, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	character_util.set_position(detective, vector(999, 0, 999))

	--꼬마공주 (left,idle,idle) 전환 0.5초 대기.
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	--꼬마공주(left,tried,idle) 상태로 ( silence) 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	camera_util.move_async(get_field_object('s2_door_2').Position, 1)

	--이후 상단의 도어 오픈 연출.
	--Focus On, Full Opening 처리.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s2_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s2_door_2', false))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	local boomerang_controller = get_stage_event_controller('PixyWorldBoomerangController')

	boomerang_controller:boomerang_active_setting(true)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	self.controller:complete_quest({
		run_complete_ui = true,
		run_fame_alignment = false,
		return_control = true,
		run_chapter_end_ui = false,
	})
end


return local_class
